Kiswahili: Hii ni kwa sababu, ikiwa mtu mwingine kwenye ndege hiyo atapatikana kuwa ameambukizwa, mamlaka inaweza kuwafuatilia watu waliokuwa wameketi karibu naye ili kupimwa na kukarantini.

English: COVID-19 is treated by relieving symptoms and preventing complications.
Kiswahili: COVID-19 inatibiwa kwa kutuliza dalili na kuzuia matatizo.

English: There is no vaccine or specific treatment for the novel coronavirus.
Kiswahili: Hakuna chanjo au matibabu mahsusi ya virusi hivi vya korona.

English: Research into a vaccine or specific antiviral drug is underway.
Kiswahili: Utafiti wa chanjo au dawa mahsusi ya kuzuia virusi unaendelea.

English: There are a variety of trials using HIV medications and other novel antiviral medications for treatment of COVID-19.
Kiswahili: Kuna majaribio mbalimbali yanayotumia dawa za HIV na dawa nyingine za kuzuia virusi kutibu COVID-19,

English: Mild symptoms may be relieved by taking paracetamol (acetaminophen).
Kiswahili: Dalili ndogo zinaweza kutulizwa kwa kutumia paracetamol (acetaminophone).

English: If you are infected with COVID-19, countries will isolate you until several consecutive tests for COVID-19 are negative.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa umeambukizwa COVID-19, nchi zitakutenga hadi vipimo kadhaa mtawalia za COVID-19 ziwe hasi.

English: If you have been in close contact with someone infected with COVID-19, many countries will quarantine you for 14 days since the last exposure and monitor you for signs and symptoms.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa umetangamana kwa karibu na mtu aliyeambukizwa COVID-19, nchi nyingi zitakukarantini kwa siku 14 tangu mara ya mwisho mlipotangamana na kukufuatilia kwa ishara na dalili.

English: Some countries will also test you even if you don't have symptoms.
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya nchi zitakupima pia hata kama huna dalili.

English: In many countries, the healthcare system has been stretched to the point of not being able to handle the sheer number of patients, and there is a chance you may be refused treatment due to the lack of available medical staff, supplies or equipment.
Kiswahili: Katika nchi nyingi, mfumo wa huduma ya afya umepanuliwa sana hadi hauwezi kushughulikia idadi kubwa ya wagonjwa, na kuna uwezekano unaweza kunyimwa matibabu kwa sababu ya ukosefu wa wahudumu wa matibabu, vifaa au bidhaa.

English: Many countries have shut down or severely limited flights, ships, and border crossings, especially to and from affected areas.
Kiswahili: Nchi nyingi zimefunga au kuzuia kabisa usafiri wa ndege, meli, na kuvuka mipaka, hasa kwenda na kutoka maeneo yaliyoathirika.

English: Even more countries have imposed restrictions on arriving travelers, either barring entry (maybe with an exception for local citizens and permanent residents) or requiring you to be quarantined, typically for 14 days.
Kiswahili: Hata nchi zaidi zimeweka vikwazo kwa wasafiri wanaowasili, aidha kuwazuia kuingia (isipokuwa raia na wakazi wa kudumu) au kuwahitaji kukarantini, kwa kawaida siku 14.

English: Even if a mandatory quarantine is not imposed, you may be asked to "self-quarantine" by staying at home and not interacting with other people.
Kiswahili: Hata kama karantini ya lazima haijawekwa, huenda ukaombwa "ujikarantini mwenyewe" kwa kukaa nyumbani na kutotangamana na watu wengine.

English: The most severe restrictions are on travellers who have recently been to affected areas, but increasingly many countries are applying them to incoming travellers overall.
Kiswahili: Vikwazo vikali zaidi ni kwa wasafiri ambao wamekuwa katika maeneo yaliyoathirika, lakini nchi zaidi nyingi zinavitumia kwa wasafiri wanaoingia kwa jumla.

English: Some countries have even prohibited all or almost all foreigners from entry or limited the ability of local citizens and residents to leave.
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya nchi hata zimewakataza wageni wote au karibu wote dhidi ya kuingia au kuzuia uwezo wa raia na wakazi kutoka.

English: What are the affected areas?
Kiswahili: Maeneo yaliyoathirika ni gani?

English: Well, this is a fast-changing situation, and each country/region/organization has its own list of what areas are subject to restrictions.
Kiswahili: Kwa hakika, hii ni hali inayobadilika kwa haraka, na kila nchi/eneo/shirika lina orodha yake yenyewe ya maeneo ambayo yamewekewa vikwazo.

English: The city of Wuhan is on every list and the rest of mainland China is on most.
Kiswahili: Jiji la Wuhan liko kwenye kila orodha na China Kuu iko poa.

English: Other areas that are often included: France, Germany, Hong Kong, Iran, Italy, Japan, Macau, Singapore, South Korea, Spain, Taiwan, the United Kingdom, the United States, the Schengen Area as a whole, and sometimes various others.
Kiswahili: Maeneo mengine ambayo yanajumuishwa sana ni pamoja na: Ufaransa, Ujerumani, Hong Kong, Irani, Italia, Japani, Makau, Singapoo, Korea Kusini, Taiwani, Uingereza, Marekani, Maeneo yote ya Schengen, na wakati mwingine mengine mengi.

English: Some countries have imposed restrictions based on citizenship or residency from severely affected areas.
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya nchi zimeweka vikwazo kulingana na uraia au makazi kutoka kwa maeneo yaliyoathirika sana.

English: A detailed list of entry restrictions is maintained by the IATA.
Kiswahili: Orodha kamili ya vikwazo vya kuingia inadumishwa na IATA.

English: It doesn't cover all the restrictions, but it's still useful.
Kiswahili: Haishughulikii vikwazo vyote, lakini inaweza bado kusaidia.

English: Keep up to date—the outbreak and the travel restrictions are changing rapidly.
Kiswahili: Pata taarifa mpya—mlipuko na vikwazo vya usafiri vinabadilika kwa haraka.

English: For travel in the near future, consider making refundable reservations in case the changing situation forces you to change your plans.
Kiswahili: Kwa usafiri wa baadaye, fikiria kuhifadhi nafasi ambayo unaweza kurudishiwa fedha iwapo hali zinazobadilika zinakulazimisha kubadilisha mipango yako.

English: Avoid buying tickets with a connection in an affected area – even changing planes can make you subject to restrictions.
Kiswahili: Epuka kununua tiketi zinazounganisha safari katika eneo lililoathirika - hata kubdilisha ndege kunaweza kufanya uwekewe vikwazo.

English: Flights may get canceled with little notice, either due to the disease's spread and ever-changing entry restrictions, or simply because fewer people are flying and airlines are having trouble filling seats.
Kiswahili: Huenda ndege zikaghairishwa bila ilani, aidha kwa sababu ya kuenea kwa ugonjwa na vikwazo vya kuingia vinavyobadilika sana, au kwa sababu ya watu wachache wanaosafiri na mashirika ya ndege kuwa na matatizo ya kujaza viti.

English: You might also be delayed for hours upon arrival waiting for temperature checks and related procedures and paperwork, or even get quarantined for two weeks.
Kiswahili: Unaweza pia kucheleweshwa kwa saa kadhaa baada ya kuwasili ili kuangaliwa hali joto na taratibu na fomu husika, au hata kukarantani kwa wiki mbili.

English: Be prepared for the possibility of disruption to your travel plans, especially if traveling internationally.
Kiswahili: Kuwa tayari kwa uwezeko wa usumbufu wa mipango yako ya usafiri, hasa ikiwa unasafiri kimataifa.

English: Even if you're nowhere near affected areas there's a risk that you'll have to stay at the destination longer than planned if you've shared a building or vessel with an infected person.
Kiswahili: Hata kama hauko karibu na maeneo yaliyoathirika, kuna hatari kwamba utalazimika kuishi mahali unakoenda kwa muda mrefu zaidi kuliko ulivyopangia ikiwa umeshiriki jengo au chombo na mtu aliyeambukizwa.

English: For example, in late February an Italian doctor on vacation in Costa Adeje (Canary Islands) was diagnosed with COVID-19, and as a result all the guests in the hotel he stayed at were quarantined.
Kiswahili: Kwa mfano, mwisho wa Februari daktari Mwitaliano akiwa kwenye likizo kule Costa Adeje (Visiwa vya Canary) alipatikana kuwa na COVID-19, na kama matokeo yake wageni wote katika hoteli aliyoishi walisalia karantini.

English: Lockdowns and other internal restrictions
Kiswahili: Kusitishwa kwa shughuli za kawaida na vikwazo vingine vya ndani.

English: Some countries and regions, especially severely affected ones, are implementing emergency lockdowns and restrictions on people's movements and activities, even for those who haven't recently been abroad.
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya nchi na maeneo, hasa katika maeneo yaliyoathirika sana, yanasitisha shughuli za kawaida na vikwazo kwa mienendo na shughuli za watu, hata kwa wale ambao hawasafiri ng'ambo hivi karibuni.

English: These include the temporary reintroduction of some border controls, restrictions on travel within the country, closing or limiting service at restaurants and other establishments, banning large public events, and in the most severe cases prohibiting people from leaving the house except for essential reasons.
Kiswahili: Hii ni pamoja na kuanzisha kwa muda baadhi ya vidhibiti vya mpaka, vikwazo vya kusafiiri ndnai ya nchi, kufunga au kuzuia huduma za mikahawa na biashara zingine, kupiga marufuku matukio makubwa ya umma, na katika visa vikali zaidi kuwazuia watu kutoka nyumbani isipokuwa kwa sababu muhimu.

English: Beyond government restrictions, individual establishments are shutting their doors and cancelling events to try to reduce the spread of the virus.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya vikwazo vya serikali, biashara za kibinafsi zinafunga milango yako na kughairisha matukio ili kujaribu kupunguza kuenea kwa virusi.

English: In China, there are extensive restrictions on transportation and activity, which vary widely by province, city, and even by district or village.
Kiswahili: Nchini Uchina, kuna vikwazo zaidi vya usafiri na shughuli, ambavyo vinatofautiana pakubwa kwa mkoa, jimbo na hata wilaya au kijiji.

English: Many governments recommend against traveling to China at this time.
Kiswahili: Serikali nyingi zinapendekeza kutosafiri Uchina wakati huu.

English: If you have no choice, do your research and get up-to-date information about the local situation wherever you are going.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa huna chaguo lingine, fanya utafiti wako na upate maelezo mapya kuhusu hali ya kokote unakoenda.

English: People who have traveled to Hubei face particularly severe restrictions.
Kiswahili: Watu waliosafiri kwenye Hubei wanakabiliwa na vikwazi vikali zaidi.

English: 14-day quarantine, self-quarantine, or COVID-19 test upon arrival from other parts of China or from other countries, at your expense
Kiswahili: Karantini ya siku 14, karantini ya kibinafsi, au kipimo cha COVID-19 baada ya kuwasili kutoka sehemu nyingine za Uchina au kutoka nchi nyingine, kwa gharama yako

English: questions about your travel and medical history (lying can get you years in prison)
Kiswahili: maswali kuhusu usafiri wako na historia ya matibabu (kudaganyana kunaweza kufanya ufungwe miaka kadhaa gerezani)

English: mandatory registration using an online or paper form
Kiswahili: usajili wa lazima kwa kutumia fomu ya mtandaoni au ya karatasi

English: requirement to wear a face mask in public
Kiswahili: mahitaji ya kuvaa barakoa ukiwa kwa umma

English: people who have been outside of China within 14 days not allowed into public places like malls
Kiswahili: watu ambao wamekuwa nje ya Uchina ndani ya siku 14 hawaruhisi katika maeneo ya umma kama vile duka kuu

English: shops only accept mobile payments, not cash
restaurants, transportation and other establishments refusing service to non-Chinese citizens
Kiswahili: mikahawa, usafiri na biashara nyingine zinakataa kutoa huduma kwa raia wasio wa Uchina

English: many forms of transportation reduced or shut down
Kiswahili: aina nyingi za usafiri zimepunguzwa au kufungwa

English: mandatory real-name registration for public transit cards
Kiswahili: usajili wa lazima wa jina halisi kwa ajili ya kadi ya usafiri wa umma

English: access in and out of a town, village, or city completely blocked
Kiswahili: kuingia na kutoka mji, kijiji, au jiji umezuiwa kabisa

English: non-resident visitors prohibited from entering apartment complexes
Kiswahili: wageni wasio wakazi wamekatazwa kuingia ghorofa za kuishi

English: only allowed to go outside once every two days to get supplies
Kiswahili: wanaruhusiwa kwenda nje mara moja baada ya kila siku mbili ili kupata bidhaa

English: businesses, activities, and attractions closed
Kiswahili: biashara, shughuli, na vivuvito vimefungwa

English: businesses need local government permission to re-open
Kiswahili: biashara zinahitaji kibali cha serikali ya mitaa ili kufungua tena

English: restaurants (if they are even open) require a minimum distance between customers
Kiswahili: mikahawa (kama imefunguliwa) inahitaji umbali wa chini unaoruhusiwa kati ya wateja

English: selling substandard face masks has a maximum sentence of life imprisonment
Kiswahili: kuuza barakoa duni za uso kunaweza kusababisha kifungo cha maisha

English: As of mid-March 2020, Europe is the epicenter of the epidemic, and many European countries have closed their borders to international travel - only border commuters and freight are allowed to cross.
Kiswahili: Hadi kati ya Machi 2020, Ulaya imekuwa kitivo cha janga hili, na nchini nyingi za Ulaya zimefunga mipaka yao kwa usafiri wa kimataifa - wasafiri wa mipaka na wasafirisha mizigo pekee ndio wameruhusiwa kuvuka.

English: Also businesses other than food stores and pharmacies are closed, and public transport has been reduced or stopped.
Kiswahili: Pia biashara kando na maduka ya chakula na maduka ya dawa zimefungwa, na usafiri wa umma umepunguzwa au kukomeshwa.

English: In the worst affected countries including Italy, Spain and France, lockdowns like in China in January, have been implemented.
Kiswahili: Katika nchi zilizoathirika kabisa ikiwa ni pamoja na Italia, Hispania na Ufaransa, kusitishwa kwa shughuli za kawaida kumetekelezwa kama kule Uchina mnano Januari.

English: As well the EU has closed its outer borders.
Kiswahili: Pia EU imefunga mipaka yake ya nje.

English: COVID-19 is prevalent also in North America.
Kiswahili: COVID-19 imesambaa sana pia katika Marekani Kaskazini.

English: The borders between Canada, the U.S., and Mexico are closed to non-essential travel, and in many areas bans on big gatherings are in effect (this means places like restaurants are closed, and events are canceled).
Kiswahili: Mipaka kati ya Canada, Marekani, na Meksiko imefungwa kwa usafiri usio muhimu, na katika maeneo mengi marufuku yamepikwa kwa mikusanyiko ya watu wengi (hii inamaanisha maeneo kama vile mikahawa imefungwa, na matukio yameghairishwa).

English: Numerous state, county, and municipal jurisdictions have issued stay-at-home orders that require all nonessential businesses to close.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka mengi ya jimbo, kaunti, na manispaa imetoa amri ya kukaa nyumbani ambayo inahitaji biashara zote zisizo muhimu kufungwa.

English: With lots of flights canceled, warnings issued, and restrictions imposed, flying in the time of coronavirus can be a challenge.
Kiswahili: Ndege nyingi zikiwa zimeghairishwa, maonyo kutolewa, na vikwazo kuwekwa, kusafiri kwa ndege wakati huu wa virusi vya korona kuna changamoto.

English: Some routes are not possible.
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya njia haziwezekani.

English: Others will require more inconvenient connections than usual—multiple stops and long waits between flights.
Kiswahili: Wengine watahitaji miunganisho ya safari isio ya kawaida-vituo kadhaa na kusubiri kwa muda mrefu kati ya ndege.

English: In some cases that means more expensive tickets.
Kiswahili: Katika baadhi ya visa hiyo inamaanisha tiketi ghali zaidi.

English: On the other hand, the good news is that many flights are cheaper than usual due to decreased demand, and there's a decent chance you'll get an empty seat next to you.
Kiswahili: Upande mwingine, habari njema ni kwamba ndege nyingi ni za bei nafuu zaidi ya kawaida kwa sababu ya upungufu wa abiria, na kuna uwezekano mkubwa utapata viti tup kando yako.

English: Build in extra time for your connections, especially if transferring from an international flight to a domestic flight and especially if your itinerary involves a country that's seriously affected.
Kiswahili: Jipangie muda wa ziada wa kuunganisha safari zako, hasa ikiwa unahamia ndege ya kimataifa hadi ndege ya ndani na hasa ikiwa safari yako inahusisha nchi ambayo imeathiriwa vibaya.

English: Screenings, temperature checks, extra paperwork, and the associated waiting around can add minutes or hours before you're allowed to continue on your journey.
Kiswahili: Uchunguzi, ukaguzi wa halijoto, fomu za ziada, na muda husika wa kusubiri unaweza kuongezea dakika au saa kabla uruhusiwe kuendelea na safari yako.

English: You may find it harder than usual to buy a ticket to or from a destination subject to warnings and restrictions.
Kiswahili: Huenda ukapata kuwa vigumu kuliko kawaida kununua tiketi kwenda au kutoka mwisho wa safari yako kulingana na maonyo na vikwazo.

English: This is a real concern if you're trying to get out of an affected area.
Kiswahili: Huu ni wasiwasi wa kweli ikiwa unajaribu kutoka eneo lililoathirika.

English: For instance, most aggregators are not selling tickets from China to the United States (presumably to avoid falling afoul of restrictions and being on the hook for a passenger's flight out).
Kiswahili: Kwa mfano, wauzaji hawauzi tiketi kutoka Uchina hadi Marekani (hiyo ni kwa sababu ya kuepuka kukiuka vikwazo na kushindwa kupata ndege ya abiria ya kutoka)

English: To buy a ticket for an itinerary like this, you may have to contact the airline or use a lesser-known aggregator.
Kiswahili: Ili kununua tiketi ya safari kama hii, huenda ukalamizika kuwasiliana na ndege au utumie muuzaji asiyejulikana sana.

English: Another possibility is to buy two separate tickets (for instance, a ticket from China to Cambodia and a second ticket from Cambodia to the U.S.), but be careful you won't get quarantined or lose your luggage in between.
Kiswahili: Uwezekano mwingine ni kununua tiketi mbili tofauti (kwa mfano, tiketi kutoka Uchina hadi Kambodia na tiketi ya pili kutoka Kambodia hadi Marekani.), lakini kuwa mwangalifu usiingie karantini au upoteze mizigo yako hapo katikati.

English: Connecting flights can be a problem.
Kiswahili: Ndege za kuunganisha safari zinanaweza kuwa na shida,

English: The risk of getting stuck in the connection city is higher than usual right now, due to delays for screening and testing as well as extensive cancellations.
Kiswahili: Hatari ya kukwama katika mji wa kuunganisha safari iko juu kuliko kawaida wakati huu, kwa sababu ya kucheleweshwa na kupimwa na hata pia kughairishwa kwingi.

English: Connecting in an affected area may lead to entry restrictions later on, and if you've been in an affected area recently some countries won't even let you change planes.
Kiswahili: Kuunganisha safari katika eneo lililoathirika kunaweza kusababisha vikwazo vya kuingia baadaye, na kama umekuwa katika eneo lililoathirika hivi karibuni baadhi ya nchi hazitakuruhusu ubadilishe ndege.

English: On certain itineraries there is a risk of getting quarantined somewhere along the way.
Kiswahili: Katika safari nyingine kuna hatari ya kuingia karantini mahali katikati ya safari yako.

English: So book a direct flight if you can, and if not, think carefully about where to connect.
Kiswahili: Kwa hivyo hifadhi nafasi ya safari ya moja kwa moja, na ikiwa haiwezekani, fikiria kwa makini kuhusu ni wapi utaunganisha safari yako.

English: In uncertain times, plans can change.
Kiswahili: Katika hali nyingine, mipango inaweza kubadilika.

English: Many embassies and consulates have evacuated nonessential staff, and some have shut down operations completely.
Kiswahili: Balozi nyingi zimewaokoa wafanyakazi wasio muhimu, na baadhi zimefunga shughuli zao kabisa.

English: Emergency assistance should still be available, though it's possible you may have to contact a further-away consulate if your local one has shut down.
Kiswahili: Msaada wa dharura unapaswa bado kupatikana, ijapokuwa inawezekana unaweza kulazimika kuwasiliana na ubalozi kwa mbali ikiwa ile iliyo karibu na wewe imefungwa.

English: If you have been stranded due to the pandemic, your nearest consulate may be able to help you find a flight home, arrange an emergency loan so you can buy a ticket, or provide an emergency passport.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa umekwama kwa sababu ya janga hili, ubalozi wako ulio karibu unaweza kukusaidia kupata ndege ya kukupeleka nyumbani, kupanga mkopo wa dharura ili uweze kununua tiketi, au kukupa pasipoti ya dharura.

English: At the very least they can keep you informed about the local situation and notify you about recently introduced travel requirements and restrictions.
Kiswahili: Katika hali ya chini kabisa wanaweza kukufahamisha kuhusu hali ya ndani na kukuarifu kuhusu mahitaji na vikwazo vipya vya kusafiri.

English: Ordinary consular services such as visa and passport processing may be suspended or restricted to urgent need, depending on the location and the consulate.
Kiswahili: Huduma za kawaida za ubalozi kama vile kuchakata visa na pasipoti zinaweza kusitishwa au kuzuiwa kwa mahitaji ya haraka, kulingana na eneo na ubalozi.

English: Although some people call the disease "Wuhan pneumonia" (武汉(漢)肺炎/武肺), "Wuhan disease", or "Chinese virus", the use of these terms is considered racist in China and by many people of Chinese origin.
Kiswahili: Ijapokuwa baadhi ya watu wanaita ugonjwa huu "nimonia ya Wuhan" (武汉(漢)肺炎/武肺), "ugonjwa wa Wuhan", au "virusi vya Uchina", matumizi ya maneno haya yanachukuliwa kama ya ubaguzi wa rangi nchini Uchina na watu wengi wa eneo la Uchina.

English: It is still common to refer the disease as "Wuhan pneumonia" or "Chinese virus" in places like Hong Kong and Taiwan.
Kiswahili: Ni kawaida kurejelea ugonjwa huu kama "nimonia ya Wuhana" au "virusi vya Uchina" katika maeneo kama vile Hong kong na Taiwan.

English: To be safe, use location-neutral terms when referring to the disease, such as "COVID-19", "novel coronavirus", or just "the virus" or "the pandemic".
Kiswahili: Ili kuwa salama, tumia maneno ya kawaida ya eneo lako wakati unarejelea ugonjwa huu, kama vile "COVID-19" "ugonjwa wa korona" au "virusi" au "janga" tu.

English: Particularly in developing countries where law enforcement are poorly trained, enforcement of curfew, lockdown or stay-at-home orders are often brutal, often using forces not proportionate against crowds.
Kiswahili: Katika nchi zinazostawi hasa ambapo watekelezaji sheria wamefunzwa vibaya, utekelezaji wa amri ya kutotoka nje, kusitishwa kwa shughuli za kawaida au amri za kukaa nyumbani huwa mbaya sana, mara kwa mara hao hutumia nguvu zisizofaa kwa umati.

English: Comply with these orders, and avoid crowds in public.
Kiswahili: Tii amri hizi, na uepuke umati wa watu.

English: As a result of the coronavirus pandemic, xenophobia has risen in many countries, primarily but not exclusively targeting people perceived to be Chinese.
Kiswahili: Kama matokeo ya janga hili la virusi vya korona, ubaguzi wa wageni umeongezeka katika nchi nyingi, kimsingi lakini sio tu unaowalenga watu wanaochukuliwa kuwa Wachina.

English: There has been a worldwide spike in racist incidents targeting people of East Asian origin, including in major cities such as New York, London and San Francisco.
Kiswahili: Kumekuwa na ongezeko kubwa duniani katika matukio ya ubaguzi wa rangi unaowalenga watu wa asili ya Asia Mashariki, ikiwa ni pamoja na miji mikuu kama vile New York, London na San Francisco.

English: In Hong Kong, Sinophobia, which was already high to begin with, has intensified as a result of the pandemic, with the result that many shops and restaurants are now denying service to mainland Chinese customers and banning Mandarin speakers from their premises (with the exception of Taiwanese).
Kiswahili: Kule Hong Kong, ubaguzi dhidi ya Uchina, ambao ulikuwa juu tayari, umeongezeka kama matokeo ya janga hili, matokeo yake yakisababisha maduka na mikahawa ikiwanyima huduma wateja kutoka China Kuu na kuwapiga marufuku wanenaji wote wa Kimandarini katika majengo yao (isipokuwa Taiwanisi).

English: Levels of xenophobia have also risen in East Asia, with some restaurants and other businesses in Japan and China refusing service to foreign customers.
Kiswahili: Viwango vya ubaguzi wa wageni vimeongezeka pia katika Asia Mashariki, na baadhi ya mikahawa na biashara nyingine nchini Japani na Uchina ikikataa kuwahudumia wateja wa kigeni.

English: In China, there have been incidents of foreigners being refused rooms by hotel staff, and foreign residents, particularly black people, being kicked out of their apartments on short notice by their landlords.
Kiswahili: Nchini Uchina, kumekuwa na matukio ya wageni kunyimwa vyumba na wafanyakazi wa hoteli, na wakazi wa kigeni, hasa watu weusi, wakifurushwa kutoka makazi yao baada ya ilani fupi kutoka kwa kabaila wao.

English: The US government Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
Kiswahili: Vituo vya Kudhibiti na Kuzuia Magonjwa vya serikali ya Marekani

English: European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (daily updates)
Kiswahili: Kituo cha Kudhibiti na Kuzuia Magonjwa cha Ulaya (taarifa za kila siku)

English: United Kingdom government, - Foreign and Commonwealth Office advice for Travellers
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Uingereza, - ushauri kwa Wasafiri kutoka Ofisi ya Mambo ya Nje na Jumuiya ya madola

English: An online map and dashboard from the John Hopkins University Center for Systems Science and Engineering with live updates
Kiswahili: Ramani na dashibodi ya mtandaoni kutoka kwa Kituo cha Chuo Kikuu cha John Hopkins cha Sayansi ya Mifumo na Uhandisi na taarifa za moja kwa moja

English: Partial lists of entry restrictions from IATA and The New York Times
Kiswahili: Orodha nusu ya vikwazo vya kuingia kutoka IATA na The New York Times

English: A variety of misinformation and conspiracy theories about the virus are being promoted online and even by some government officials, so be careful which sources you check for information.
Kiswahili: Maelezo mengi yasio ya kweli na nadharia za njama kuhusu virusi hivi zimekuzwa sana mtandaoni na hata pia na baadhi ya maafisa wa serikali, kwa hivyo kuwa mwangalifu ni vyanzo gani unavyoangalia kwa maelezo.

English: Ensure that all information and advice you receive has been backed by reputable doctors and scientists.
Kiswahili: Hakikisha kwamba maelezo na ushauri wote unaopokea umeungwa mkono na madaktari na wanasayansi wanaoaminika.

English: In a crisis, it's natural to want to keep following the latest updates, but it may be better for your mental health to moderate the amount of news that you look at, and stick to reliable news sources.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa janga, ni kawaida kutaka kufuata taarifa zinazochipuka, lakini huenda ikawa vizuri kwa afya ya akili yako kupunguza kiwango cha habari unachoangalia, na kufuata vyanzo vinavyoaminika vya habari.

English: If you normally watch the news twice per day then stick to this schedule and do something else, rather than having the 24-hour news on continuously.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa kwa kawaida unatazama habari mara mbili kwa siku basi fuata ratiba hii na ufanye mambo mengine, badala ya kupata habari kwa saa 24 kila wakati.

English: b'Angiotensin-converting enzyme 2 (ACE2) is an enzyme attached to the outer surface (cell membranes) of cells in the lungs, arteries, heart, kidney, and intestines.
Kiswahili: Kimeng'enya 2 cha kugeuza b'Angiotensin (ACE2) ni kimeng'enya kilichoambatishwa kwa sehemu ya nje (utandao wa seli) ya seli katika mapafu, mishipa, moyo, figo na utumbo.

English: ACE2 counters the activity of the related angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) by reducing the amount of angiotensin-II and increasing Ang(1-7) making it a promising drug target for treating cardiovascular diseases.ACE2 also serves as the entry point into cells for some coronaviruses.
Kiswahili: ACE2 hukabiliana na shughuli zinazohusiana na kimeng'enya kinachogeuza angiotensin (ACE) kwa kupunguza kiwango cha angiotensi-II na kuongeza Ang(1-7) kwa kuifanya iwe dawa nzuri ya kutibu magonjwa ya moyo. ACE2 hutumika pia kama sehemu ya kuingia kwenye seli ya baadhi ya virusi vya korona.

English: The human version of the enzyme is often referred to as hACE2.
Kiswahili: Toleo la mwanadamu la kimeng'enya hurejelewa mara kwa mara kama hACE2.

English: Angiotensin-converting enzyme 2 is a zinc containing metalloenzyme located on the surface of endothelial and other cells.
Kiswahili: Kimeng'enya 2 cha kugeuza angiotensin ni zinki yenye kimeng'enya cha atomu za metali zilizo kwenye eneo la neva za seli za mwisho na seli nyingine.

English: ACE2 protein contains an N-terminal peptidase M2 domain and a C-terminal collectrin renal amino acid transporter domain.
Kiswahili: Protini ya ACE2 ina kikoa cha M2 cha peptidi ya temino N na kikoa cha kusafirisha asidi ya amino ya figo ya kolektini temino C

English: ACE2 is a single-pass type I membrane protein, with its enzymatically active domain exposed on the surface of cells in lungs and other tissues.
Kiswahili: ACE2 ni protini ya utando wa aina I ya njia moja, kikoa chake kinachotumika cha kumeng'enya kikiwa kwenye sehemu ya juu ya seli katika mapafu na tishu nyingine.

English: The extracellular domain of ACE2 is cleaved from the transmembrane domain by another enzyme known as sheddase, and the resulting soluble protein is released into the blood stream and ultimately excreted into urine.
Kiswahili: Kikoa cha giligili iliyo nje cha ACE2 kimeshikilia kikoa cha utando kwa kimeng'enya kingine kinachojulikana kama sheddase, na protini inayotokea inayoyeyuka hutolewa kwenye mfumo wa damu na mwishowe kutolewa kupitia mkojo.

English: ACE2 is present in most organs: ACE2 is attached to the cell membrane of mainly lung type II alveolar cells, enterocytes of the small intestine, arterial and venous endothelial cells and arterial smooth muscle cells in most organs.
Kiswahili: ACE2 inapatikana katika viungo vingi: ACE2 imeambatishwa kwenye utando wa seli za alveola aina II za mapafu, enterosaiti ya utumbo mdogo, mishipa na seli za mwisho za vena na seli za mishipa laini ya misuli katika viungo vingi.

English: ACE2 mRNA expression is also found in the cerebral cortex, striatum, hypothalamus, and brainstem.
Kiswahili: Onyesho la ACE2 mRNA linapatikana pia katika utando wa bongo, striatum, hypothalamus, na mfumo wa ubongo.

English: The primary function of ACE2 is to act as a counter balance to ACE.
Kiswahili: Kazi kuu ya ACE2 ni kufanya kazi kama kisawazishi cha ACE.

English: ACE cleaves angiotensin I hormone into the vasoconstricting angiotensin II.
Kiswahili: ACE hukuamilia homoni I ya angiotensin kwenye angiotensin II ya shinikizo la damu.

English: ACE2 in turn cleaves the carboxyl-terminal amino acid phenylalanine from angiotensin II (Asp-Arg-Val-Tyr-Ile-His-Pro-Phe) and hydrolyses it into the vasodilator angiotensin (1-7), (H-Asp-Arg-Val-Tyr-Ile-His-Pro-OH).
Kiswahili: Upande wake ACE2 hukwamilia carboxyl-terminal amino acid phenylalanine kutoka kwa angiotensin II (Asp-Arg-Val-Tyr-Ile-His-Pro-Phe) na kuivunja kuwa angiotensin ya vasodilator (1-7), (H-Asp-Arg-Val-Tyr-Ile-His-Pro-OH).

English: ACE2 can also cleave a number of other peptides including [des-Arg9]-bradykinin, apelin, neurotensin, dynorphin A, and ghrelin.
Kiswahili: ACE2 inaweza pia kukwamilia viunganishi kadhaa ikiwa ni pamoja na [des-Arg9]-bradykinin, apelin, neurotensin, dynorphin A, na ghrelin.

English: ACE2 also regulates the membrane trafficking of the neutral amino acid transporter SLC6A19 and has been implicated in Hartnup's disease.
Kiswahili: ACE2 hudhibiti pia usafirishaji wa utando wa kisafirishi SLC6A19 cha amino asili na imetajwa kwa ugonjwa wa Hartnup.

English: As a transmembrane protein, ACE2 serves as the main entry point into cells for some coronaviruses, including HCoV-NL63; SARS-CoV (the virus that causes SARS); and SARS-CoV-2 (the virus that causes COVID-19).
Kiswahili: Kama protini ya kupitisha utando, ACE2 inatumika kama sehemu kuu ya kuingia kwenye seli za baadhi ya virusi vya korona, ikiwa ni pamoja na HCoV-NL63; SARS CoV (virusi ambavyo vinasababisha SARS); na SARS-CoV-2 (virusi ambavyo vinasababisha COVID-19).

English: More specifically, the binding of the spike S1 protein of SARS-CoV and SARS-CoV2 to the enzymatic domain of ACE2 on the surface of cells results in endocytosis and translocation of both the virus and the enzyme into endosomes located within cells.
Kiswahili: Kihususa, ushikamano wa protini ya SI ya SARS-CoV na SARS-CoV2 kwa kikoa cha mmeng'enyo cha ACE2 kwenye sehemu ya juu ya seli husababisha endocytosis na uhamishaji wa virusi na kimeng'enya kwa endosomu zilizo ndani ya seli.

English: This entry process also requires priming of the S protein by the host serine protease TMPRSS2, the inhibition of which is under current investigation as a potential therapeutic.This has led some to hypothesize that decreasing the levels of ACE2, in cells, might help in fighting the infection.
Kiswahili: Mchakato huu wa kuingia unahitaji pia utayarishaji wa protini S na vizuia protini vya serine kuu ya TMPRSS2, uzuiaji ambao unachunguzwa kwa sasa kama matibabu yanayowezekana. Hii imesababisha wengine kudhania kwamba kupunguza viwango vya ACE2, katika seli, kunaweza kusaidia kukabiliana na maambukizi.

English: However, multiple professional societies and regulatory bodies have recommended continuing standard ACE inhibitor and ARB therapy.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, mashirika mengi ya kitaalamu na ya usimamizi yamependekeza kuendelea na kizuzi cha kawaida cha ACE na matibabu ya ARB.

English: A systematic review and meta-analysis published on July 11, 2012, found that "use of ACE inhibitors was associated with a significant 34% reduction in risk of pneumonia compared with controls."
Kiswahili: Upitiaji wa kimfumo na uchanganuzi wa meta uliochapishwa tarehe 11 Julai, 2013, ulipata kwamba "matumizi ya vizuizi vya ACE yalihusishwa na upungufu mkubwa wa asilimia 34 katika hatari ya nimonia ikilinganishwa na vidhibiti."

English: Moreover, "the risk of pneumonia was also reduced in patients treated with ACE inhibitors who were at higher risk of pneumonia, in particular those with stroke and heart failure.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya hayo, "hatari ya nimonia pia ilipunguzwa kwa wagonjwa waliotibiwa na vizuizi vya ACE ambao walikuwa na hatari kubwa ya kupata nimonia, hasa wale wenye kiharusi au moyo kushindwa kufanya kazi.

English: Use of ACE inhibitors was also associated with a reduction in pneumonia related mortality, although the results were less robust than for overall risk of pneumonia."
Kiswahili: Matumizi ya vizuizi vya ACE pia yalijumuishwa na kupungua kwa vifo vinavyohusiana na nimonia, ingawa matokeo yalikuwa dhaifu kuliko hatari ya jumla ya nimonia."

English: Recombinant human ACE2 (rhACE2) is surmised to be a novel therapy for acute lung injury, and appeared to improve pulmonary hemodynamics and oxygen saturation in piglets with a lipopolysaccharide-induced acute respiratory distress syndrome.
Kiswahili: ACE2 iliyounganishwa ya binadamu (rhACE2) imechukuliwa kuwa matibabu mapya ya majeraha makali ya mapafu, na ilionekana kuboresha mzunguko wa damu mwilini na ukolevu wa oksijeni katika nguruwe wadogo walio na ugonjwa uliosababishwa wa shida kali ya mfumo wa kupumua wa lipopolysaccharide.

English: The half-life of rhACE2 in human beings is about 10 hours and the onset of action is 30 minutes in addition to the course of effect (duration) of 24 hours.
Kiswahili: Maisha nusu ya rhACE2 kwa binadamu ni saa 10 na itaanza kufanya kazi baada ya dakika 30 pamoja na sababu ya matokeo (muda) saa 24.

English: Several findings suggest that rhACE2 may be a promising drug for those with intolerance to classic renin-angiotensin system inhibitors (RAS inhibitors) or in diseases where circulating angiotensin II is elevated.Infused rhACE2 has been evaluated in clinical trials for the treatment of acute respiratory distress syndrome.
Kiswahili: Matokeo kadhaa yanaonyesha kuwa rhACE2 inaweza kuwa dawa nzuri kwa wale hawawezi kuvumilia vizuizi vya mfumo vya renin-angiotensin (vizuizi vya RAS) au katika magonjwa ambapo angiotensin II inayozunguka imapenda. Mchanganyiko wa rhACE2 umekadiriwa katika majaribio ya kliniki kwa ajili ya matibabu ya matatizo sugu ya upumuaji.

English: b'Bat SARS-like coronavirus WIV1 (Bat SL-CoV-WIV1), also sometimes called SARS-like coronavirus WIV1, is a strain of Severe acute respiratory syndrome-related coronavirus (SARSr-CoV) isolated from Chinese rufous horseshoe bats (Rhinolophus sinicus).
Kiswahili: Virusi vya korona kama vya SARS ya popo WIV1 (Bat SL-CoV-WIV1), pia ambavyo wakati mwingine hutiwa virusi vya korona kama vya SARS WIV1, ni ugonjwa wa matatizo sugu ya upumuaji yanayohusika na virusi vya korona (SARSr-CoV) vilivyotengwa kutoka kwa spishi ya popo huko Uchina (Rhinolophus sinicus).

English: Like all coronaviruses, virions consist of single-stranded positive-sense RNA enclosed within an envelope.
Kiswahili: Kama virusi vya korona, chembe kimoja cha virusi kina RNA chanya ya kamba moja kilichofunikwa ndani ya gubiko.

English: The discovery confirms that bats are the natural reservoir of SARS-CoV.
Kiswahili: Ugunduzi huo unathibitisha kuwa popi ni hifadhi ya asili ya SARS-CoV.

English: Phylogenetic analysis shows the possibility of direct transmission of SARS from bats to humans without the intermediary Chinese civets, as previously believed.
Kiswahili: Uchunguzi wa filojenitiki unaonyesha uwezekanao wa maambukizi ya moja kwa moja kutoka kwa popo kwenda kwa wanadamu bila kizuizi cha ngawa za Kichina, kama ilivyokuwa ikiaminiwa hapo awali.

English: b'COVID-19 apps are mobile software applications designed to aid contact tracing in response to the 2019-20 coronavirus pandemic, i.e. the process of identifying persons ("contacts") who may have been in contact with an infected individual.
Kiswahili: Programu za COVID-19 ni progamu-tumizi za simu ya mkononi zilizoundwa kusaidia kutafuta watu waliotangamana ili kushughulikia maradhi ya virusi vya korona 2019-20, yaani mchakato wa kutambua watu ("watu waliokutana nao") ambao wanaweza kuwa walitangamana na mtu aliyeambukizwa.

English: Numerous applications were developed or proposed, with official government support in some territories and jurisdictions.
Kiswahili: Programu nyingi zilitengenezwa au kupendekezwa, na msaada rasmi wa serikali katika wilaya na maeneo kadhaa.

English: Several frameworks for building contact tracing apps have been developed.
Kiswahili: Mifumo kadhaa ya kuunda proramu za kutafuta watu waliotangamana imetengenezwa.

English: Privacy concerns have been raised, especially about systems that are based on tracking the geographical location of app users.
Kiswahili: Maswala ya faragha yamedokezwa, haswa kuhusu mifumo ambayo inategemea kufuatilia eneo la kijiografia la watumiaji wa programu.

English: Less intrusive alternatives include the use of Bluetooth signals to log a user's proximity to other cellphones.
Kiswahili: Mibadala isiyojidukiza sana inajumuisha matumizi ya ishara za Bluetooth ili kuweka eneo la karibu la mtumiaji kwa simu zingine.

English: On 10 April 2020, Google and Apple jointly announced that they would integrate functionality to support such Bluetooth-based apps directly into their Android and iOS operating systems.
Kiswahili: Tarehe 10 Aprili 2020, Google na Apple walitangaza kwa pamoja kuwa wataunganisha utendaji ili kukubali programu hizo zinazotegemea Bluetooth moja kwa moja kwenye mifumo yao ya uendeshaji ya Android na iOS.

English: In China, the Chinese government, in conjunction with Alipay, has deployed an app that allows citizens to check if they have been in contact with people that have COVID-19.
Kiswahili: Nchini Uchina, serikali ya Kichina, kwa kushirikiana na Alipay, imetoa programu ambayo huruhusu raia kuangalia ikiwa wametangamana na watu ambao wana COVID-19.

English: It is in use across more than 200 Chinese cities.In Singapore, an app called TraceTogether is being used.
Kiswahili: Inatumika wa zaidi ya miji 200 ya Uchina. Huko Singapore, proframu inayoitwa TraceTogether inatumika.

English: The app was developed by local IT community, released as open source and will be handed over to the government.North Macedonia launched "StopKorona!", a Bluetooth-based app to trace exposure with potentially infected persons and provide a fast response to healthcare authorities.
Kiswahili: Programu hiyo ilitengenezwa na jamii na IY ya eneo hilo, iliyotolewa kama chanzo wazi na itakabidhiwa kwa serikali. Makedonia ya Kaskazini ilizindua "StopKorona!", programu inayotegemea Bluetooth ya kutafuta watu walioambukizwa wanaoweza kueneza na kutoa majibu ya haraka kwa mamlaka ya huduma ya afya.

English: The app was developed by the Ministry of Communication and Technology and Ministry of Health.
Kiswahili: Programu hiyo ilitengenezwa na Wizara ya Mawasiliano na Teknolojia na Wiraza ya Afya.

English: As of 14 April 2020, the app was awaiting approval by the Google Play Store and Apple App Store.
Kiswahili: Kutikia tarehe 14 Aprili 2020, programu ilikuwa inasubiri kuidhinishwa na Google Play Store na Appple App Store.

English: On 12 April, the government stated that the contact tracing app was in an advanced stage of development, and would be available for deployment within weeks.A similar app is planned in Ireland, and in France ("StopCovid").
Kiswahili: Tarehe 12 Aprili, serikali ilisema kuwa programu ya kutafuta watu waliotangamana ilikuwa katika hatua za juu za maendeleo, na itatumika baada ya majuma machache. Programu sawia inapangwa nchini Ireland, na huko Ufaransa ("StopCovid").

English: Both Australia and New Zealand are considering apps based on Singapore's TraceTogether app and BlueTrace protocol.Russia intends to introduce a geofencing app for patients diagnosed with COVID-19 living in Moscow, designed to ensure they do not leave home.
Kiswahili: Australia na New Zealand inazingatia programu kulingana na programu ya TraceTogether ya Singapoo na itifaki ya BlueTrace. Urusi inatarajia kuanzisha programu inayotegemea eneo ya wagonjwa wanaopatikana kuwa na COVID-19 wanaoishi Moscow, iliyoundwa kuhakikishwa kuwa hawatoki nyumbani.

English: Ross Anderson, professor of security engineering at Cambridge University, listed a number of potential practical problems with app-based systems, including false positives and the potential lack of effectiveness if takeup of the app is limited to only a small fraction of the population.
Kiswahili: Ross Anderson, profesa wa uhandisi wa usalama katika Chuo Kikuu cha Cambridge University, aliorodhesha matatizo kadhaa ya kiutendaji ya mifumo ya programu, ikiwemo maoni mazuri ya uongo na ukosefu unaowezekana wa ufanisi ikiwa matumizi ya programu imezuiwa kwa idadi ndogo ya watu.

English: Addressing concerns about the spread of misleading or harmful "coronavirus" apps, Apple set limits on which types of organizations could add coronavirus-related apps to its App Store, limiting them to only "official" or otherwise reputable organizations.
Kiswahili: Kushughulikia matatizo kuhusu usambazaji wa programu za "virusi vya korona" za kupotosha au mbaya, Apple huweka vizuizi vya ni aina gani ya mashirika ambayo inaweza kuweka programu zinazohusiana na virusi vya korona katika Duka lake la Programu, ikiwazuia kwa walio "rasmi" tu au mashirika mengine mashuhuri.

English: Google and Amazon have implemented similar restrictions.
Kiswahili: Google and Amazon zimetumia vizuizi hivyo pia.

English: Privacy campaigners voiced their concern regarding the implications of mass surveillance using coronavirus apps, in particular about whether surveillance infrastructure created to deal with the coronavirus pandemic will be dismantled once the threat has passed.
Kiswahili: Wafanya kampeni ya faragha walionyesha wasiwasi wa madhara ya uchunguzi wa idadi kubwa ya watu kwa kutumia progwamu ya virusi vya korona, haswa kuhusu ikiwa miundombinu ya uchunguzi iliyoundwa kushughulikia ugonjwa wa virusi vya korona itasambaratishwa baada ya ugonjwa kudhibitiwa.

English: Amnesty International and over 100 other organizations issued a statement calling for limits on this kind of surveillance.
Kiswahili: Amnesty International na mashirika mengine zaidi ya 100 yametoa taarifa ikisema kuwa vizuizi viwekwe katika uchunguzi wa aina hii

English: surveillance would have to be "lawful, necessary and proportionate";
Kiswahili: lazima uchunguzi uwe "halali, muhimu, na mwafaka";

English: extensions of monitoring and surveillance would have to have sunset clauses;
Kiswahili: lazima viendelezi vya ufuatiliaji na uchunguzi viwe na sheria za muda;

English: the use of data would have to be limited to COVID-19 purposes;
Kiswahili: matumizi ya data yalazimike kuwa na vizuizi kwa madhumuni ya COVID-19.

English: data security and anonymity would have to be protected and shown to be protected based on evidence;
Kiswahili: lazima usalama wa data na kutojulikana ulindwe na kuonyeshwa kuwa unalindwa kulingana na ushahidi;

English: digital surveillance would have to avoid exacerbating discrimination and marginalisation;
Kiswahili: lazima uchunguzi wa kidijitalii luepuke kuzidisha ubaguzi na kutengwa;

English: any sharing of data with third parties would have to be defined in law;
Kiswahili: lazima kushiriki data yote na wahusika wengine ufafanuliwe kwa sheria;

English: there would have to be safeguards against abuse and the rights of citizens to respond to abuses;
Kiswahili: lazima kuwe na ulinzi dhidi ya unyanyasaji na haki ya raia kushugulikia unyanyasaji;

English: meaningful participation by all "relevant stakeholders" would be required, including that of public health experts and marginalised groups.The German Chaos Computer Club (CCC) and Reporters Without Borders (Reporter ohne Grenzen) (RSF) also issued checklists.
Kiswahili: ushiriki wenye maana wa "wadau wote muhimu" utahitajika, ikiwemo kwa wataalam wa afya ya umma na vikundi vilivyotengwa. Chaos Compute Club ya Ujerumani (CCC) na Waandishi Bila Vizuizi (Mwandishi wa Habari ohne Grenzen) (RSF) pia walitoa orodha ya ukaguzi.

English: The proposed Google/Apple plan intends to address the problem of persistent surveillance by removing the tracing mechanism from their device operating systems once it is no longer needed.
Kiswahili: Mpango uliopendekezwa wa Google/Apple unakusudia kushughukia tatizo la uchunguzi wa kuendelea kwa kuondoa utaratibu wa ufutaji kutoka kwa mfumo wa uendeshaji wa kifaa chao baada kukosa kuhitajika tena.

English: Some countries used network-based location tracking instead of apps, eliminating both the need to download an app and the ability to avoid tracking.
Kiswahili: Nchi zingine zilitumia ufuatiliaji wa eneo unaotegemea mtandao badala ya programu, ikiondoa hitaji ya kupakua programu na uwezo na kuepuka kutafuta.

English: In Israel, network-based tracking was approved.
Kiswahili: Huko Israeli, ufuatiliaji unaotegemea mtandao ulikubaliwa.

English: Network-based solutions that have access to raw location data have significant potential privacy problems.
Kiswahili: Ufumbuzi unaotegemea mtandao ambao una ufikiaji wa data halisi ya eneo una matatizo muhimu yanayowezekana ya faragha.

English: However, not all systems with central servers need to have access to personal location data; a number of privacy-preserving systems have been created that use central servers only for intercommunication (see section below).
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, sio mifumo yote yenye seva kuu inayohitaji kuwa na ufikiaji wa data ya eneo la kibinafsi; mifumo kadhaa ya utunzaji wa faragha imeundwa ambayo hutumia seva kuu tu kwa ajili ya mawasiliano (angalia sehemu hapa chini).

English: In South Korea, a non-app-based system was used to perform contact tracing.
Kiswahili: Huko Korea Kusini, mfumo usio wa programu ulitumika kufanya utafutaji wa watu waliotangamana.

English: Instead of using a dedicated app, the system gathered tracking information from a variety of sources including mobile device tracking data and card transaction data, and combined these to generate notices via text messages to potentially-infected individuals.
Kiswahili: Badala ya kutumia programu moja, mfumo ulikusanya maelezo ya utafutaji kutoka kwa vyanzo anuwai ikiwemo data ya utafutaji wa kifaa cha mkononi na data ya manunuzi ya kadi, na kujumuisha hizi kutoa arifa kupitia ujumbe wa maandishi kwa watu wanaoweza kuwa wameambukizwa.

English: In addition to using this information to alert potential contacts, the government has also made the location information publicly available, something permitted because of far-reaching changes to information privacy laws after the MERS outbreak in that country.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya kutumia maelezo haya kuarifu watu wanaowezekana, serikali pia imefanya maelezo ya eneo kupatikana kwa umma, kitu kinachoruhusiwa kwa sababu ya mabadiliko ya sheria ya faragha ya maelezo baada ya mlipuko wa MERS katika nchi hiyo.

English: This information is available to the public via a number of apps and websites.Countries including Germany considered using both centralized and privacy-preserving systems.
Kiswahili: Maelezo haya yanapatikana kwa umma kupitia programu na tovuti kadhaa. Nchi kadhaa ikijumuisha Ujerumani zilizingatia kutumia mifumo kuu na ya kuhifadhi faragha.

English: As of 6 April 2020, the details had not yet been released.
Kiswahili: Kufikia 6 Aprili 2020, maelezo hayajatolewa.

English: Privacy-preserving contact tracing is a well-established concept, with a substantial body of research literature dating back to at least 2013.As of 7 April 2020, over a dozen expert groups were working on privacy-friendly solutions, such as using Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) to log a user's proximity to other cellphones.
Kiswahili: Utafutaji wa watu waliotangamana ambao faragha yake imehifadhiwa ni dhana iliyooanzishwa vizuri, na kikundi kibwa kilichoanziwa zamani mwaka wa 2013. Hadi tarehe 7 Aprili 2020, vikundi vingi vya wataalamu kadhaa walikuwa wakishughulikia suluhisho za faragha ambazo ni rahisi kutumia, kama vile Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) ya kuweka eneo la karibu la mtumiaji kwa simu zingine.

English: However, PEPP-PT is a co-ordination effort which contains both centralised and decentralised approaches, and is not a single protocol.Decentralised protocols include Decentralized Privacy-Preserving Proximity Tracing (DP-PPT/DP-3T), Temporary Contact Numbers (TCN, fka Contact Event Numbers, CEN), Privacy Sensitive Protocols and Mechanisms for Mobile Contact Tracing (PACT) and others.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, PEPP-PT ni juhudi ya uratibu ambayo ina njia zote za mamlaka moja na mamlaka anuwai, na sio itifaki moja. Itifaki zenye mamlaka anuwai zinajumuisha Utafutaji wa Eneo la Karibu Ambao Faragha Yake Imehifadhiwa yenye Mamlaka Anuwai (DP-PPT/DP-3T), Nambari za Waasiliani wa Muda (TCN, fka Nambari za Waasiliani wa Tukio, CEN), Itifaki za Faragha Nyeti na Mbinu za Kufuatilia Mawasilino ya Simu (PACT) na zingine.

English: In these protocols, identifiable personal data never leaves the device, and all matching happens on-device.
Kiswahili: Katik itifaki hizi, data ya kibinafsi inayoweza kutambulika huwa haitoki kwenye kifaa, na ulinganisho wote hufanyika kwenye kifaa.

English: The Privacy Group at MIT Media Lab has been developing SafePaths, a platform for using privacy-preserving techniques when collecting and using location or path intersection data to track the spread of COVID-19.
Kiswahili: Kikundi cha Faragha katatika MIT Media Lab kimekuwa kikitengeneza SafePaths, jukwa la kutumia mbinu za kuhifadhi faragha wakati wa kukusanya na kutumia eneo au data ili kufuatilia maambukizo ya COVID-19.

English: It is based on research from the whitepaper "Apps Gone Rogue: Maintaining Personal Privacy in an Epidemic" released in March 2020.Another similar effort is the SafeTrace platform by Enigma MPC, a company developing privacy technologies that was also originally founded at the MIT Media Lab.
Kiswahili: Inategemea utafiti kutoka kwa whitepaper "Programu Zimekuwa Lagai: Kudumisha Faragha ya Kibinafsi katika Mlipuko" uliotolewa mwezi wa Machi 2020. Juhudi lingine sawia ni jukwa la SafeTrace la Enigma MPC, kampuni inayokuza teknolojia za faragha ambayo pia ilianzishwa katika MIT Media Lab.

English: SafeTrace utilizes secure hardware technologies to allow users to share sensitive location and health data with other users and officials, without compromising the privacy of that data.
Kiswahili: SafeTrace hutumia teknolojia salama za maunzi za kuruhusu watumiaji kushiriki eneo nyeti na data ya afya kwa watumiaji na maafisa wengine, bila kuathiri faragha ya data hiyo.

English: On 5 April 2020, the global TCN Coalition was founded by groups that had coalesced around what was essentially the same approach and largely overlapping protocols, with the goal to reduce fragmentation, and enable global interoperability of tracing and alerting apps, a key aspect of achieving widespread adoption.
Kiswahili: Tarehe 5 Aprili, Ushirikiano wa kimataifa wa TCN ulianzishwa na vikundi ambavyo vilikuwa vimehusishwa na mbinu sawia na itifaki zilizokuwa zinalingana, kwa lengo la kupunguza mgawanyiko, na kuwezesha ushirikiano wa kimataifa wa programu za kutafuta na kuarifu, sehemu muhimu ya kufanikisha matumizi makubwa.

English: On 9 April 2020, the Singaporean government announced that it had open-sourced the BlueTrace protocol used by its official government app.
Kiswahili: Tarehe 9 Aprili 2020, serikali ya Singapoo ilitangaza kuwa ilifungua itifaki ya BlueTrace inayotumika na programu yake rasmi ya serikali.

English: On 10 April 2020, Google and Apple, the companies that control the Android and iOS mobile platforms, announced an initiative for contact tracing, which they claimed would preserve privacy, based on a combination of Bluetooth Low Energy technology and privacy-preserving cryptography.
Kiswahili: Tarehe 10 Aprili 2020, Google na Appe, kampuni zinazodhibiti majukwaa ya simu ya Android na iOs, zilitangaza mpango wa kutafuta watu waliotangamana, ambayo walidai kuwa walinda faragha, kulingana na mchanganyiko wa teknolojia ya Bluetooth Low Enerygy na ufichamishi wa uhifadhi wa faragha.

English: They also published specifications of the core technologies used in the system.
Kiswahili: Pia zilichapisha uainisho wa teknolojia msingi zinazotumiwa kwenye mfumo.

English: rollout of tools to enable governments to create official privacy-preserving coronavirus tracing apps
Kiswahili: kutoa zana za kuwezesha serikali kuunda programu rasmi za utafutaji wa watu wenye virusi vya korona ambayo inalinda faragha

English: integration of this functionality directly into iOS and AndroidGoogle and Apple plan to address the take-up and persistent surveillance problems by first distributing the system through operating system updates, and later removing it in the same way once the threat has passed.
Kiswahili: muunganisho wa utendakazi huu moja kwa moja katika iOS na AndroidGoogle na mpango wa Apple wa kushughulikia matatizo ya uchunguzi unaoendelea kwa kusambaza kwanza mfumo kupitia visasisho vya mfumo wa uendeshaji, na baadaye kuiondoa kwa njia sawia baada ya tishio kuisha.

English: b'COVID-19 drug development is the research process to develop a preventative vaccine or therapeutic prescription drug that would alleviate the severity of 2019-20 coronavirus disease (COVID-19).
Kiswahili: Utengenezaji wa dawa ya COVID-19 ni mchakato wa utafiti wa kutengeneza chanjo ya kinga au dawa ya matibabu ambayo inaweza kuondoa ukali wa ugonjwa wa virusi vya korona 2019-20 (COVID-19).

English: The International Clinical Trials Registry Platform of the WHO recorded 536 clinical studies to develop post-infection therapies for COVID-19 infections, with numerous established antiviral compounds for treating other infections under clinical research to be repurposed.
Kiswahili: Jukwaa la Usajili wa Majaribio ya Kimatibabu la Kimataifa la WHO lilirekodi tafiti 536 za kimatibabu ili kutengeneza matibabu ya baada ya maambukizi kwa maambukizi ya COVID-19, na kemikali nyingi zilizopatikana za kingavirusi za kutibu maambukizi mengine chini ya utafiti wa kimatibabu zikielekezwa kwingine.

English: In March, the WHO initiated the "SOLIDARITY Trial" in 10 countries, enrolling thousands of people infected with COVID-19 to assess treatment effects of four existing antiviral compounds with the most promise of efficacy.
Kiswahili: Mnamo Machi, WHO ilianzisha "Jaribio la MSHIKAMANO" katika nchi 10, lililowasajili maelfu ya watu walioambukizwa COVID-19 ili kutathmini matokeo ya matibabu ya kemikali nne zinazopatikana za kuzuia virusi zinazoonyesha ufanisi zaidi.

English: A dynamic, systematic review was established in April 2020 to track the progress of registered clinical trials for COVID-19 vaccine and therapeutic drug candidates.Vaccine and drug development is a multistep process, typically requiring more than five years to assure safety and efficacy of the new compound.
Kiswahili: Uhakiki changamani, wa kimfumo ulianzishwa mnamo Aprili 2020 kufuatilia maendeleo ya majaribio yaliyosajiliwa ya kimatibabu ya chanjo ya COVID-19 na dawa zilizoteuliwa za matibabu. Utengenezaji wa chanjo na dawa ni mchakato uaohusisha hatua nyingi, unaohitaji kwa kawaida zaidi ya miaka mitano ili kuhakikisha usalama na kemikali mpya.

English: Drug development is the process of bringing a new infectious disease vaccine or therapeutic drug to the market once a lead compound has been identified through the process of drug discovery.
Kiswahili: Utengenezaji wa dawa ni mchakato wa kuleta chanjo au dawa ya matibabu ya ugonjwa unaoambukiza kwenye soko punde kemikali kuu inapotambuliwa kupitia mchakato wa kugundua dawa.

English: It includes laboratory research on microorganisms and animals, filing for regulatory status, such as via the FDA, for an investigational new drug to initiate clinical trials on humans, and may include the step of obtaining regulatory approval with a new drug application to market the drug.
Kiswahili: Unajumuisha utafiti wa maabara kuhusu vijiumbe na wanyama, kuwasilisha hali za kisheria, kama vile kupitia FDA, kwa dawa mpya ya uchunguzi ili kuanzisha majaribio ya kimatibabu kwa wanadamu, na unaweza kujumuisha hatua za kupata idhini ya kisheria kwa maombi mapya ya dawa ili kutangaza dawa hiyo.

English: Development of a COVID-19 vaccine or therapeutic antiviral drug begins with matching a chemical concept to the potential prophylactic mechanism of the future vaccine or antiviral activity in vivo.
Kiswahili: Utengenezaji wa chanjo au dawa ya kingavirusi ya COVID 19 huanza kwa kulinganisha dhana ya kemikali na mbinu inayowezekana ya kinga ya chanjo za baadaye au shughuli za kingavirusi katika vivo.

English: New chemical entities (NCEs, also known as new molecular entities or NMEs) are compounds that emerge from the process of drug discovery to specify a vaccine or antiviral candidate.
Kiswahili: Vitengo vipya vya kemikali (NCE, vinavyojulikana pia kama vitengo vipya vya molekuli au NME) ni kemikali ambazo zinatokana na mchakato wa ugunduaji wa dawa ili kubainisha chanjo au dawa ya kingavirusi.

English: These have promising activity against a biological target related to COVID-19 disease.
Kiswahili: Vitengo hivi vina shughuli ya kuaminika dhidi ya lengo la kibiolojia linalohusiana na ugonjwa wa COVID-19.

English: At the beginning of vaccine or drug development, little is known about the safety, toxicity, pharmacokinetics, and metabolism of the NCE in humans.
Kiswahili: Mwanzo wa utengenezaji wa chanjo au dawa, mengi hayajulikani kuhusu usalama, sumu, hali ya dawa, na metaboli ya NCE katika wanadamu.

English: It is the function and obligation of drug development to assess all of these parameters prior to human clinical trials to prove safety and efficacy.
Kiswahili: Ni kazi na jukumu la utengenezaji wa dawa kutathmini vigezo hivi vyote kabla ya majaribio ya kimatibabu kwa binadamu ili kudhibitisha usalama na ufanisi.

English: A further major objective of drug development is to recommend the dose and schedule for the first use in a human clinical trial ("first-in-human" [FIH] or First Human Dose [FHD], previously also known as "first-in-man" [FIM]).
Kiswahili: Lengo lingine kuu la utengenezaji wa dawa ni kupendekeza dozi na ratiba ya matumizi ya kwanza katika jaribio la matibabu kwa binadamu ("kwanza katika binadamu: [FIH] au Dozi ya Kwanza ya Binadamu [FHD], iliyojulikana awali kama 'kwanza katika binadamu" [FIM]).

English: In addition, drug development must establish the physicochemical properties of the NCE: its chemical makeup, stability, and solubility.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuongezea, utengenezaji wa dawa lazima uweke sifa za kitabia za NCE: asili ya kemikali, uthabiti, na umumuniyifu.

English: Manufacturers must optimize the process they use to make the chemical so they can scale up from a medicinal chemist producing milligrams, to manufacturing on the kilogram and ton scale.
Kiswahili: Lazima watengenezaji waboreshe mchakato wanaotumia wa kutengeneza kemikali ili waweze kuongezea kemia ya dawa inayotoa miligramu, hadi kutengeneza kwa kilogramu na kiwango cha tani.

English: They further examine the product for suitability to package as capsules, tablets, aerosol, intramuscular injectable, subcutaneous injectable, or intravenous formulations.
Kiswahili: Wanachunguza bidhaa zaidi ili kuona kama zinafaa kufungwa kama vidonge, tembe, aerosoli, dawa ya kudungwa kwenye misuli, dawa ya kudungwa kwenye ngozi, au mchanganyiko wa kudungwa.

English: Together, these processes are known in preclinical and clinical development as chemistry, manufacturing, and control (CMC).Many aspects of drug development focus on satisfying the regulatory requirements of drug licensing authorities.
Kiswahili: Kwa pamoja, michakato hii inajulikana katika utengenezaji wa kabla wa kimatibabu kama kemia, utengenezaji, na udhibiti (CMC). Hali nyingi za utengenezaji wa dawa zinalenga kuridhisha mahitaji ya kisheria ya mamlaka ya inayotoa leseni ya dawa.

English: These generally constitute tests designed to determine the major toxicities of a novel compound prior to first use in humans.
Kiswahili: Kwa jumla hii inahusisha vipimo vilivyobuniwa kubainisha sumu kuu katika mchanganyiko mpya kabla ya matumizi ya kwanza katika binadamu.

English: The Canadian government announced CA$275 million in funding for 96 research projects on medical countermeasures against COVID-19, including numerous vaccine candidates at Canadian universities, with plans to establish a "vaccine bank" of new vaccines for implementation if another coronavirus outbreak occurs.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Canada imetangaza milioni dola 275 za Canada katika ufadhili kwa miradi 96 ya utafiti kuhusu hatua za kimatibabu za kukabiliana na COVID-19, ikiwa ni pamoja na chanjo kadhaa zilizochaguliwa na vyuo vikuu vya Canada, na mipango ya kuanzisha "benki ya chanjo" ya chanjo mpya za kutumika ikiwa mlipuko mwingine wa virusi vya korona utatokea.

English: Phase I trials, usually in healthy volunteers, determine safety and dosing.
Kiswahili: Vipimo vya awamu ya I, kwa kawaida katika watu wanaojitolea wenye afya, huamua usalama na kipimo cha dawa.

English: Phase II trials are used to establish an initial reading of efficacy and further explore safety in small numbers of people having the disease targeted by the NCE.
Kiswahili: Vipimo vya awamu ya II hutumika kuanzisha usomaji wa kwanza wa ufanisi na kuchunguza zaidi usalama katika idadi ndogo ya watu wenye ugonjwa wanaolengwa na NCE.

English: Phase III trials are large, pivotal trials to determine safety and efficacy in sufficiently large numbers of people with the COVID-19 infection.
Kiswahili: Vipimo vya awamu ya III ni vikubwa, vipimo muhimu vya kujua usalama na ufanisi katika idadi kubwa ya watu wenye maambukizo ya COVID-19.

English: If safety and efficacy are adequately proved, clinical testing may stop at this step and the NCE advances to the new drug application (NDA) stage to begin marketing.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa usalama na ufanisi umethibitishwa vizuri, vipimo vya kliniki vinaweza kukoma katika hatua hii na NCE kuendendelea na hatua ya matumizi ya dawa mpya ili kuanza uuzaji.

English: Phase IV trials are post-approval trials that may be a condition attached by the FDA, also called post-market surveillance studies.
Kiswahili: Vipimo vya awamu ya IV ni vipimo vya baada ya idhini ambayo inaweza kuwa hali iliyowekwa na FDA, pia inajulikana kama utafiti wa ufuatiliaji baada ya uuzaji.

English: In addition to the tests required to move a novel vaccine or antiviral drug into the clinic for the first time, manufacturers must ensure that any long-term or chronic toxicities are well-defined, including effects on systems not previously monitored (fertility, reproduction, immune system, among others).
Kiswahili: Kwa kuongezea vipimo vinavyohitajika kutoa chanjo kipya au dawa ya kukinga virusi kwa kliniki kwa mara ya kwanza, lazima watengenezaji wahakikishe kuwa sumu zozote za muda mrefu au za kudumu zimetambuliwa vizuri, ikiwemo athari kwenye mifumo ambayo haijachunguzwa hapo awali (uwezo wa kupata mimba, uzazi, mfumo wa kinga, kati ya zingine).

English: In the United States, this process is called a "new drug application" or NDA.
Kiswahili: Huko Marekani, mchakato huu unajulikana kama "matumizi ya dawa mpya" au NDA.

English: A clinical trial design in progress may be modified as an "adaptive design" if accumulating data in the trial provide early insights about positive or negative efficacy of the treatment.
Kiswahili: Muundo unaoendelea wa vipimo vya kliniki unaweza kurekebishwa kama "muundo unaoweza kubadilika" ikiwa kukusanya data katika vipimo kunatoa ufahamu wa mapema wa ufanisi mzuri au mbaya wa matibabu.

English: The global Solidarity and European Discovery trials of hospitalized people with severe COVID-19 infection apply adaptive design to rapidly alter trial parameters as results from the four experimental therapeutic strategies emerge.
Kiswahili: Vipimo vya Umoja wa kimataifa na Ugunduzi wa Ulaya wa watu waliolazwa kwa sababu ya maambukizo kali ya COVID-19 hutumia muundo unaoweza kubadilika ili kugeuza haraka vigezo vya vipimo huku matokeo kutoka kwa mikakati nne ya majaribio ya matibabu kuibuka.

English: Adaptive designs within ongoing Phase II-III clinical trials on candidate therapeutics may shorten trial durations and use fewer subjects, possibly expediting decisions for early termination or success, and coordinating design changes for a specific trial across its international locations.
Kiswahili: Miundo inayoweza kubadilika ndani ya vipimo vinavyoendelea vya Awamu ya II-II katika matibabu yaliyoteuliwa inaweza kufupisha muda wa majaribio na kutumia wahusika wachache, ikiwezekana kuharakisha maamuzi ya kukamilisha mapema au kufaulu, na kuratibu mabadiliko ya muundo kwa majaribio fulani katika maeneo yake ya kimataifa.

English: Most novel drug candidates (NCEs) fail during drug development, either because they have unacceptable toxicity or because they simply do not prove efficacy on the targeted disease, as shown in Phase II-III clinical trials.
Kiswahili: Dawa nyingi mpya zilizoteuliwa (NCE) huwa hazifaulu wakati wa maendeleo ya dawa, kwa sababu ina sumu isiyokubalika au kwa sababu hazithibitishi ufanisi katika ugonjwa unaolengwa, kama ilivyoonyeshwa katika vipimo vya kliniki vya Awamu ya II-III.

English: The high failure rates associated with pharmaceutical development are referred to as an "attrition rate", requiring decisions during the early stages of drug development to "kill" projects early to avoid costly failures.
Kiswahili: Viwango vya juu vya kufeli vinavyohusiana na maendeleo ya dawa hujulikana kama "kiwango cha kutoa", vinavyohitaji maamuzi wakati wa hatua za mwanzo za maendeleo ya dawa ili "kuua" miradi mapema kuepuka kufeli ya gharama kubwa.

English: One 2010 study assessed both capitalized and out-of-pocket costs for bringing a single new drug to market as about US$1.8 billion and $870 million, respectively.
Kiswahili: Utafiti mmoja katika mwaka wa 2010 uligundua gharama za ziada na zisizokuwa na marejesho za kuleta dawa moja moya kwa soko kukaribia dola bilioni 1.8 na dola milioni 870, mtawalia.

English: A median cost estimate of 2015-16 trials for development of 10 anti-cancer drugs was $648 million.
Kiswahili: Makadirio ya gharama ya wastani ya majaribio ya mwaka wa 2015 hadi 2016 ya kukuza dawa 10 za kuzuia saratani ilikuwa dola milioni 648.

English: In a 2016 review of 106 drug candidates assessed through clinical trials, the total capital expenditure for a manufacturer having a drug approved through successful Phase III trials was $2.6 billion (in 2013 dollars), an amount increasing at an annual rate of 8.5%.
Kiswahili: Katika ukaguzi mwaka wa 2016 wa dawa 106 zilizoteuliwa na kutathminiwa kupitia vipimo vya kliniki, matumizi ya jumla ya mtaji kwa mtengenezaji mwenye dawa ilidhibitishwa kupitia vipimo vilivyofaulu vya Awamu ya III yalikuwa dola bilioni 2.6 (kwa dola za mwaka wa 2013), kiasi cha fedha kinachoongezeka kwa kiwango cha kila mwaka cha asilimia 8.5.

English: Seven trials were evaluating repurposed drugs already approved to treat malaria, including four studies on hydroxychloroquine or chloroquine phosphate.
Kiswahili: Majaribio saba yalikuwa yakikagua dawa zilizotumika vingine na zilizoidhinishwa kutibu ugonjwa wa malaria, ikiwemo utafiti nne wa hydroxychloroquine au chloroquine phosphate.

English: Repurposed antiviral drugs make up most of the Chinese research, with 9 Phase III trials on remdesivir across several countries due to report by the end of April.
Kiswahili: Dawa za kukinga virusi zilizotumika vingine zinajumuisha utafiti zaidi huko Uchina, na majaribio ya Awamu ya III ya remdesiviri katika nchi kadhaa kwa sababu ya ripoti kabla ya mwisho wa Aprili.

English: Led by the Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation with partners investing US$125 million and coordinating with the World Health Organization, the COVID-19 Therapeutics Accelerator began in March, facilitating drug development researchers to rapidly identify, assess, develop, and scale up potential treatments.
Kiswahili: Ikiongozwa na Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation na washiriki wanaowekeza dola milioni 125 na kuratibu na Shirika la Afya Duniani, Kichocheo cha Matibabu ya COVID-19 kilianza mwezi wa Machi, kikiwezesha watafiti wa ukuzaji dawa kutambua haraka, kutatathmini, kukuza, na kuongeza matibabu yanayowezekana.

English: The COVID-19 Clinical Research Coalition formed to coordinate and expedite results from international clinical trials on the most promising post-infection treatments.
Kiswahili: Muungano wa Utafiti wa Kliniki wa COVID-19 uliundwa kuratibu na kuongeza matokeo kutoka kwa majaribio ya kliniki ya kimataifa katika matibabu yanayowezekana zaidi ya baada ya kuambukizwa.

English: In early 2020, numerous established antiviral compounds for treating other infections were being repurposed or developed in new clinical research efforts to alleviate the illness of COVID-19.
Kiswahili: Mwanzoni mwa mwaka wa 2020, misombo anuwai iliyotengenezwa ya kukinga virusi na kutibu maambukizo mengine ilikuwa inatumika vingine au kukuzwa katika juhudi mpya za utafiti wa kliniki ili kupunguza ugonjwa wa COVID-19.

English: For an already-approved drug (such as hydroxychloroquine for malaria), Phase III-IV trials determine in hundreds to thousands of COVID-19-infected people the possible extended use of an already-approved drug for treating COVID-19 infection.
Kiswahili: Dawa iliyoidhinishwa tayari (kama vile hydrichloroquine ya kutibu malaria), majaribio ya Awamu ya III-IV huamua kwa mamia hadi maelfu ya watu walioambukizwa na COVID-19 uwezekano wa matumizi ya ziada ya dawa iliyodhiitishwa tayari kutibu maambukizo ya COVID-19.

English: As of early April 2020, 103 candidate therapeutics were in preclinical or a stage of Phase I-IV development, with trial results for 29 drug candidates expected during April.
Kiswahili: Mapema Aprili 2020, dawa 103 zilizoteuliwa zilikuwa zinapimwa kwa wanyama au katika hatua ya maendeleo ya Awamu ya I-IV, na matokeo ya majaribio ya dawa 29 zilizoteuliwa kutarajiwa mwezi wa Aprili.

English: In March, the World Health Organization (WHO) launched the coordinated "Solidarity trial" in 10 countries to rapidly assess in thousands of COVID-19 infected people the potential efficacy of existing antiviral and anti-inflammatory agents not yet evaluated specifically for COVID-19 illness.
Kiswahili: Mwezi wa Machi, Shirika la Afya Duniani (WHO) lilizindua "jaribio la umoja" ulioratibiwa katika nchi 10 ili kukagua haraka maelfu ya watu walioambikizwa na COVID-19, ufanisi unaowezekana wa dawa za kuzuia virusi au kuzuia uvimbe ambazo bado hazijakaguliwa kwa ajili ya ugonjwa wa COVID-19.

English: Do any of the drugs reduce mortality?
Kiswahili: Kuna dawa zozote zinazopunguza vifo?

English: Do any of the drugs reduce the time a patient is hospitalized?
Kiswahili: Dawa hizo hupunguza muda ambao mgonjwa analazwa hospitalini?

English: Do the treatments affect the need for people with COVID-19-induced pneumonia to be ventilated or maintained in intensive care?
Kiswahili: Je, matibabu hayo huathiri hitaji la watu wenye nimonia ya COVID-19 kuongezwa hewa au kusalia katika kitengo cha huduma maalum?

English: Could such drugs be used to minimize the illness of COVID-19 infection in healthcare staff and people at high risk of developing severe illness?Enrolling people with COVID-19 infection is simplified by using data entries, including informed consent, on a WHO website.
Kiswahili: Je, dawa hazo zinaweza kutumiwa kupunguza ugonjwa wa maambukizo ya COVID-19 katika wafanyikazi wa huduma ya afya na watu walio katika hatari kubwa ya kupata ugonjwa mkali? Kuandikisha watu wenye maambukizo ya COVID-19 kunarahisishwa kwa kutumia uingizaji takwimu, ikiwemo idhini ya kuarifiwa, kwenye tovuti ya WHO.

English: After the trial staff determines the drugs available at the hospital, the WHO website randomizes the hospitalized subject to one of the trial drugs or to the hospital standard of care for treating COVID-19.
Kiswahili: Baada ya jaribio, wafanyakazi huamua dawa zinazopatikana hospitalini, tovuti ya WHO huchagua mhusika aliyelazwa hospitalini bila utaratibu kuwa mmoja wa kufanyiwa majaribio ya dawa au kwa kiwango cha utunzaj wa hospitali kwa ajili ya matibabu ya COVID-19.

English: The trial physician records and submits follow-up information about the subject status and treatment, completing data input via the WHO Solidarity website.
Kiswahili: Daktari wa majaribio hurekodi na kuwasilsha maelezo ya ufuatiliaji kuhusu hali na matibabu ya mhusika, kukamilisha uingizaji wa data kupitia tovuti ya WHO.

English: A global safety monitoring board of WHO physicians examine interim results to assist decisions on safety and effectiveness of the trial drugs, and alter the trial design or recommend an effective therapy.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya kufuatilia usalama duniani ya madaktari wa WHO hukuchunguza matokeo ya muda ili kusaidia maamuzi ya usalama na ufanisi wa dawa za majaribio, na kubadilisha muundo wa jaribio au kupendekeza dawa inayofaa.

English: A similar web-based study to Solidarity, called "Discovery", was initiated in March across seven countries by INSERM (Paris, France).During March, funding for the Solidarity trial reached US$108 million from 203,000 individuals, organizations and governments, with 45 countries involved in financing or trial management.
Kiswahili: Utafiti sawia unaotegemea tovuti wa Umoja, unaojulikana kama "Ugunduzi", ulianzishwa mwezi wa Machi katika nchi saba na INSERM (Paris, Ufaransa). Mwezi wa machi, ufadhili wa jaribo la Umoja ulifikia dola milioni 108 kutoka kwa watu 203,000, mashirika, na serikali, na nchi 45 zilizohusika katika ufhadhili au udhibiti wa jaribio.

English: Numerous candidate drugs under study as "supportive" treatments to relieve discomfort during illness, such as NSAIDs or bronchodilators, are not included in the table below.
Kiswahili: Dawa nyingi zilizoteuliwa zinazochunguzwa kama matibabu "yaliyokubaliwa" ya kupunguza maumivu wakati wa ugonjwa, kama vile NSAID AU bronchodilato, hazijajumuishwa kwenye jedwali hapa chini.

English: Others in early-stage Phase II trials or numerous treatment candidates in Phase I trials, are also excluded.
Kiswahili: Zingine katika majaribio ya hatua ya kwanza ya Awamu ya II au matibabu anuwai yaliyoteuliwa katika majaribio ya Awamu ya I, pia hazijaajumuishwa.

English: Drug candidates in Phase I-II trials have a low rate of success (under 12%) to pass through all trial phases to gain eventual approval.
Kiswahili: Dawa zilizoteuliwa katika majaribio ya Awamu ua I-II zina kiwango cha chini cha mafanikio (chini ya asilimia 12%) kupita katika awamu za majaribio ili kupata idhini ya mwisho.

English: Hydroxychloroquine is more commonly available than chloroquine in the United States.
Kiswahili: Hydroxychloroquine inapatikana sana kuliko chloroquine huko Marekani.

English: Although several countries use chloroquine or hydroxychloroquine for treatment of persons hospitalized with COVID-19, as of March 2020 the drug has not been formally approved through clinical trials in the United States.
Kiswahili: Ingawa nchi kadhaa hutumia chloroquine au hydroxychloroquine kwa matibabu ya watu waliolazwa hospitalini kwa sababu ya COVID-19, kuanzia March 2020 dawa hiyo haijaidhinishwa rasmi kupitia majaribu ya kliniki nchini Marekani..

English: Chloroquine has been recommended by Chinese, South Korean and Italian health authorities for the treatment of COVID-19, although these agencies and the US CDC noted contraindications for people with heart disease or diabetes.
Kiswahili: Chloroquine imependekezwa na wizara ya afya huko Uchina, Korea Kusini na Italia kwa matibabu ya COVID-19, ingawa mashirika haya na CDC ya Marekani ilibaini madhara kwa watu wenye ugonjwa wa moyo au kisukari.

English: Both drugs have extensive interactions with prescription drugs, affecting the therapeutic dose and disease mitigation.
Kiswahili: Dawa zote zina mwingiliano mkubwa na dawa za kuagiza, zikiathiri dawa ya matibabu na kupunguza magonjwa.

English: Some people have allergic reactions to these drugs.On 12 April, a preliminary clinical trial conducted at a hospital in Brazil was stopped when several people given high doses of chloroquine for COVID-19 infection developed irregular heart rates, causing 11 deaths.
Kiswahili: Watu wengine hupatwa na athari za mizio kwa dawa hizi. Tarehe 12 Aprili, jaribio la kliniki lililofanyiwa uchunguzi kwanza lililofanyika katika hospitali nchini Brazili ulikomeshwa wakati watu kadhaa waliopewa kipimo cha juu cha chloroquine kwa ajili ya mmambukizo ya COVID-19 walikuwa na viwango vya mapigo ya moyo yasiyo ya kawaida, na kusababisha vifo vya watu 11.

English: Chinese clinical trials in Wuhan and Shenzhen claimed to show that favipiravir was "clearly effective".
Kiswahili: Majaribio ya kliniki ya Wachina huko Wuhan na Shenzhen yalionyesha kuwa favipiravir ilikuwa "fanisi kabisa".

English: Of 35 patients in Shenzhen tested negative in a median of 4 days, while the length of illness was 11 days in the 45 patients who did not receive it.
Kiswahili: Wagonjwa 35 huko Shenzhen walipimwa na matokeo yao yalikuwa hasi katika wastani wa siku 4, ambapo urefu wa ugonjwa ulikuwa siku 11 kwa wagonjwa 45 ambao hawakupewa dawa hiyo.

English: In a study conducted in Wuhan on 240 patients with pneumonia half were given favipiravir and half received umifenovir.
Kiswahili: Katika utafiti uliofanywa huko Wuhan kwa wagonjwa 240 wenye ugonjwa wa nimonia, nusu yao walipewa favipiravir na nusu walipewa umifenovir.
