English: The term "preclinical research" is defined by laboratory studies in vitro and in vivo, indicating a beginning stage for development of a vaccine, antiviral or monoclonal antibody therapy, such as experiments to determine effective doses and toxicity, before a candidate compound is advanced for safety and efficacy evaluation in humans.
Kiswahili: Neno "uchunguzi wa kujaribu dawa" hufafanuliwa na utafiti wa maabara katika vitro na vivo, ukionyesha hatua za mwanzo za ukuzaji wa dawa, dawa ya kuzuia virusi au kingamwili za monoklonali, kama vile majaribio ya kuamua dawa fanisi na kiwango cha sumu, kabla ya dawa iliyoteuliwa inaendelezwa kwa ajili ya thathmni ya usalama na ufanisi kwa mwanadamu.

English: In March 2020, the main protease of the SARS-CoV-2 virus was identified as a target for post-infection drugs.
Kiswahili: Mwezi wa Machi 2020, protease kuu ya virusi vya SARS-CoV-2 ilitambuliwa kama shabaha ya dawa za baada ya kuambukizwa.

English: This enzyme is essential to the host cell to reproduce the ribonucleic acid of the virus.
Kiswahili: Kimeng'enya hiki ni muhimu kwa seli enyeji ili kutoa asidi ya ribonucleic ya virusi hivyo.

English: To find the enzyme, scientists used the genome published by Chinese researchers in January 2020 to isolate the main protease.
Kiswahili: Kupata kimeng'enya hicho, wanasayansi walitumia jenomu iliyochapishwa na watafiti Wachina mnamo Januari 2020 ili kutenga protease kuu.

English: As a potential combination therapy, they are used together in two Phase III arms of the 2020 global Solidarity project on COVID-19.
Kiswahili: Kama mchanyanyiko wa tiba inayowezekana, hutumiwa pamoja katika majaibio ya Awamu ya III ya mradi wa 2020 wa Umoja wa Kimataifa kuhusu COVID-19.

English: A preliminary study in China of combined lopinavir and ritonavir found no effect in people hospitalized for COVID-19.
Kiswahili: Uchunguzi wa kujaribu dawa nchini Uchina wa mchanganyiko wa lopinavir na ritonavir, haukupara athari kwa watu waliolazwa hospitalini kwa sababu ya COVID-19.

English: b'Drug repositioning (also known as drug repurposing, re-profiling, re-tasking or therapeutic switching) is the repurposing of an approved drug for the treatment of a different disease or medical condition than that for which it was originally developed.
Kiswahili: Ubadilishaji wa dawa (pia inajulikana kama kutumia dawa vingine, kuweka umbo mpya, kusababisha kufanya kazi mpya au kubadilisha dawa) ni kutumua dawa iliyoidhinishwa vingine kwa ajili ya matibabu ya ugonjwa tofauti au hali ya matibabu badala ya kuitumia kwa sababu iliyotengenezwa hapo awali.

English: This is one line of scientific research which is currently being pursued to develop safe and effective COVID-19 treatments.
Kiswahili: Hii ni njia moja ya utafiti wa kisayansi ambayo kwa sasa inafuatiliwa kukuza matatibabu salama na fanisi ya COVID-19.

English: Other research directions include the development of a COVID-19 vaccine and convalescent plasma transfusion.SARS-CoV-2 has about 66 druggable proteins, each of which has multiple ligand binding sites.
Kiswahili: Miongozo mingine ya utafiti inajumuisha ukuzaji wa chanjo ya COVID-19 na kuchukua kinga mwili za mtu aliyepona na kuzipeleka kwa mtu mgonjwa kupitia damu. SARS-CoV-2 ina protini za dawa karibu 66, ambazo kila moja ina maeneo mengi yenye molekuli.

English: Analyzing those binding sites provide the reasonable project of developing effective antiviral drug against COVID-19 proteins.
Kiswahili: Kuchambua maeneo hayo ya kuunganisha hutoa mradi mzuri wa kutengeneza dawa bora ya kuzuia virusi itakayotoa protini za COVID-19.

English: Of the most important SARS-CoV-2 target proteins are papain-like protease, RNA dependent RNA polymerase, helicase, S protein, and ADP ribophosphatase.

Hussein A A, et al studied several candidate compounds which then optimized and analyzed for their skeleton similarity with the highest similar approved drugs in order to accelerate a potent anti-SARS-CoV-2 drug development in his preclinical study to be recommended in a clinical study design.
Kiswahili: Hussein A A, alichuguza dawa kadhaa zilizoteuliwa, kisha akaboresha na kuchambua mfanano wao na mifupa na dawa za kiwango cha juu zilizoidhinishwa ili kuharakisha maendeleo ya dawa inayowezekana ya kuzuia SARS-CoV-2 na uchunguzi wake wa dawa kupendekezwa katika muundo wa uchunguzi wa kliniki.

English: Chloroquine is an anti-malarial medication that is also used against some auto-immune diseases.
Kiswahili: Chloroquine ni dawa ya kuzuia malaria ambayo hutumika pia dhidi ya magonjwa fulani ya kingamwili kushambulia mwili kimakosa.

English: On 18 March, the WHO announced that chloroquine and the related hydroxychloroquine would be among the four drugs studied as part of the Solidarity clinical trial.
Kiswahili: Tarehe 18 Machi, WHO ilitangaza kuwa chloroquine na hydroxychloroquine husika zitakuwa kati ya dawa nne zilizochunguzwa na kuwa sehemu ya jaribio la Kliniki la Umoja.

English: New York governor Andrew Cuomo announced that New York State trials of chloroquine and hydroxychloroquine would begin on 24 March.On 28 March, the FDA authorized the use of hydroxychloroquine sulfate and chloroquine phosphate under an Emergency Use Authorization (EUA).
Kiswahili: Gavana wa New York Andrew Cuomo, alitagaza kuwa majaribio huko New York ya chloroquine na hydroxychloroquine yanaweza kuanza tarehe 24 Machi. Tarehe 28 Machi, FDA iliidhinisha matumizi ya hydroxychloroquine sulfate na chloroquine phosphate chini ya Idhini ya Matumizi ya Dharura (EUA).

English: The treatment has not been approved by the FDA's clinical trials process and is authorized under the EUA only as an experimental treatment for emergency use in patients who are hospitalized but are not able to receive treatment in a clinical trial.
Kiswahili: Matibabu hayo hayajaidhinishwa na mchakato wa majaribio ya kliniki ya FDA na yameidhinishwa chini ya EUA pekee kama matibabu ya majaribio ya matumizi ya dharura kwa wagonjwa waliolazwa hospitalini lakini hawawezi kupokea matibabu katika jaribio la kliniki.

English: The CDC has said that "the use, dosing, or duration of hydroxychloroquine for prophylaxis or treatment of SARS-CoV-2 infection" are not yet established.
Kiswahili: CDC imesema kuwa "matumizi, kipimo cha dawa, na muda wa hydrichloroquine kwa prophylaxis au matibabu ya maambukizo ya SARS-CoV-2" bado haijaanzishwa.

English: Doctors have said they are using the drug when "there's no other option".
Kiswahili: Madaktari wamesema kuwa wanatumia dawa hiyo wakati "hakuna chaguo lingine",

English: A Turkish research team in Istanbul is conducting a small study on the use of chloroquine in combination with zinc, vitamin A, vitamin C and vitamin D.
Kiswahili: Timu ya Uturuki ya utafiti huko Istabul inafanya utafiti mdogo wa matumizi ya chloroquine pamija na zinki, vitamini A, vitamini C, na vitamini D.

English: Large studies are underway at Duke University and the University of Oxford.
Kiswahili: Utafiti mkubwa unaendelea katika Chuo Kikuu cha Duke na Oxford.

English: NYU Langone Medical School is conducting a trial on the safety and efficacy of preventative use of hydroxychloroquine.
Kiswahili: Shule ya Masomo ya Matibabu ya NYU Langone inafanya majaribio ya usalama na ufanisi wa matumizi ya hydroxychloroquine.

English: 35 patients in Shenzhen tested negative in a median of 4 days, while the length of illness was 11 days in the 45 patients who did not receive it.
Kiswahili: Wagonjwa 35 huko Shenzen walipimwa na matokeo yalikuwa hasi katika wastani wa siku 4, ambapo urefu wa ugonjwa ulikuwa siku 11 kwa wagonjwa 45 ambao hawakupokea dawa hiyo.

English: The Italian Pharmaceutical Agency reminded the public that the existing evidence in support of the drug is scant and preliminary.
Kiswahili: Shirika la Dawa la Italia liliwakumbusha umma kuwa ushahidi uliopo unaounga mkono dawa hiyo ni adimu na ya awali.

English: On 2 April, Germany announced that it would purchase the drug from Japan for its stockpile, and use the military to deliver the drug to university hospitals, where the drug will be used to treat COVID-19 patients.
Kiswahili: Tarehe 2 Aprili, Ujerumani ilitangaza kuwa itanunua dawa hiyo kutoka Japani kwa akiba yake, na kutumia jeshi kupeleka dawa hiyo kwa hospitali za chuo kikuu, ambapo dawa hiyo itatumika kutibu wagonjwa wa COVID-19.

English: According to the South China Morning Post, Shinzo Abe has made overtures to the Trump administration about purchasing the drug.The drug may be less effective in severe cases of illness where the virus has already multiplied.
Kiswahili: Kulingana na South China Morning Post, Shinzo Abe amefanya mazungumzo ya awali na utawala wa Trump kuhusu kununua dawa hiyo. Dawa hiyo inaweza kuwa sio fanisi kwa ugonjwa kali ambapo virusi tayari vimeongezeka.

English: It may not be safe for use by pregnant women or those trying to conceive.
Kiswahili: Inaweza kuwa sio salama kutumiwa na wanawake wajawazito au wale wanaojaribu kupata mimba.

English: One study of lopinavir/ritonavir (Kaletra), a combination of the antivirals lopinavir and ritonavir, concluded that "no benefit was observed".
Kiswahili: Utafiti mmoja wa lopinavir/ritonavir (Kaletra), mchanganyiko wa kinga virusi vya lopinavir na ritonavir, ulihitimisha kuwa "hakuna faida ulioonekana".

English: The drugs were designed to inhibit HIV from replicating by binding to the protease.
Kiswahili: Dawa hizo zilibuniwa kuzuia HIV kutoa nakala kwa kuinganisha na protease.

English: A team of researchers at the University of Colorado are trying to modify the drugs to find a compound that will bind with the protease of SARS-CoV-2.There are criticisms within the scientific community about directing resources to repurposing drugs specifically developed for HIV/AIDS.
Kiswahili: Timu ya watafiti katika Chuo Kikuu cha Colorado wanajaribu kubadilisha dawa hiyo ili kupata chembe ambacho kitaunganisha na protease ya SARS-CoV-2. Kuna ukosoaji katika jamii ya kisayansi kuhusu kuelekeza rasimali za kubadilisha dawa zilizoundwa muhususi kutibu HIV/AIDS.

English: The WHO included lopinavir/ritonavir in the international Solidarity trial.
Kiswahili: WHO ilijumuisha lopinavir/ritonavir katika jaribio la kimataifa la Umoja.

English: Remdesivir was created and developed by Gilead Sciences as a treatment for Ebola virus disease and Marburg virus infections . Gilead Sciences subsequently discovered that Remdesivir had antiviral activity in vitro against multiple filo-, pneumo-, paramyxo-, and corona- viruses .
Kiswahili: Remdesivir iliundwa na kukuzwa na Gilead Sciences kama matibabu ya ugonjwa wa virusi vya Ebola na maambukizo ya virusi vya Marburg . Gilead Sciences baadaye iligundua kuwa Remdesivir ilikuwa na shughuli ya kuzuia virusi katika vitro dhidi ya filo-, pneumo-, paramyxo-, na virusi vya korona.

English: One issue with antiviral treatment is the development of resistance through mutations that can lead to more severe disease and transmission.
Kiswahili: Suala moja na matibabu ya kuzia virusi ni maedeleo ya upinzani kupitia mabadiliko ambayo yanaweza kusababisha ugonjwa kali na maambukizo.

English: Some early pretrial studies suggest remdesivir may have a high genetic barrier to resistance.There are several clinical trials underway, including two conducted by Cleveland University Hospitals; one for people with moderate illness and another for those with more severe illness.
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya uchunguzi wa mapema wa remdesivir unaonyesha kuwa inaweza kuwa kizuizi kikubwa cha jenitiki. Kuna majaribio kadhaa ya kliniki yanayoendelea, ikiwemo mbili yanayofanywa na Hospitali za Chuo Kikuu cha Cleveland, moja kwa ajili ya watu wenye magonjwa ya wastani na nyingine kwa watu wenye ugonjwa mkali zaidi.

English: There are three ongoing clinical trials of intravenous vitamin C for people who are hospitalized and severely ill with COVID-19; two placebo controlled (China, Canada) and one with no control (Italy).
Kiswahili: Kuna majaribio matatu ya kiliniki yanayoendelea ya vitamini C ya kupitisha mishipani kwa watu waliolazwa hospitalini na wanaugua sana ugonjwa wa COVID-19; vipozauongo viwili vilivyodhibitiwa (Uchina, Kanada) na moja kisicho dhibitiwa (Italia).

English: New York State began trials for the antibiotic azithromycin on 24 March 2020.
Kiswahili: Jimbo la New York lilianza majaribio ya kiua vijasumu cha azithromycin tarehe 24 Machi 2020.

English: Japan's National Center for Global Health and Medicine (NCGM) is planning a clinical trial for Teijin's Alvesco (ciclesonide), an inhaled corticosteroid for asthma, for the treatment of pre-symptomatic patients infected with the novel coronavirus.
Kiswahili: Kituo cha Kitaifa cha Afya na Tiba ya Jumuiya huko Japani (NCGM) inapanga jaribio la kliniki la Teijin's Alvesco (ciclesonide), corticosteroid ya kuvuta puani kwa ajili ya pumu, kwa matibabu ya wagonjwa wenye pumu walioambukizwa na virusi vipya vya korona.

English: A form of angiotensin-converting enzyme 2, a Phase II trial is underway with 200 patients to be recruited from severe, hospitalized cases in Denmark, Germany, and Austria to determine the effectiveness of the treatment.
Kiswahili: Dawa ya angiotensin-inayobadilisha kimeng'enya 2, jaribio la awamu ya II na wagonjwa 200 kuandikishwa wenye magonjwa mahututi na waliolazwa hospitalini kutoka Denmark, Ujerumani, na Austria ili kubaini ufanisi wa matibabu hayo.

English: Researchers from the Montreal Heart Institute in Canada are currently studying the role of colchicine in reducing inflammation and pulmonary complications in patients suffering from mild symptoms of COVID-19.
Kiswahili: Watafiti kutoka Taasisi ya Moyo huko Montreal kwa sasa wanachunguza jukumu la colchicine katika kupunguza uvimbe na matatizo ya mapafu kwa wagonjwa wenye dalili kazi za COVID-19.

English: The study, named COLCORONA, is recruiting 6000 adults aged 40 and over who were diagnosed with COVID-19 and experience mild symptoms not requiring hospitalization.
Kiswahili: Utafiti unaojulikana kama COLCORONA, unaandikisha watu wazima 6000 wenye unmri wa miaka 40 na zaidi ambao wamegunduliwa kuwa na ugonjwa wa COVID-19 na wanaonyesha dalili zisizo kali na hawahitaji kulazwa hospitalini.

English: Women who are pregnant or breastfeeding or who do not have an effective contraceptive method are not eligible.
Kiswahili: Wanawke ambao ni wajawazito au wananyonyesha au ambao hawana njia bora ya upangaji uzazi hawastahiki.

English: Several anticoagulants are being tested in Italy.
Kiswahili: Dawa za kuzuia kuganda zinapimwa nchini Italia.

English: Low-molecular-weight heparin is being widely used to treat patients, prompting the Italian Medicines Agency to publish guidelines on its use.
Kiswahili: Heparin yenye uzito wa chini wa molekuli inatumika sana kutibu wagonjwa, ikisababisha Shirika la Dawa huko Italia kuchapisha miongozo ya matumizi yake.

English: A multicenter study on 300 patients researching the use of enoxaparin sodium at prophylaxis and therapeutic dosages was announced in Italy on April 14.
Kiswahili: Utafiti wa vituo anuwai kwa wagonjwa 3000, unaochunguza matumizi ya enoxaparin sodium katika prophylaxis na dawa za matibbau ulitangazwa nchini Italia terehe 14 Aprili.

English: Since SARS-CoV-2 is a virus, considerable scientific attention has been focused on repurposing approved anti-viral drugs that were developed for prior outbreaks such as MERS, SARS, and West Nile virus.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa SARS-CoV-2 ni virusi, uzingatifu mkubwa wa kisayansi umejikita kurudisha dawa za kuzuia virusi ambazo zilikuwa zimetengenezwa kwa ajili ya milipuko ya awali kama vile virusi vya MERS, SARS, na West Nile.

English: Ribavirin: ribavirin was recommended for COVID-19 treatment according to Chinese 7th edition guidelines
Kiswahili: Ribavirin: ribavirin ilipendekezwa kwa matibabu ya COVID-19 kulingana na miongozo ya toleo la 7 la Uchina

English: Umifenovir: umifenovir was recommended for COVID-19 treatment according to Chinese 7th edition guidelines
Kiswahili: Umifenovir: umifenovir ilipendekezwa kwa matibabu ya COVID-19 kulingana na miongozo ya toleo la 7 la Uchina

English: Tocilizumab (Anti-IL-6 receptor): Approved by China.
Kiswahili: Tocilizumab (Kipokezi cha anti-IL-6): Imeidhinishwa nchini Uchina.

English: Also trials in Italy and China. and see Tocilizumab#COVID-19.
Kiswahili: Pia vipimo huko Italia na Uchina. na angaliaTocilizumab#COVID-19.

English: It is unclear yet whether conditions arising during pregnancy including diabetes, cardiac failure, hypercoagulability or hypertension might represent additional risk factors for pregnant people as they do for nonpregnant people.From the limited data available, vertical transmission during the third trimester probably does not occur, or only occurs very rarely.
Kiswahili: Haijulikani wazi ikiwa hali zinazotokea wakati wa ujauzito ikiwemo ugonjwa wa kisukari, matatizo ya moyo, shinikizo la juu la damu zinaweza kuwakilisha sababu za hatari kwa watu wajawazito kama zinavyofanya kwa watu wasio wajawazito. Kutoka wa data ndogo inayopatika, labda maambukizo ya ugonjwa hautatokea kwa mtoto wakati wa miezi mitatu ya mwisho, au hutokea mara chache sana.

English: There is no data yet on early pregnancy.
Kiswahili: Bado hakuna data ya ujauzito wa mapema.

English: Little evidence exists to permit any solid conclusions about the nature of COVID-19 infection in pregnancy.
Kiswahili: Ushahidi mdogo upo wa kudhibitisha hitimisho lolote dhabiti kuhusu asili ya maambukizo ya COVID-19 katika ujauzito.

English: A case series of 43 women from New York who tested positive for COVID-19 showed similar patterns to non-pregnant adults: 86% had mild disease, 9.3% had severe disease and 4.7% developed critical disease.
Kiswahili: Mfululizo wa visa vya wanawake 43 kutoka New York ambao walipatikana kuwa na COVID-19 ulionyesha hali kama hiyo kwa watu wazima wasio wajawazito: asilimia 86 walikuwa na ugonjwa usio mkali, asilimia 9.3 walikuwa na ugonjwa kali na asilimia 4.7 walikuwa na ugonjwa ya hali mahututi.

English: Fetal distress was reported in two.
Kiswahili: Watu wawili walipatikana kuwa na matatizo kwenye kijusi.

English: None of the women developed severe COVID-19 pneumonia or died.
Kiswahili: Hakuna wanawake walipatikana kuwa nimonia kali ya COVID-19 au kufa.

English: All of them had live birth pregnancies and no severe neonatal asphyxia was observed.
Kiswahili: Wote walikuwa na ujauzito mzuri na hakuna hali ya mtoto kukosa oksijeni ulionekana.

English: The samples of breast milk, amniotic fluid, cord blood and neonatal throat swab were tested for SARS-CoV-2, and all results were negative.In another study on 15 pregnant women, majority of the patients presented with fever and cough, while laboratory tests yielded lymphocytopenia in 12 patients.
Kiswahili: Sampuli za maziwa ya matiti, maji ya mimba, damu ya ugwe na maambukizo kwenye koo zilipimwa SARS-CoV-2, na matokeo yote yalikuwa hasi. Katika utafiti mwingine wa wanawake 15 wajawazito, wagonjwa wengine walionyesha homa na kukohoa, na vipimo vya maabara vilionyesha lympocytopenia kwa wagonjwa 12.

English: Computed tomography findings of these patients were consistent with previous reports of non-pregnant patients, consisting of ground-glass opacities at early stage.
Kiswahili: Matokeo ya eksrei kwa kutumia kompyuta ya wagonjwa hawa yalikuwa sawa na ripoti za awali kutoka kwa wagonjwa wasio wajawazito, yanayojumuisha matokeo ya rediolojia katika hatua za kwanza.

English: Follow-up images after delivery showed no progression of pneumonia.Media reports indicate that over 100 women with COVID-19 might have delivered, and in March 2020, no maternal deaths were reported.
Kiswahili: Picha za kufuatia baada ya kujifungua haukuonyesha maendeleo ya nimonia. Ripoti za vyombo za habari zinaonyesha kuwa zaidi ya wanawake 100 wenye COVID-19 wanaweza kuwa wamejifungua, na mnamo Machi 2020, hakuna vifo vya akina mama walioripotiwa.

English: Their guidelines thus advise that any pregnant person admitted to hospital with a COVID-19 infection should receive at least 10 days of prophylactic low-molecular-weight heparin after being discharged from the hospital.
Kiswahili: Kwa hivyo miongozo yao inashauri kuwa mtu yeyote ambaye ni mjamzito alliyelazwa hospitalini kwa sababu ya maambukizo ya COVID-19 anapaswa kupewa heparin yenye uzito wa chini wa molekuli kwa siku 10 baada ya kutolewa hospitalini.

English: There are no data yet concerning the implications of COVID-19 infections for labour.
Kiswahili: Bado hakuna data inayohusiana na matatizo ya maambukizo ya COVID-19 kwa uchungu wa uzazi.

English: One infant girl born to a mother with COVID-19 had elevated IgM levels two hours after birth, suggesting that she had been infected in utero and supporting the possibility of vertical transmission in some cases.
Kiswahili: Msichana mmoja mchanga aliyezaliwa na mama mwenye COVID-19 alikuwa na viwango vya juu vya IgM saa mbili baada ya kuzaliwa, na kupendekeza kuwa alikuwa ameambukizwa kwenye tumbo la uzazi na kuonyesha uwezekano wa maambukizo ya ugonjwa kwa mtoto katika baadhi ya visa.

English: A small study involving 6 confirmed COVID-19 mothers showed no indication of SARS-COV-19 in their newborns' throats or serum but antibodies were present in neonatal blood sera samples, including IgM in two of the infants.
Kiswahili: Utafiti mdogo unaohusisha mama 6 waliodhibitishwa kuwa na COVID-19 hawakuonyesha ishara yoyote ya SARS-COV-19 katika koo au damu ya watoto wao wachanga lakini kingamwili ilikuwepo katika sampuli za damu ya watato wachanga hao, ikiwemo IgM katika watoto wawili wachanga kati yao.

English: This is not usually passed from mother to fetus so further research is required to know whether the virus crossed the placenta or whether placentas of women in the study were damaged or abnormal.
Kiswahili: Kwa kawaida hii haipitishwi kutoka kwa mama kwenda kwa kijusi kwa hivyo uchunguzi zaidi unahitajika kujua ikiwa virusi hivyo vilipitia kwenye kondo au ikiwa kondo ya wanawake kwenye utafiti ilikuwa imeharibiwa au isiyo ya kawaida.

English: Since COVID-19 shows similarities to SARS-CoV and MERS-CoV, it is likely that their effect on pregnancy are similar.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa COVID-19 inaonyesha mfanano wa SARS-CoV na MERS-CoV, kuna uwezekano kuwa athari zao kwa ujauzito ni sawia.

English: Four of seven had first trimester miscarriage, two of five had fetal growth restriction in the second trimester, and four of five had preterm birth.
Kiswahili: Watu wanne kati ya saba, mimba yao iliharibika katika miezi mitatu ya kwanza, wawili kati ya tano walikuwa na kizuizi cha ukuaji wa kijusi katika miezi mitatu ya pili na wanne kati ya tano walizaa kabla ya wakati kufika.

English: None of the newborns were infected with SARS-CoV.
Kiswahili: Hakuna watoto wachanga waliozaliwa waliambukizwa na SARS-CoV.

English: A report of ten cases of MERS- CoV infection in pregnancy in Saudi Arabia showed that the clinical presentation is variable, from mild to severe infection.
Kiswahili: Ripoti ya visa kumi ya maambukizo ya MERS- Cov wakati wa ujauzito nchini Saudia Arabia ilionyesha kuwa uwasilishaji wa kiliniki unatofautiana, kutoka kwa maambukizo isiyo kali hadi kali.

English: The outcome was favorable in a majority of the cases, but the infant death rate was 27%.A recent review suggested that COVID-19 appeared to be less lethal to mothers and infants than SARS and MERS but that there may be an increased risk of preterm birth after 28 weeks' gestation.
Kiswahili: Matokeo yalikuwa mazuri katika visa vingi, lakini kiwango cha vifo vya watoto wachanga kilikuwa asilimia 27. Ukaguzi wa hivi karibuni ulionyesha kuwa COVID-19 ilionekana kuwa hasababishi vifo sana kwa mama na watoto wachanga kuliko SARS na MERS, lakini kunaweza kuwa na hatari iliyoongezeka kwa watoto waliozaliwa kabla ya wakati baada ya ujauzito wa wiki 28.

English: The World Health Organization and Centers for Disease Control and Prevention of the United States advises pregnant women to do the same things as the general public to avoid infection, such as covering cough, avoid interacting with sick people, cleaning hands with soap and water or sanitizer.
Kiswahili: Shirika la Afya Duniani na Vituo vya Kudhibiti na Kuzuia Ugonjwa huko Marekani hushauri wanawake wajawazito kufanya mambo sawa kama umma kwa ujumla ili kuzuia maambukizo, kama vile kujifuka ukikohoa, kuepuka kutangamana na watu wagonjwa, kusafisha mikono kwa kutumia sabuni na maji au kisafisha mikono chenye kileo cha kuua viini.

English: A survey conducted in Shanghai among pregnant women in different trimesters of pregnancy identified a strong demand for online access to health information and services.
Kiswahili: Utafiti uliofanywa huko Shangai wa wanawake wajawazito katika miezi tofauti ya ujauzito ulibaini hitaji kubwa la ufikiaji wa mtandaoni wa maelezo na huduma za afya.

English: People expecting their first baby were more willing to have online consultation and guidance than who had previously given birth.The RCOG and RCM recommend that in-person appointments be deferred by 7 days after the start of symptoms of COVID-19 or 14 days if another person in the household has symptoms.
Kiswahili: Watu wanaotarajia mtoto wao wa kwanza walikuwa tayari zaidi kupata ushari na mwongozo mtandaoni kuliko wale waliozaa hapo awali. RCOG na RCM inapendekeza kuwa miadi ya ana kwa ana upunguzwe kuwa siku 7 baada ya dalili za COVID-19 kuonekana au siku 14 ikiwa mtu mwingine katika kaya anaonyesha dalili.

English: Fever subsequently developed in three asymptomatic patients.
Kiswahili: Homa baadaye ilionekana kwa wagonjwa watatu wasioonyesha dalili.

English: One patient who had tested negative subsequently became symptomatic postpartum and tested positive three days after the initial negative test.
Kiswahili: Mgonjwa mmoja ambaye alikuwa amepimwa na matokeo yalikuwa hasi baadaye alionyesha dalili baada ya kujifungua na matokeo ya vipimo yalikuwa chanya siku tatu baada ya matokeo hasi ya kwanza.

English: The doctors conducting the screening recommended that in order to reduce infection and allocate PPE, due to high numbers of patients presenting as asymptomatic, universal screening of pregnant patients should be conducted.
Kiswahili: Madaktari wanaofanya uchunguzi huo walipendekeza kuwa, ili kupunguza maambukizo na kutenga PPE, kwa sababu ya idadi kubwa ya wagonjwa wasioonyesha ugonjwa, uchunguzi wa wagonjwa wote wajawazito unapaswa kufanywa.

English: They also suggest that people with suspected or confirmed COVID-19 should have continuous electronic fetal monitoring.
Kiswahili: Pia wanapendekeza kwamba watu wanaoshukiwa au wamedhibitishwa kuwa na ugonjwa wa COVID-19 wanapaswa kuendelea na uchunguzi wa kijusi kielekroniki.

English: The use of birthing pools is not recommended for suspected or confirmed cases of COVID-19 due to the risk of infection via faeces.
Kiswahili: Haipendekezwi kutumia mabwawa ya kuzaa kwa watu wanaoshukiwa au waliodhibitishwa kuwa na ugonjwa wa COVID-19 kwa sababu ya hatari ya kuambukiza kupitia kinyesi.

English: In the UK, official recommendations state that precautionary separation of a mother and a healthy baby should not be undertaken lightly and that they should be kept together in the postpartum period where neonatal care is not required.Literature from China recommended separation of infected mothers from babies for 14 days.
Kiswahili: Nchini Uingereza, mapendekezo rasmi yanasema kuwa utengano wa tahadhari wa mama na mtoto mwenye afya haupaswi kufanywa kwa urahisi na wanapaswa kuwekwa pamoja katiki kipindi cha baada ya kujifungua ambapo utuzaji wa mtoto aliyezaliwa hauhitajiki. Mwandishi kutoka Uchina alipendekeza mama walioambukizwa kutenganishwa na watoto kwa siku 14.

English: In the US there is also the recommendation that newborns and mothers should be temporarily separated until transmission-based precautions are discontinued, and that where this is not possible the newborn should be kept 2 metres away from the mother.
Kiswahili: Huko Marekani bado kuna pendekezo kuwa watoto wachanga na mama watenganishwe kwa muda hadi tahadhari zinazotegemea maambukizo zimekomeshwa, na ambapo hii haiwezekani, mtoto mchanga anapaswa kuweka umbali wa mita 2 kutoka kwa mama.

English: b'COVID-19 surveillance involves monitoring the spread of the coronavirus disease in order to establish the patterns of disease progression.
Kiswahili: Uchunguzi wa b'COVID-19 unajumuisha kufuatilia ugonjwa kuenea ili kuweka mifumo ya maendeleo ya ugonjwa huo.

English: The World Health Organization (WHO) recommends active surveillance, with focus of case finding, testing and contact tracing in all transmission scenarios.
Kiswahili: Shirika la Afya Duniani (WHO) linapendekeza uchunguzi amilifu, ukizingatia utafutaji wa kisa, upimaji na utafutaji wa utangamano katika hali zote za maambukizo.

English: COVID-19 surveillance is expected to monitor epidemiological trends, rapidly detect new cases, and based on this information, provide epidemiological information to conduct risk assessment and guide disease preparedness.
Kiswahili: Uchunguzi wa COVID-19 unatarajiwa kufuatilia mitindo ya ugonjwa, kugundua haraka visa vipya, na kulingana na maelezo haya, kutoa maelezo ya ugonjwa ili kufanya utathmini wa hatari na kutoa mwongozo wa utayarishaji wa magonjwa.

English: Syndromic surveillance is done based on the symptoms of an individual that corresponds to COVID-19.
Kiswahili: Uchunguzi wa dalili za ugonjwa hufanyika kulingana na dalili za mtu binafsi ambazo zinalingana na COVID-19.

English: Probable case : "A suspect case for whom testing for the COVID-19 virus is inconclusive" OR "a suspect case for whom testing could not be performed for any reason".
Kiswahili: Kisa kinachowezekana: "Mtu anayeshukiwa ambaye upimaji wa virusi vya COVID-19 haujakamilika" AU " mtu anayeshukiwa ambaye hangeweza kufanyiwa upimaji kwa sababu yeyote".

English: Confirmed case: "A person with laboratory confirmation of COVID-19 infection, irrespective of clinical signs and symptoms".
Kiswahili: Kisa kilichodhibitishwa: "Mtu mwenye uthibitisho wa maabara ya maambukizo ya COVID-19, bila kujali ishara na dalili za kliniki".

English: Direct physical contact with a probable or confirmed case;
Kiswahili: Utangamano wa kimwili wa moja kwa moja na mtu anayeshukuwa au aliyedhibitishwa;

English: Direct care for a patient with probable or confirmed COVID-19 disease without using proper personal protective equipment;
Kiswahili: Utunzaji wa moja kwa moja bila kutumia vizuri vifaa sahihi vya kujikinga na mgonjwa anayeshukiwa au amedhibitishwa kuwa na ugonjwa wa COVID-19;

English: Other situations as indicated by local risk assessments".WHO recommends reporting of probable and confirmed cases of COVID-19 infection within 48 hours of identification.
Kiswahili: Hali zingine kama ilivyoonyeshwa na tathmini za hatari za ndani". WHO inapendekeza kuripoti watu wanaoshukuwa au wamedhibitishwa kuwa na maambukizo ya COVID-19 ndani ya saa 48 baada ya utambuzi.

English: The countries should report on a case-by-case basis as far as possible, but in case of limitation in resources, aggregate weekly reporting is also possible.
Kiswahili: Nchi zinapaswa kuripoti kwa msingi wa tukio-kwa-tukio iwezekanavyo, lakini ikiwa kuna upungufu wa rasilimali, ripoti ya jumla ya kila wiki inawezekana pia.

English: Some organizations have created crowdsourced apps for syndromic surveillance, where people can report their symptoms to help researchers map areas with concentration of COVID-19 symptoms.
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya mashirika wameunda programu ya ukusanyaji wa maelezo ya uchunguzi wa dalili, ambapo watu wanaweza kuripoti dalili zao ili kuwasaidia watafiti kualamisha maeneo yenye idadi kubwa ya dalili za COVID-19.

English: Virological surveillance is done by using molecular tests for COVID-19.
Kiswahili: Uchunguzi wa kivirolojia hufanywa kwa kutumia vipimo vya molekuli kwa COVID-19.

English: WHO has published resources for laboratories on how to perform testing for COVID-19.
Kiswahili: WHO imetoa rasilimali za maabara za jinsi ya kupima COVID-19.

English: In the European Union, laboratory confirmed cases of COVID-19 are reported within 24 hours of identification.
Kiswahili: Nchini Ulaya, visa vya COVID-19 vilivyodhibitishwa na maabra huripotiwa ndani ya saa 24 baada ya kutambuliwa.

English: At least 24 countries have established digital surveillance of their citizens.
Kiswahili: Angalau nchi 24 zimeanzisha uchunguzi wa kidijitali wa raia wao.

English: The digital surveillance technologies include apps, location data and electronic tags.
Kiswahili: Teknolojia za uchunguzi wa kidijitali zinajumuisha pogramu, data ya eneo na vitambulisho vya kielekroniki.

English: The Center For Disease Control and Prevention in USA tracks the travel information of individuals using airline passenger data.
Kiswahili: Kituo cha Udhbiti na Uzuizi wa Ugonjwa huko Marekani hufuatilia maelezo ya usafiri wa watu wanaotuma data za abiria wa ndege.

English: In Hong Kong, authorities are requiring a bracelet and an app for all travellers.
Kiswahili: Huko Hong Kong, mamlaka zinataka watu wawe na bangili na programu ya simu kwa wote wanaosafiri.

English: A GPS app is used to track the locations of individuals in South Korea to ensure against quarantine breach, sending alerts to the user and to authorities if people leave designated areas.
Kiswahili: Programu ya GPS hutumika kufuatilia maeneo ya watu huko Korea Kusini ili kuhakikisha hakuna kutoka karantini, kutuma arifa kwa mtumiaji na mamlaka ikiwa watu watatoka kwenye maeneo waliowekwa.

English: In Singapore, individuals have to report their locations with photographic proof.
Kiswahili: Huko Singapoo, lazima watu waripoti mahali walipo na ushahidi wa picha.

English: Thailand is using an app and SIM cards for all travelers to enforce their quarantine.
Kiswahili: Nchini Thailand inatumia programy na SIM kadi kwa wasafiri wote ili kutekeleza muda wao wa karantini.

English: Human rights organizations have criticized some of these measures, asking the governments not to use the pandemic as a cover to introduce invasive digital surveillance.
Kiswahili: Mashirika ya haki za kibinadamu yamekosoa baadhi ya hatu hizo, yakiwauliza serikali isitumie ugonjwa huo kama kisetiri cha kuanzisha uchunguzi wa kuingilia kwa njia ya kidijitali.

English: b'A COVID-19 vaccine is a hypothetical vaccine against coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19).
Kiswahili: Chanjo ya b'A COVID-19 ni chanjo ya kubuni ya kuzuia ugonjwa wa virusi vya korona 2019 (COVID-19).

English: Although no vaccine has completed clinical trials, there are multiple attempts in progress to develop such a vaccine.
Kiswahili: Ingawa hakuna chajo iliyokamilisha majaribio ya kliniki, kuna majaribio kadhaa yanayoendelea ya kuunda chanjo hiyo.

English: In late February 2020, the World Health Organization (WHO) said it did not expect a vaccine against SARS-CoV-2, the causative virus, to become available in less than 18 months.
Kiswahili: Mwisho wa Februari 2020, Shirika la Afya Duniani (WHO) lilisema kuwa halikutarajia chanjo ya kuzuia SARS-CoV-2, virusi vinavyosababisha ugonjwa huo, kupatikana katika kipindi kisichozidi miezi 18.

English: Five vaccine candidates were in Phase I safety studies in April.
Kiswahili: Chanjo tano zilizoteuliwa zilikuwa katika utafiti wa usalami wa Awamu ya I mwezi wa Aprili.

English: COVID-19 was identified in December 2019.
Kiswahili: COVID-19 ilitambuliwa mwezi wa Desemba 2019.

English: A major outbreak spread around the world in 2020, leading to considerable investment and research activity to develop a vaccine.
Kiswahili: Mlipuko mkubwa ulioenea duniani kote mwaka wa 2020, na kusababisha uwekezaji mkubwa na shughuli za utafiti wa kutengeneza chanjo.

English: Many organizations are using published genomes to develop possible vaccines against SARS-CoV-2.
Kiswahili: Mashirika mengi yanatumia jenomu zilizochapishwa kutengeneza chanjo zinazowezekana za kuzuia SARS-CoV-2.

English: Stated in April, imperatives of the CEPI initiative for vaccine development are speed, manufacturing capacity, deployment at scale, and global access.
Kiswahili: Ilivyotajwa mwezi wa Aprili, mahitaji ya mpango wa CEPI kwa maendeleo ya chanjo ni kasi, uwezo wa utengenezaji, matumizi ya kiwango, na ufikiaji duniani.

English: In April, CEPI scientists reported that 10 different technology platforms were under research and development during early 2020 to create an effective vaccine against COVID-19.
Kiswahili: Mnamo Aprili, wanasayansi wa CEPI waliripoti kuwa majukwaa 10 tofauti ya teknolojia yalikuwa yanafanyiwa utafiti na maendeleo mwanzoni mwa mwaka wa 2020 ili kuunda chanjo inayofaa ya kuzuia COVID-19.

English: nucleic acid (DNA and RNA) (Phase I developer and vaccine candidate: Moderna, mRNA-1273)
Kiswahili: asidi za kiini cha chembe (DNA na RNA) (Mkuzaji wa awamu ya I na chanjo kilichoteuliwa: Moderna, mRNA-1273)

English: viral vector (Phase I developer and vaccine candidate: CanSino Biologics, adenovirus type 5 vector)
Kiswahili: zana za kuchunguza virusi (Mwendelezaji wa awamu ya I na chajo kilichoteuliwa: CanSino Biologics, virusi vya adeno vya vekta ya aina ya 5).

English: As reported by CEPI scientists in April, 115 total vaccine candidates are in early stages of development, with 78 confirmed as active projects (79, according to the Milken Institute), and 37 others announced, but with little public information available (presumed to be in planning or being designed).
Kiswahili: Kama ilivyoripotiwa na wanasayansi wa CEPI mnamo Aprili, jumla ya chanjo 115 zilizoteuliwa zinafanyiwa maendeleo ya hatua za mwanzo, huku 78 zikithibitishwa kama miradi inayoendelea (79, kulingana na Taasisi ya Milken), na zingine 37 zimetangazwa, lakini kwa maelezo chache yanayopatikana kwa umma (zinadhaniwa kuwa zinapangwa au zinaundwa).

English: A Phase I-II trial conducts preliminary safety and immunogenicity testing, is typically randomized, placebo-controlled, and at multiple sites, while determining more precise, effective doses.
Kiswahili: Jaribio la Awamu ya I-II inaendesha jaribio ya awali ya usalama na imunogenisiti, kikawaida halifuati utaratibu maalum, hudhibitiwa kupitia placebo na katika maeneo anuwai, huku likibaini dozi sahihi zaidi na faafu.

English: Phase III trials typically involve more participants, including a control group, and test effectiveness of the vaccine to prevent the disease, while monitoring for adverse effects at the optimal dose.
Kiswahili: Kwa kawaida majaribio ya awamu ya III yanahusisha washiriki zaidi, ikiwemo kikundi cha kudhbiti, na kupima ufanisi wa chanjo ya kuzuia ugonjwa huo, wakati ikifuatilia athari mbaya kwa kipimo bora kabisa.

English: Of 79 vaccine candidates in active development (confirmed as of early April 2020), 74 were not yet in human evaluation (still in "preclinical" research).
Kiswahili: Kati ya chanjo 79 zilizoteuliwa zinazofanyiwa maendeleo (zilizothibitishwa mwanzo wa mwezi wa Aprili), chanjo 79 hazikuwa zimetathmniwa kwa mwanadamu (bado katika utafiti "kabla ya upimaji wa kliniki").

English: Around 24 January 2020 in Australia, the University of Queensland announced that it is investigating the potential of a molecular clamp vaccine that would genetically modify viral proteins in order to stimulate an immune reaction.
Kiswahili: Mnamo 24 Januari 2020 nchini Australia, Chuo Kikuu cha Queensland kilitangaza kwamba kinafanya uchunguzi wa uwezekano wa chanjo ya kunata molekuli inayoweza kubadilisha kijenetiki protini za virusi ili kuchochea kinga ya mwili.

English: Around 24 January 2020 in Canada, the International Vaccine Centre (VIDO-InterVac) at the University of Saskatchewan announced the commencement of work on a vaccine, aiming to start human testing in 2021.
Kiswahili: Tarehe 24 Januari 2020 nchini Kanada, Kituo cha Kimataifa cha Chanjo (VIDO-InterVac) katika Chuo Kikuu cha Saskatchewan kilitanganza kuanza kushughulikia chanjo, kikilenga kuanza upimaji kwa mwadamu mnamo 2021.

English: Vaccine development projects were announced at the Chinese Center for Disease Control and Prevention on 26 January 2020, and the University of Hong Kong on 28 January.
Kiswahili: Miradi ya maendeleo ya chanjo ilitangazwa katika Kituo cha Uchina cha Kudhibiti na Kuzuia Ugonjwa tarehe 26 Januari 2929, na Chuo Kikuu cha Hong Kong tarehe 28 Januari.

English: Around 29 January 2020, Janssen Pharmaceutical Companies, led by Hanneke Schuitemaker, announced that it had begun work on developing a vaccine.
Kiswahili: Tarehe 29, Januari 2020, Janssen Pharmaceutical Companies, wakiongozwa na Hanneke Schuitemaker, walitangaza kuwa walianza kushughulikia kutengeneza chanjo.

English: Janssen is co-developing an oral vaccine with its biotechnology partner, Vaxart.
Kiswahili: Janssen inakuza chanjo kwa kushirikiana na washirika wake wa bioteknolojia, Vaxart.

English: On 18 March 2020, Emergent BioSolutions announced a manufacturing partnership with Vaxart to develop the vaccine.
Kiswahili: Tarehe 18 Machi 2020, Emergent BioSolutions ilitangaza ushirikiano wa utengenezaji na Vaxart ili kukuza chanjo hiyo.

English: On 8 February 2020, the laboratory OncoGen in Romania published a paper on the design of a vaccine with similar technology to the one used for cancer neoantigen vaccination therapy.
Kiswahili: Tarehe 8 Februari 2020, maabara ya OncoGen kuko Romania ilichapisha karatasi ya muundo wa chanjo na teknolojia sawa na ile iliyotumika kwa tiba ya chanjo cha neoantigen.

English: On 25 March the head of the research institute announced that they had finalized the synthesis of the vaccine and were beginning the tests.
Kiswahili: Tarehe 25 Machi, mkuu wa taasisi ya utafiti alitangaza kuwa wamekamilisha mchanyanyiko wa chanjo na walikuwa wanaanza vipimo.

English: On 27 February 2020, a Generex subsidiary company, NuGenerex Immuno-Oncology, announced they were beginning a vaccine project to create an Ii-Key peptide vaccine against COVID-19.
Kiswahili: Tarehe 27 Februari 2020, kampuni tanzu ya Generex, NuGenerex Immuno-Oncology, ilitangaza kuwa walikuwa wanaanza mradi wa chanjo wa kuunda chanjo ya Ii-Key peptide ya kuzuia COVID-19.

English: They wanted to produce a vaccine candidate that could be tested in humans "within 90 days."
Kiswahili: Walitaka kutoa chanjo itakayoteuliwa ambayo ingeweza kupimwa kwa wanadamu "katika kipindi cha siku 90."

English: On 5 March 2020, Washington University in St. Louis announced its projects to develop a vaccine.
Kiswahili: Tarehe 5 Machi 2020, Chuo Kikuu cha St. Louis huko Washington kilitangaza miradi yake ya kukuza chanjo.

English: On 5 March 2020, the United States Army Medical Research and Materiel Command at Fort Detrick and the Walter Reed Army Institute of Research in Silver Spring, both in western Maryland, announced they were working on a vaccine.
Kiswahili: Tarehe 5 Machi 2020, Jeshi la Marekani la Utafiti wa Matibabu na Jeshi la Materiel huko Fort Detrick na Taasisi ya Utafiti ya Jeshi la Walter Reed huko in Silver Spring, yote magharibi mwa Maryland, walitangaza kuwa wanashughulikia chanjo.

English: Around 10 March 2020, Emergent Biosolutions announced that it had teamed with Novavax Inc.
Kiswahili: Tarehe 10 Machi 2020, Emergent Biosolutions ilitangaza kuwa wameshirikiana na Novavax Inc.

English: in the development and manufacture of a vaccine.
Kiswahili: kukuza na kutengeneza chanjo.

English: The partners further announced plans for preclinical testing and a Phase I clinical trial by July 2020.
Kiswahili: Washirika hao walitangaza zaidi mipango ya vipimo vya kiliniki kwa wanyama na Awamu ya 1 ya kipimo cha kipimo kabla ya Julai 2020.

English: On 12 March 2020, India's Health Ministry announced they are working with 11 isolates, and that even on a fast track it would take at least around one-and-a-half to two years to develop a vaccine.
Kiswahili: Tarehe 12 Machi 2020, Wizara ya Afya ya India ilitangaza kuwa wanafanya kazi na watu 11 waliojitenga, na kwamba hata wakifuatilia haraka itachukua angalau muda wa mwaka mmoja na nusu hadi miaka mbili kutengeneza chanjo.

English: On 12 March 2020, Medicago, a biotechnology company in Quebec City, Quebec, reported development of a coronavirus-like particle under partial funding from the Canadian Institutes for Health Research.
Kiswahili: Tarehe 12 Machi 2020, Medicago, kampuni ya bioteknolojia katika Jiji la Quebec, iliripoti maendeleo ya chembe kama ya virusi vya korona chini ya ufadhili wa sehemi kutoka kwa Taasisi za Kanada za Utafiti wa Afya.

English: The vaccine candidate is in laboratory research, with human testing planned for July or August 2020.
Kiswahili: Mtahiniwa wa chanjo ako katika utafiti wa maabara, na mpango wa kupima mwanadamu umepangwa mwezi wa Julai au Agosti 2020.

English: Earlier that week, The Guardian reported that the US President Donald Trump had offered CureVac "'large sums of money' for exclusive access to a Covid-19 vaccine", against which the German government protested.
Kiswahili: Mapema wiki hiyo, The Guardian iliripoti kwamba Rais wa Marekani Donald Trumo alitoa CureVac, "kiwango kikubwa cha fedha kwa ajili ya ufikiaji wa kipekee wa chanjo ya Covid-19", ambayo serikali ya Ujerumani ilipinga.

English: On 17 March 2020, American pharmaceutical company Pfizer announced a partnership with German company BioNTech to jointly develop a mRNA-based vaccine.
Kiswahili: Tarehe 17 Machi 2020, Kampuni ya Marekani ya Bidhaa za famasia Pfizer ilitangaza ushirikiano na kampuni ya Ujerumani ya BioNTech ili kwa pamoja kuunda chanjo inayotegemea mRNA.

English: mRNA-based vaccine candidate BNT162, currently in pre-clinical testing with clinical trials expected to begin in April 2020.
Kiswahili: Chanjo iliyoteuliwa inayotegeme mRNA, BN162, kwa sasa inapimwa kwa wanyama na vipimo hivyo vya kliniki vinatarajiwa kuanza mwezi wa Aprili 2020.

English: In Italy on 17 March 2020, Takis Biotech, an Italian biotech company announced they will have pre-clinical testing results in April 2020 and their final vaccine candidate could begin human testing by fall.
Kiswahili: Huko Italia tarehe 17 Machi 2020, Takis Biotech, kampuni ya bioteknolojia ya Italia ilitangaza kuwa watakuwa na matokeo vipimo kwa wanyama mwezi wa Aprili 2020 na chanjo ya mwisho iliyoteuliwa inaweza kuanza kufanyiwa vipimo wakati wa majira ya kupuputika kwa majani.

English: In France on 19 March 2020, the Coalition for Epidemic Preparedness Innovations (CEPI) announced a US$4.9 million investment in a COVID-19 vaccine research consortium involving the Institut Pasteur, Themis Bioscience (Vienna, Austria), and the University of Pittsburgh, bringing CEPI's total investment in COVID-19 vaccine development to US$29 million.
Kiswahili: Huko Ufaransa tarehe 19 Machi 2020, Mseto wa Uvumbuzi wa Matayarisho ya Magonjwa ya Mlipuko (CEPI) ulitangaza uwekezaji wa dola milioni 4.9 katika ubia wa utafiti wa chanjo ya COVID-19 unaohusisha Taasisi ya Pasteur, Themis Biosciece (Vienna, Austria), na Chuo Kikuu cha Pittsburgh, na kuleta uwekezaji wa jumla wa CEPI wa maendeleo ya chanjo ya COVID-19 kuwa dola milioni 29.

English: CEPI's other investment partners for COVID-19 vaccine development are Moderna, Curevac, Inovio, Novavax, the University of Hong Kong, the University of Oxford, and the University of Queensland.
Kiswahili: Washirika wengine wa uwekezaji wa CEPI kwa ajili ya maendeleo ya chanjo ya COVID-19 ni Modema, Curevac, Inovio, Novavax, Chuo Kikuu cha Hong Kong, Chuo Kikuu cha Oxford, Chuo Kikuu cha Queensland.

English: On 20 March 2020, Russian health officials announced that scientists have begun animal testing of six different vaccine candidates.
Kiswahili: Tarehe 20 Machi 2020, maafisa wa afya wa Urusi walitangaza kuwa wanasayansi wameanza upimaji wa wanyama kwa kutumia chanjo sita zilizoteuliwa.

English: Imperial College London researchers announced on 20 March 2020 that they are developing a self-amplifying RNA vaccine for COVID-19.
Kiswahili: Watafiti wa chuo cha Imperial huko London walitangaza mnamo tarehe 20 Machi 2020 kuwa wanakuza chanjo cha RNA yenye nguvu zaidi kwa ajili ya COVID-19.

English: The vaccine candidate was developed within 14 days of receiving the sequence from China.
Kiswahili: Chanjo iliyoteuliwa iliandaliwa ndani ya siku 14 za kupokea utaratibu kutoka nchi ya Uchina.

English: In late March, the Canadian government announced C$275 million in funding for 96 research projects on medical countermeasures against COVID-19, including numerous vaccine candidates at Canadian companies and universities, such as the Medicago and University of Saskatchewan initiatives.
Kiswahili: Mwisho wa mwezi wa Machi, serikali ya Kanada ilitangaza dola milioni 275 ya kufadhili miradi 96 ya utafiti wa upimaji wa matibabu dhidi ya COVID-19, ikiwemo chanjo kadhaa zilizoteuliwa katika kampuni na vyuo vikuu vya Kanada, kama vile mipango ya Medicago na Chuo Kikuu cha Saskatchewan.

English: Around the same time, the Canadian government announced C$192 million specifically for developing a COVID-19 vaccine, with plans to establish a national "vaccine bank" of several new vaccines that could be used if another coronavirus outbreak occurs.
Kiswahili: Wakati huohuo, serikali ya Kanada ilitangaza dola milioni 192 ya kukuza chanjo ya COVID-19 pekee, ikiwa na mipango ya kuanzisha "benki ya chanjo" ya kitaifa ya chanjo mpya kadhaa ambayo inaweza kutumika ikiwa mlipuko mwingine wa virusi vya korona itatokea.

English: On 2 April 2020, researchers at the University of Pittsburgh School of Medicine reported on testing of PittCoVacc, a possible COVID-19 vaccine in mice, stating that "MNA delivered SARS-CoV-2 S1 subunit vaccines elicited potent antigen-specific antibody responses [in the mice] that were evident beginning 2 weeks after immunization."
Kiswahili: Tarehe 2 Aprili 2020, watafiti wa Chuo Kikuu cha Pittsburgh cha Shule ya Tiba iliripoti kupima PittCoVacc, chanjo inayowezekana ya COVID-19 katika panya, ikisema kuwa "MNA ilitoa chanjo ndogo za SARS-CoV-2 S1 ilishawishi antijeni yenye nguvu-majibu maalum ya kingamwili [ndani ya panya] ambayo yalionekana wazo kuanzia wiki 2 baada ya chanjo."

English: In Canada on 16 April 2020, the University of Waterloo School of Pharmacy announced design of a DNA-based vaccine candidate as a possible nasal spray.
Kiswahili: Huko Kanada tarehe 16 Aprili 2020, Chuo Kikuu cha Waterloo cha Shule ya Kusomea Dawa ilitangaza muundo wa chanjo iliyoteuliwa inayotegemea DNA kama dawa ya kinyunyizio cha pua inayowezekana.

English: Using bacteriophages, the DNA will be designed to replicate inside human bacteria to produce harmless virus-like particles, which may stimulate the immune system to produce antibodies against the SARS-CoV-2 virus.
Kiswahili: Kutumia bacteriophages, DNA itatengenezwa kutoka nakala ndani ya bakteria ya mwanadamu ili kutoa chembe kama virusi zisizodhuru, ambazo zinaweza kuchochea mfumo wa kinga kutoa kinga mwili dhidi ya virusi vya SARS-CoV-2.

English: In March 2020, the US government, industry, and three universities pooled resources to access supercomputers from IBM, combined with cloud computing resources from Hewlett Packard Enterprise, Amazon, Microsoft, and Google.
Kiswahili: Mwezi wa Machi 2020, serikali, tasnia, na vyuo vikuu vitatu vya Marekani vilitoa rasilimali ya kufikia tarakilishikuu kutoka IBM, pamoja na rasilimali za kutoa huduma za kompyuta kutoka kwa Hewlett Packard Enterprise, Amazon, Microsoft, na Google.

English: Some vaccines have heterologous effects, also called non-specific effects.
Kiswahili: Chanjo zingine zina athari tofauti, pia hujulikana kama athari zisizo maalum.

English: That means they can have benefits beyond the disease they prevent.
Kiswahili: Hiyo inamaanisha kuwa zinaweza kuwa na manufaa zaidi ya ugonjwa ambao zinazuia.

English: A further randomized trial in Australia is seeking to enrol 4,170 healthcare workers.
Kiswahili: Jaribio zaidi zisizokuwa na utaratibu maalum huko Australia inatafuta kuajiri wafanyakazi 4,170 wa huduma ya afya.

English: It is possible vaccines in development will not be safe or effective.
Kiswahili: Inawezekana kuwa chanjo zinazokuzwa hazikuwa salama au hazitaleta matokeo yanayotarajiwa.

English: Early research to assess vaccine efficacy using COVID-19-specific animal models, such as ACE2-transgenic mice, other laboratory animals, and non-human primates, indicate a need for biosafety-level 3 containment measures for handling live viruses, and international coordination to ensure standardized safety procedures.
Kiswahili: Utafiti wa mapema wa kutathmini ufanisi wa chanjo kwa kutumia mifamo maalum ya covid-19 ya wananyama, kama vile ACE2 yenye jeni kutoka kwa panya, wanyama wengine wa maabara, na chembe zingine zisizo za kibinadamu, unaonyesha hitaji za hatua za uzuizi wa kiwango cha 3 cha usalama wa chembe za kuambukiza, na uratibu wa kimataifa ili kuhakikisha taratibu sanifu za usalama.

English: Vaccines against SARS and MERS have been tested in non-human animal models.
Kiswahili: Chanjo dhidi ya SARS na MARS zimepimwa katika mifano ya wanyama isiyo ya kibinadamu.

English: As of 2020, there is no cure or protective vaccine for SARS that has been shown to be both safe and effective in humans.
Kiswahili: Kufikia 2020, hakuna tiba au chanjo ya kulinda dhidi ya SARS ambazo zimeonyeshwa kuwa salama na kulera matokeo yanayotarajiwa kwa binadamu.

English: According to research papers published in 2005 and 2006, the identification and development of novel vaccines and medicines to treat SARS was a priority for governments and public health agencies around the world.There is also no proven vaccine against MERS.
Kiswahili: Kulingana na makaratasi ya utafiti yaliyochapishwa mwaka 2005 na 2006, utambuzi na ukuaji wa chanjo na dawa mpya za kutibu SARS ulikuwa suala la kipaumbele kwa serikali na mashirika ya afya ya umma kote duniani. Pia hakuna chanjo iliyothibitishwa dhidi ya MERS.

English: When MERS became prevalent, it was believed that existing SARS research may provide a useful template for developing vaccines and therapeutics against a MERS-CoV infection.
Kiswahili: Wakati MARS ilianza kuenea, iliaminika kuwa utafiti uliopo wa SARS unaweza kutoa kiolezo muhimu cha kukuza chanjo na matibabu dhidi ya maambukizo ya MERS-CoV.

English: As of March 2020, there was one (DNA based) MERS vaccine which completed phase I clinical trials in humans, and three others in progress, all of which are viral-vectored vaccines, two adenoviral-vectored (ChAdOx1-MERS, BVRS-GamVac), and one MVA-vectored (MVA-MERS-S).
Kiswahili: Hadi Machi2020, kulikuwa na chanjo moja ya MERS (inayotegemea DNA) iliyokamilisha majaribio ya awamu ya I ya kliniki kwa wanadamu, na zingine tatu zinaendelea, zote ambazo ni chanjo ya kuzuia virusi, virusi viwili ya DNA (ChAdOx1-MERS, BVRS-GamVac), na MVA-vectored (MVA-MERS-S).

English: Social media posts have promoted a conspiracy theory claiming the virus behind COVID-19 was known and that a vaccine was already available.
Kiswahili: Machapisho ya mitandao ya kijamii imekuza nadharia ya kihasidi inayodai kuwa virusi vinavyosababisha COVID-19 vilijulikana na kwamba chanjo ilikuwa tayari inapatikana.

English: The patents cited by various social media posts reference existing patents for genetic sequences and vaccines for other strains of coronavirus such as the SARS coronavirus.
Kiswahili: Haki miliki zilizotajwa na machapisho mbalimbali ya mitandao ya kijamii zinarejelea haki miliki zilizopo za mfululizo wa kijentiki na chanjo kwa aina nyingine ya virusi vya korona kama vile virusi vya korona vya SARS.

English: b'Coronaviruses are a group of related viruses that cause diseases in mammals and birds.
Kiswahili: b'Virusi vya korona ni kikundi cha virusi vinayohusiana vinavyosababisha magonjwa miongoni mwa wanyama na ndege.

English: In humans, coronaviruses cause respiratory tract infections that can range from mild to lethal.
Kiswahili: Kwa binadamu, virusi vya korona husababisha maambikizo ya njia ya pumu yanayoweza kuwa ya wastani au mbaya zaidi.

English: Mild illnesses include some cases of the common cold (which has other possible causes, predominantly rhinoviruses), while more lethal varieties can cause SARS, MERS, and COVID-19.
Kiswahili: Magonjwa kali yanajumuisha visa kadhaa vya mafua ya kawaida (ambayo ina sababu zingine zinazowezekana, rhinoviruses) wakati aina mbaya zaidi zinaweza kusababisha SARS, MERS, na COVID-19.

English: Symptoms in other species vary: in chickens, they cause an upper respiratory tract disease, while in cows and pigs they cause diarrhea.
Kiswahili: Dalili hutofautiana katika spishi zingine: kwa kuku, husababisha ugonjwa katika mfumo wa juu wa kupumua, ambapo kwa ng'ombe na nguruwe husababisha kuhara.

English: There are yet to be vaccines or antiviral drugs to prevent or treat human coronavirus infections.
Kiswahili: Bado hakuna chanjp au dawa za kuzuia virusi au kutibu maambukizo ya virusi vya korona vya binadamau.

English: Coronaviruses constitute the subfamily Orthocoronavirinae, in the family Coronaviridae, order Nidovirales, and realm Riboviria.
Kiswahili: Virusi vya korona vinaunda famlia ndogo ya Orthocoronavirinae, katika familia ya Coronaviridae, Nidovirales, na realm Riboviria.

English: They are enveloped viruses with a positive-sense single-stranded RNA genome and a nucleocapsid of helical symmetry.
Kiswahili: Ni virusi vilivyofunikwa na jenomu chanya ya utungo mmoja wa RNA na ulinganifu wa muundo wa nucleocapsid.

English: The genome size of coronaviruses ranges from approximately 26 to 32 kilobases, one of the largest among RNA viruses.
Kiswahili: Ukubwa wa genome ya virusi vya korona unatofautiana kuanzia takriban kilobesi 26 hadi 32, mojawapo ya gemone kubwa zaidi miongoni mwa virusi vya RNA.

English: They have characteristic club-shaped spikes that project from their surface, which in electron micrographs create an image reminiscent of the solar corona from which their name derives.
Kiswahili: Zina tabia ya ncha kali zenye umbo la rungu ambazo huchomoza kutoka kwa maeneo yake, ambazo katika picha za kitaalamu za elektroni huunda picha inayofanana na korona ya jua ambapo jina ilitoka.

English: Coronaviruses were first discovered in the 1930s when an acute respiratory infection of domesticated chickens was shown to be caused by infectious bronchitis virus (IBV).
Kiswahili: Virusi vya korona viligunduliwa kwa mara ya kwanza miaka ya 1930 wakati maambukizo kali yanayohusiana na upumuaji katika kuku wa nyumbani ulionekana kusababishwa na virusi vya kuambukiza vya mkamba.

English: In the 1940s, two more animal coronaviruses, mouse hepatitis virus (MHV) and transmissible gastroenteritis virus (TGEV), were isolated.Human coronaviruses were discovered in the 1960s.
Kiswahili: Katika miaka ya 1940, virusi viwili zaidi vya korona vya mnyama, vilitengwa, virusi vya homa ya manjano vya panya (MHV), na virusi vya kuambukiza vya uvimbe wa tumbo (TGEV). Virusi vya korona vya wanadamau viligunduliwa miaka ya 1960.

English: The earliest ones studied were from human patients with the common cold, which were later named human coronavirus 229E and human coronavirus OC43.
Kiswahili: Virusi vya kwanza vilivyofanyiwa utafiti vilitoka kwa binadamu wagonjwa wenye mafua ya kawaida, ambayo baadaye iliitwa virusi vya korona 229E na virusi vya korona vya wanadamu OC43.

English: They were first imaged by Scottish virologist June Almeida at St. Thomas Hospital in London.
Kiswahili: Walipigwa picha ya kwanza na mtaalamu wa virusi wa Uskoti June Almeida katika Hospitali ya St,Thomas huko London.

English: Other human coronaviruses have since been identified, including SARS-CoV in 2003, HCoV NL63 in 2004, HKU1 in 2005, MERS-CoV in 2012, and SARS-CoV-2 in 2019.
Kiswahili: Baadaye virusi vingine vya korona vimegunduliwa, ikijumuisha SARS-CoV mwaka wa 2003, HCoV NL63 mwaka wa 2004, HKU1 mwaka wa 2005, MERS-CoV mwaka wa 2012, na SARS-CoV-2 mwaka wa 2019.

English: Most of these have involved serious respiratory tract infections.
Kiswahili: Virusi vingi vimehusisha maambukizo kali ya ya mfumo wa kupumua.

English: The name was first used in 1968 by an informal group of virologists in the journal Nature to designate the new family of viruses.
Kiswahili: Jina hili lilitumika mara ya kwanza mnamo 1968 na kikundi kisicho rasmi cha wanavairolojia katika makala ya Asili ili kuashiria familia mpya ya virusi.

English: The name refers to the characteristic appearance of virions (the infective form of the virus) by electron microscopy, which have a fringe of large, bulbous surface projections creating an image reminiscent of a crown or of a solar corona.
Kiswahili: Jina linamaanisha sifa ya kuonekana ya chembe cha virusi (umbo ya kuambukiza ya virusi) na darubini ya elektroni, ambavyo vina taswira ya maeneo kubwa, ya mviringo inayounda picha ya ukumbusho wa taji au korona ya jua.

English: This morphology is created by the viral spike peplomers, which are proteins on the surface of the virus.
Kiswahili: Mofolojia hii imeundwa na miiba ya glikoprotini kwenye virusi, ambayo ni protini kwenye uso wa virusi.

English: Coronaviruses are large pleomorphic spherical particles with bulbous surface projections.
Kiswahili: Virusi vya korona ni chembe kubwa za mviringo mmoja vyenye taswira ya uso yenye umbo wa balbu.

English: The envelope of the virus in electron micrographs appears as a distinct pair of electron dense shells.The viral envelope consists of a lipid bilayer where the membrane (M), envelope (E) and spike (S) structural proteins are anchored.
Kiswahili: Mfuniko wa virusi hizi katika picha ya kitaalamu ya elektroni huonekana kama jozi ya kipekee ya sheli nzito za elektroni. Mfuniko wa virusi una tabaka ya lipidi ambapo protini za muundo za utando (M), mfuniko (E) na ncha kali (S) zimeshikilia.

English: The lipid bilayer envelope, membrane proteins, and nucleocapsid protect the virus when it is outside the host cell.
Kiswahili: Mfuniko wa tabaka mbili za lipidi, protini za utandao, na nucleocapsid hulinda virusi wakati viko nje ya seli mama.

English: Coronaviruses contain a positive-sense, single-stranded RNA genome.
Kiswahili: Virusi vya korona vina genomu chanya ya nyuzi moja ya RNA

English: The genome size for coronaviruses ranges from 26.4 to 31.7 kilobases.
Kiswahili: Ukubwa wa jenomu wa virusi vya korona ni kati ya kilobesi 26.4 hadi 31.7.

English: The genome size is one of the largest among RNA viruses.
Kiswahili: Ukubwa wa jenomu ni mojawapo kubwa kati ya virusi vya RNA.

English: The open reading frames 1a and 1b, which occupy the first two-thirds of the genome, encode the replicase/transcriptase polyprotein.
Kiswahili: Fremu wazi za kusoma za 1a na 1b, ambazo zinachukua theluthi mbili za kwanza za genomu, husimbua protini nyingi za relicase/transcriptase.

English: The replicase/transcriptase polyprotein self cleaves to form nonstructural proteins.The later reading frames encode the four major structural proteins: spike, envelope, membrane, and nucleocapsid.
Kiswahili: Protini nyingi za replicase/transcriptase hujikwamilia ili kuunda protini zisizo na muundo. Fremu za baadaye za kusoma husimbua protini nne kuu za muundo: ncha kali, mfuniko, utandao, na nucleocapsid.

English: Interspersed between these reading frames are the reading frames for the accessory proteins.
Kiswahili: Zilizochanganywa kati ya fremu hizi za kusona na fremu za kusoma za protini za ziada.

English: The number of accessory proteins and their function is unique depending on the specific coronavirus.
Kiswahili: Idadi ya protini ya ziada na kazi yao ni ya kipekee kulingana na virusi maalum vya korona.

English: Infection begins when the viral spike (S) glycoprotein attaches to its complementary host cell receptor.
Kiswahili: Maambukizi huanza wakati glaikoprotini (S) ya ncha kali ya virusi inapojiambatishwa kwa vipokezi vya ziada vya seli mama.

English: After attachment, a protease of the host cell cleaves and activates the receptor-attached spike protein.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kuambatisha, protisi ya seli mama hukwamilia na kuamilisha kipokezi kilichoambatishwa kwenye protini ya ncha kazi.

English: Depending on the host cell protease available, cleavage and activation allows the virus to enter the host cell by endocytosis or direct fusion of the viral envelop with the host membrane.On entry into the host cell, the virus particle is uncoated, and its genome enters the cell cytoplasm.
Kiswahili: Kulingana na protisi ianyopatikana ya seli mama, ukwamiliaji na uamilishaji huruhusu virusi kuingia kwenye seli mama kwa njia ya endocytosis au mchanganyiko wa moja kwa moja wa mfuniko wa virusi na utando mama. Baada ya kuingia kwenye seli mama, chembe cha virusi hufunguliwa, na genomu huingia sitoplazimu ya seli.

English: The host ribosome translates the initial overlapping open reading frame of the virus genome and forms a long polyprotein.
Kiswahili: Ribosomu mama hutafsiri fremu wazi ya kwanza inayopindana ya kusoma ya genomu ya vitusi na kuunda protini nyingi.

English: The polyprotein has its own proteases which cleave the polyprotein into multiple nonstructural proteins.
Kiswahili: Protini nyingi zina protisi zake zenyewe ambazo hukwamilikia protini nyingi na kuwa protini mbalimbali zisizo kuwa na muundo.

English: A number of the nonstructural proteins coalesce to form a multi-protein replicase-transcriptase complex (RTC).
Kiswahili: Idadi ya protini zisizokuwa na muundo hushirikiana ili kuunda multi-protein replicase-transcriptase complex (RTC).

English: The main replicase-transcriptase protein is the RNA-dependent RNA polymerase (RdRp).
It is directly involved in the replication and transcription of RNA from an RNA strand.
Kiswahili: Inahusika moja kwa moja katika urudufishaji na ufasili wa RNA kutoka kwa nyuzi ya RNA.

English: The other nonstructural proteins in the complex assist in the replication and transcription process.
Kiswahili: Protini nyingine zisizo na muundo katika uchangamano husaidia katika mchakato wa kurudufisha na ufasili.

English: The exoribonuclease nonstructural protein, for instance, provides extra fidelity to replication by providing a proofreading function which the RNA-dependent RNA polymerase lacks.One of the main functions of the complex is to replicate the viral genome.
Kiswahili: Protini isiyokuwa na muundo ya exoribonclease, kwa mfano, hutoa uaminifu wa ziada wa urudufishaji kwa kutoa utendaji wa kupitia ambao polyemerase RNA inyotegemea RNA inakosa. Mojawapo ya kazi kuu za uchangamano huu ni kurudufu genomu ya virusi.

English: RdRp directly mediates the synthesis of negative-sense genomic RNA from the positive-sense genomic RNA.
Kiswahili: RdRp hupatanisha moja kwa moja usanisi wa RNA genomiki ya hisia hasi kutoka kwa RNA genomikia ya hisia chanya.

English: This is followed by the replication of positive-sense genomic RNA from the negative-sense genomic RNA.
Kiswahili: Hii inafuatwa na urududishaji wa RNA genomiki ya hisia chanya kutoka kwa RNA genomiki ya hisia hasi.

English: The other important function of the complex is to transcribe the viral genome.
Kiswahili: Kazi nyingine muhimu ya uchangamano ni kufasilia genomu ya virusi.

English: RdRp directly mediates the synthesis of negative-sense subgenomic RNA molecules from the positive-sense genomic RNA.
Kiswahili: RdRp hupatanisha moja kwa moja usanidi wa molekuli za RNA za genomiki ndogo za hisia hasi kutoka kwa RNA genomiki za hisia chanya.

English: This is followed by the transcription of these negative-sense subgenomic RNA molecules to their corresponding positive-sense mRNAs.
Kiswahili: Hii inafuatiliwa na ufasili wa molekuli hizi za RNA za genomiki ndogo za hisia hasi kwa MRNAs zao zinazolingana za hisia chanya.

English: The replicated positive-sense genomic RNA becomes the genome of the progeny viruses.
Kiswahili: RNA genomiki inayorudufiwa ya hisia chanya inakuwa genomiki ya virusi vya kizazi.

English: The mRNAs are gene transcripts of the last third of the virus genome after the initial overlapping reading frame.
Kiswahili: mRNA ni hati za jini za theluthi ya mwisho wa genomu ya virusi baada ya kupindana kwa kwanza kwa fremu ya kusoma.

English: These mRNAs are translated by the host's ribosomes into the structural proteins and a number of accessory proteins.
Kiswahili: Chembe hizi za mRNS zinabadilishwa na ribosome za mwenye virusi kuwa protini za kimuundo na idadi fulani ya protini za ufikiaji.

English: RNA translation occurs inside the endoplasmic reticulum.
Kiswahili: RNA hubadilishwa ndani ya utumbo wa endoplasmiki.

English: The viral structural proteins S, E, and M move along the secretory pathway into the Golgi intermediate compartment.
Kiswahili: Protini za muundo wa virusi, S, E, na M husonga pamoja katika njia ya uzalishaji kwenye sehemu ya kati ya Golgi.

English: There, the M proteins direct most protein-protein interactions required for assembly of viruses following its binding to the nucleocapsid.
Kiswahili: Hapo, prorini ya M huelekeza miingiliano baina ya protini na protini inayohitajika inayohitajika kwa mkusanyiko wa virusi kufuatia kunatwa kwake kwenye nucleocapsidi.

English: Progeny viruses are then released from the host cell by exocytosis through secretory vesicles.
Kiswahili: Virusi vya uzao kisha huachiliwa kutoka kwa seli mama na eksotisosi kupitia vilengelenge vya uzalishaji.

English: The interaction of the coronavirus spike protein with its complement host cell receptor is central in determining the tissue tropism, infectivity, and species range of the virus.
Kiswahili: Mwingiliano wa protini ya ncha ya kali ya virusi vya korona na kipokezi chake cha ziada cha seli mama ni muhimu katika kubainisha ubadilishaji wa tishu, hali ya kuambukizwa, na masafa ya spishi ya virusi.

English: The SARS coronavirus, for example, infects human cells by attaching to the angiotensin-converting enzyme 2 (ACE2) receptor.
Kiswahili: Virusi vya korona vya SARS, kwa mfano, huambukiza seli za binadamu kwa kuambatisha kipokezi cha (ACE2) cha kimeng'enya 2 cha kubadilisha angiotensin.

English: The scientific name for coronavirus is Orthocoronavirinae or Coronavirinae.
Kiswahili: Jina la kisayansi la virusi vya korona ni Orthocoronavirinae au Coronavirinae.

English: Coronaviruses belong to the family of Coronaviridae, order Nidovirales, and realm Riboviria.
Kiswahili: Virusi vya korona kibayolojia vinatokana na familia ya Coronaviridae, mpangilio wa Nidovirales na ulingo wa Riboviria.

English: Genus Betacoronavirus; type species: Murine coronavirus

Species: Betacoronavirus 1 (Bovine Coronavirus, Human coronavirus OC43), Human coronavirus HKU1, Murine coronavirus, Pipistrellus bat coronavirus HKU5, Rousettus bat coronavirus HKU9, Severe acute respiratory syndrome-related coronavirus (SARS-CoV, SARS-CoV-2), Tylonycteris bat coronavirus HKU4, Middle East respiratory syndrome-related coronavirus, Hedgehog coronavirus 1 (EriCoV)
Kiswahili: Aina zake: Betacoronavirus 1 (Bovine Coronavirus, Human coronavirus OC43), Human coronavirus HKU1, Murine coronavirus, Pipistrellus bat coronavirus HKU5, Rousettus bat coronavirus HKU9, Ugonjwa mbaya wa matatizo ya kupumua yanayohusiana na virusi vya korona (SARS-CoV, SARS-CoV-2), Tylonycteris bat coronavirus HKU4, Ugonjwa wa matatizo ya kupumua unaotoka Mashariki ya kati unaohusiana na virusi vya korona, Hedgehog coronavirus 1 (EriCoV)

English: Species: Beluga whale coronavirus SW1, Infectious bronchitis virus
Kiswahili: Aina: Virusi vya korona vya nyangumi ya beluga sw1, virusi vya kuambukiza vya mkamba

English: The most recent common ancestor (MRCA) of all coronaviruses is estimated to have existed as recently as 8000 BCE, although some models place the common ancestor as far back as 55 million years or more, implying long term coevolution with bat and avian species.
Kiswahili: Kizazi cha hivi punde cha virusi vyote ya korona (MRCA) kinakadiriwa kilikuwa hivi karibuni kama 8000 BCE, ingawa mifano kadhaa huchukua nafasi ya kizazi cha kawaida kwa miaka milioni 55 au zaidi, ikimaanisha inashirikiana kuwa muda mrefu na aina ya spishi ya popo na ndege.

English: The most recent common ancestor of the alphacoronavirus line has been placed at about 2400 BCE, the betacoronavirus line at 3300 BCE, the gammacoronavirus line at 2800 BCE, and the deltacoronavirus line at about 3000 BCE.
Kiswahili: Kizazi cha hivi punde cha virusi cha alphacoronavirus kimewekwa kati ya takriban 2400 BCE, kizazi cha betacoronavirus katika 3300 BCE, kizazi cha gammacoronavirus katika 2800 BCE na kizazi cha deltacoronavirus katika takriban 3000 BCE.

English: The large number of host bat and avian species, and their global range, has enabled extensive evolution and dissemination of coronaviruses.Many human coronavirus have their origin in bats.
Kiswahili: Idadi kubwa ya bata yenye virusi na spishi za ndege, na aina yao duniani, imewezesha mageuzi na usambazaji mkubwa wa virusi vya korona. Virusi vingi vya korona vya wanadamu vimetoka kwa popo.

English: More recently, alpaca coronavirus and human coronavirus 229E diverged sometime before 1960.
Kiswahili: Vya hivi majuzi zaidi, virusi vya korona vya alpaca na virusi vya korona vya mwanadamu 229E vilitengana kabla ya 1960.

English: MERS-CoV emerged in humans from bats through the intermediate host of camels.
Kiswahili: MERS-Cov iliibuka kwa wanadamu kutoka kwa popo ambayo iitoka kwa ngamia.

English: MERS-CoV, although related to several bat coronavirus species, appears to have diverged from these several centuries ago.
Kiswahili: MERS-CoV, ingawa vinahusiana na aina nyingi za virusi vya korona vya popo, vinaonekana vilitengana karne kadhaa zilizopita.

English: The most closely related bat coronavirus and SARS-CoV diverged in 1986.
Kiswahili: Virusi vya korona na SARS-C0V inavyohusiana sana na popo vilitofautiana mwaka wa 1986

English: A possible path of evolution, of SARS coronavirus and keen bat coronaviruses, suggests that SARS related coronaviruses coevolved in bats for a long time.
Kiswahili: Njia inayowezekana ya mageuzi, ya virusi vya korona vya SARS na virusi vya korona vya popo, inapendekeza kuwa virusi vya korona vinavyohusiana na SARS vilikuwa kwenye popo kwa muda mrefu.

English: In the 1790s, equine coronavirus diverged from the bovine coronavirus after a cross-species jump.
Kiswahili: Miaka ya 1790, virusi vya koroma vya farasi vilitoka kwa virusi vya korona vya ng'ombe baada ya kuruka kwenda kwa spishi nyingine.

English: Later in the 1890s, human coronavirus OC43 diverged from bovine coronavirus after another cross-species spillover event.
Kiswahili: Baadaye katika miaka ya 1980, virusi vya korona vya mwanadamu OC43 vilitoka kwa virusi vya korona vya ng'ombe baada ya tukio lingine ya kuruka kwenda kwenye spishi nyingine.

English: It is speculated that the flu pandemic of 1890 may have been caused by this spillover event, and not by the influenza virus, because of the related timing, neurological symptoms, and unknown causative agent of the pandemic.
Kiswahili: Inakisiwa kwamba maradhi ya mafua ya mwaka wa 1890 yanaweza kuwa yalisababishwa na tukio hili ya kuruka kwenda kwenye spishi nyine, lakini sio virusi vya mafua, kwa sababu ya muda husika, dalili za nyurolojia, dalili zingine zisizojulikana za ugonjwa huo.

English: Human coronavirus OC43 besides causing respiratory infections is also suspected of playing a role in neurological diseases.
Kiswahili: Virusi vya korona vya mwanadamu OC43 kando na kusababisha maambukizi ya njia ya kupumua pia vinashukiwa kusababisha magonjwa ya nyurolojia.

English: In the 1950s, the human coronavirus OC43 began to diverge into its present genotypes.
Kiswahili: Miaka ya 1950, virusi vya korona vya mwanadamu vilianza kuibuka kama genitki ni za sasa.

English: Phylogentically, mouse hepatitis virus (Murine coronavirus), which infects the mouse's liver and the central nervous system, is related to human coronavirus OC43 and bovine coronavirus.
Kiswahili: Katika uvumbuzi wa kikundi fulani cha viumbe, virusi vya homa vya panya (virusi vya korona vya murine) ambayo huambukiza ini na mfumo mkuu wa neve wa panya, vinahusiana na virusi vya korona vya mwanadamu OC43 na virusi vya korona vya ng'ombe.

English: Human coronavirus HKU1, like the aforementioned viruses, also has its origins in rodents.
Kiswahili: Virusi vya korona vya mwanadamu HKU1, kama virusi vilivyotajwa hapo awali, pia hutoka kwa wanyama wagugunaji.

English: Coronaviruses vary significantly in risk factor.
Kiswahili: Virusi vya korona hutofautiana sana kwa kiwango cha hatari.

English: Some can kill more than 30% of those infected, such as MERS-CoV, and some are relatively harmless, such as the common cold.
Kiswahili: Vingine vinaweza kuua zaidi ya asilimia 30 ya wale walioambukizwa, kama vile MERS-CoV, na vingine sio hatari sana, kama vile homa ya kawaida.

English: Coronaviruses can cause colds with major symptoms, such as fever, and a sore throat from swollen adenoids.
Kiswahili: Virusi vya korona vinaweza kusababisha mafua yenye dalili kali, kama vile homa na mwasho wa koo kutoka kwa tushu zilizovimba.

English: Coronaviruses can cause pneumonia (either direct viral pneumonia or secondary bacterial pneumonia) and bronchitis (either direct viral bronchitis or secondary bacterial bronchitis).
Kiswahili: Virusi vya korona vinaweza kusababisha nimonia (aidha virusi vya moja kwa moja vya nimonia au nimonoa ya bakteria ya pili) na mkamba (aidha virusi vya moja kwa moja vya mkamba au mkamba bakeria ya pili).

English: The human coronavirus discovered in 2003, SARS-CoV, which causes severe acute respiratory syndrome (SARS), has a unique pathogenesis because it causes both upper and lower respiratory tract infections.Six species of human coronaviruses are known, with one species subdivided into two different strains, making seven strains of human coronaviruses altogether.
Kiswahili: Virusi vya korona vya binadamu vilivyogunduliwa mwaka wa 2003, ambavyo husababisha ugonjwa kali wa matatizo ya kupumua (SARS), vina pathogenisis ya kipekee kwa sababu huambukiza sehemu ya juu na chini ya kupumua. Aina sita za virusi vya korona vya mwanadamu vinajulikana, na aina moja imegawanywa katika aina mbili tofauti, na kutengeneza aina sita za virusi vya korona vya mwanadamu kwa pamoja.

English: Four of these coronaviruses continually circulate in the human population and produce the generally mild symptoms of the common cold in adults and children worldwide: -OC43, -HKU1, HCoV-229E, -NL63.
Kiswahili: Nne kati ya virusi hivi vya korona vinaendelea kusambazwa katika idadi ya watu na hutoa dalili za kawaida zisizo kali za mafua kwa watu wazima na watoto duniani: -OC43, -HKU1, HCoV-229E, -NL63.

English: Coronaviruses cause about 15% of commons colds.
Kiswahili: Virusi vya korona husababisha takriban asilimia 15 ya mafua ya kawaida.

English: The majority of colds are caused by rhinoviruses.
Kiswahili: Aina nyingi ya mafua husababishwa na rhinoviruses.

English: The four mild coronaviruses have a seasonal incidence occurring in the winter months in temperate climates.
Kiswahili: Virusi vinne kali vya korona hutokea wakati wa msimu wa baridi katika hali ya hewa ya wastani.

English: There is no preference towards a particular season in tropical climates.
Kiswahili: Hakuna upendeleo wa msimu fulani katika hali ya hewa ya kitropiki.

English: The virus was officially named the SARS coronavirus (SARS-CoV).
Kiswahili: Virusi hivyo vilipewa jina rasmi la (SARS-CoV).

English: More than 8,000 people were infected, about ten percent of whom died.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya watu 8,000 waliambukizwa, takriban asilimia kumi yao waliaga dunia.

English: In September 2012, a new type of coronavirus was identified, initially called Novel Coronavirus 2012, and now officially named Middle East respiratory syndrome coronavirus (MERS-CoV).
