English: This strategy was tried for SARS with inconclusive results.
Kiswahili: Mbinu hii ilijaribiwa kwa SARS na matokeo yasio kamili.

English: Viral neutralisation is the anticipated mechanism of action by which passive antibody therapy can mediate defence against SARS-CoV-2.
Kiswahili: Usawazishaji wa virusi ndiyo njia inayotarajiwa ya hatua ambayo tiba isiyoamilifu ya kingamwili inaweza kuleta kinga dhidi ya SARS-CoV-2.

English: Other mechanisms however, such as antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity and/or phagocytosis, may be possible.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, mbinu nyingine, kama vile sitotoksiki ya seli na/au phagocytosis zinazotegema kingamwili, zinawezekana.

English: Other forms of passive antibody therapy, for example, using manufactured monoclonal antibodies, are in development.
Kiswahili: Njia nyingine za matibabu yasiyo amilifu ya kinga mwili, kwa mfano, kutumia kingamwili zilizotengenezwa za kloni za namna moja zinaundwa.

English: Production of convalescent serum, which consists of the liquid portion of the blood from recovered patients and contains antibodies specific to this virus, could be increased for quicker deployment.
Kiswahili: Uzalishaji wa chanjo ya dawa ya ahueni, yenye sehemu ya kioevu cha damu kutoka kwa wagonjwa waliopona na ina kingamwili ambayo ni maalum kwa virusi, inaweza kuongezeka kwa sababu ya kutengenezwa kwa haraka.

English: Coronavirus diseases, a group of closely related syndromes
Kiswahili: Ugonjwa wa virusi vya korona, kundi la magonjwa yanayo husiana kwa karibu

English: Li Wenliang, a doctor at Central Hospital of Wuhan, who later contracted and died of COVID-19 after raising awareness of the spread of the virus.

Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawakumbusha wazazi kwamba uandikishaji wa Gredi ya Kwanza unaendelea katika shule zote za umma za msingi.

English: Teenage mothers are encouraged to return to school, and no school should deny them readmission.
Kiswahili: Wakina mama wa kijana wanahimizwa kurejea shuleni, na hakuna shule inayopaswa kuwanyima kukubaliwa tena.

English: Needy students can apply for county bursaries through their ward education offices.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi maskini wanaweza kuomba misaada ya masomo ya kaunti kupitia ofisi za elimu za kata zao.

English: HELB invites eligible university and college students to apply for loans through the online portal.
Kiswahili: HELB inawaalika wanafunzi wa vyuo vikuu na vyuo wanaostahili kuomba mikopo kupitia lango la mtandaoni.

English: Adult literacy classes are offered free of charge at community learning centres across the county.
Kiswahili: Madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima yanatolewa bure katika vituo vya kujifunzia vya jamii katika kaunti nzima.

English: Every child has the right to education; parents who keep children at home risk legal action.
Kiswahili: Kila mtoto ana haki ya kupata elimu; wazazi wanaowazuia watoto wao kuhudhuria shule wanaweza kuchukuliwa hatua za kisheria.

English: The sub-county education office will register children who missed enrolment during the school holidays.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya elimu ya wilaya ndogo itawaandikisha watoto walioachwa nyuma wakati wa uandikishaji.

English: The Teachers Service Commission urges communities to keep girls in school until they complete their secondary education.
Kiswahili: TSC inahimiza jamii kuweka wasichana shuleni hadi wamalisize elimu yao ya sekondari.

English: Parents are asked to collect admission letters for their children from the schools where they were placed.
Kiswahili: Wazazi wanaombwa kuchukua barua za kujiunga za watoto wao kutoka shule walizowekwa.

English: KUCCPS reminds candidates who have not secured placement to revise their course choices during the open window.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawakumbusha watahiniwa ambao bado hawajapata nafasi kupitia tena uchaguzi wao wa kozi katika kipindi kilichofunguliwa.

English: The Ministry of Education urges youth to enrol in TVET colleges for practical skills that lead to employment.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawahamasisha vijana kujiunga na vyuo vya TVET ili kupata ujuzi wa vitendo unaowezesha kuajiriwa.

English: Apprenticeship opportunities are available for youth interested in plumbing, welding, and electrical work at county workshops.
Kiswahili: Fursa za kujifunzia ufundi kwa kazi zinapatikana kwa vijana wanaopenda ufundi wa mabomba, kushomelea na umeme katika karakana za kaunti.

English: KUCCPS has opened applications for diploma and certificate courses in public technical and vocational institutions.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS imefungua maombi ya kozi za diploma na vyeti katika taasisi za umma za mafunzo ya kiufundi na kitaaluma.

English: Graduates of vocational training can access government tools and startup support through their local youth offices.
Kiswahili: Wahitimu wa mafunzo ya ufundi wanaweza kupata zana za serikali na msaada wa kuanzisha biashara kupitia ofisi za vijana za eneo lao.

English: Employers are encouraged to offer industrial attachment placements to TVET students in their workshops and firms.
Kiswahili: Waajiri wanahimizwa kutoa nafasi za kujifunzia kwa vitendo kwa wanafunzi wa TVET katika karakana na makampuni yao.

English: Technical training institutes will admit students who sat their national examinations regardless of their final grades.
Kiswahili: Taasisi za mafunzo ya kiufundi zitawakubali wanafunzi waliofanya mitihani yao ya kitaifa bila kujali alama walizopata.

English: Youth who complete artisan courses can register for trade tests to have their skills formally recognised.
Kiswahili: Vijana wanaomaliza kozi za ufundi wa vitendo wanaweza kusajiliwa kwa mitihani ya ufundi ili ujuzi wao utambuliwe rasmi.

English: The county government will sponsor needy youth to join vocational training centres within their sub-counties.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya kaunti itawadhamini vijana maskini kujiunga na vituo vya mafunzo ya ufundi vilivyomo katika wilaya zao ndogo.

English: Parents are advised to guide their children towards technical courses, which offer strong opportunities for self-employment.
Kiswahili: Wazazi wanashauriwa kuwaongoza watoto wao kuelekea kozi za kiufundi, ambazo hutoa fursa nzuri za kujiajiri.

English: Workers who acquired their skills informally can now be assessed and certified through recognition of prior learning.
Kiswahili: Wafanyakazi waliojifunza ujuzi wao kwa njia isiyo rasmi sasa wanaweza kupimwa na kutunukiwa vyeti kupitia utambuzi wa ujuzi uliopatikana hapo awali.

English: Schools are encouraged to hold civic education sessions that teach learners about their rights and responsibilities as citizens.
Kiswahili: Shule zinahimizwa kufanya vikao vya elimu ya kiraia vinavyowafundisha wanafunzi kuhusu haki na wajibu wao kama raia.

English: The Ministry of Education will partner with civil society to deliver voter awareness programmes in secondary schools.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu itashirikiana na asasi za kiraia kutoa programu za uelewa wa kupiga kura katika shule za sekondari.

English: Learners who turn eighteen are urged to register as voters and participate in choosing their leaders peacefully.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wanaofikisha umri wa miaka kumi na nane wanahimizwa kujisajili kama wapiga kura na kushiriki kwa amani katika kuchagua viongozi wao.

English: Community barazas will be held in every ward to educate residents on the importance of public participation in county planning.
Kiswahili: Mikutano ya baraza itafanywa katika kila kata kuwaelimisha wakazi kuhusu umuhimu wa ushiriki wa umma katika mipango ya kaunti.

English: Teachers are reminded to remain neutral when guiding classroom discussions on elections and national governance.
Kiswahili: Walimu wanakumbushwa kutokuwa na upendeleo wanapoongoza mjadala darasani kuhusu uchaguzi na utawala wa kitaifa.

English: Civic education materials in local languages are available at sub-county education offices for community trainers.
Kiswahili: Vifaa vya elimu ya kiraia kwa lugha za kienyeji vinapatikana katika ofisi za elimu za wilaya ndogo kwa ajili ya waelimishaji wa jamii.

English: Parents are encouraged to discuss national values such as honesty, respect, and responsibility with their children at home.
Kiswahili: Wazazi wanahimizwa kujadiliana na watoto wao nyumbani kuhusu maadili ya kitaifa kama uaminifu, heshima na uwajibikaji.

English: The county government urges residents to attend public forums before decisions on development projects are made.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya kaunti inawahamasisha wakazi kuhudhuria mikutano ya umma kabla ya maamuzi kuhusu miradi ya maendeleo kufanywa.

English: School drama and music festivals will include themes that promote peace, tolerance, and national unity among learners.
Kiswahili: Tamasha za maigizo na muziki shuleni zitajumuisha mada zinazohimiza amani, uvumilivu na mshikamano wa kitaifa miongoni mwa wanafunzi.

English: Young people are reminded that voting is a right and a duty, and every voice counts in building the nation.
Kiswahili: Vijana wanakumbushwa kwamba kupiga kura ni haki na wajibu, na kila sauti ni muhimu katika kujenga taifa.

English: The Ministry of Education has distributed new textbooks to all public schools and will verify their use termly.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu imesambaza vitabu vipya vya kiada katika shule zote za umma na itathibitisha matumizi yake kila muhula.

English: School feeding programmes will continue in all public primary schools, and no child should be sent away from school.
Kiswahili: Programu za chakula shuleni zitaendelea katika shule zote za msingi za umma, na hakuna mtoto anayepaswa kufukuzwa shuleni.

English: Donors and well-wishers are invited to support school libraries by donating storybooks in English and Kiswahili.
Kiswahili: Wafadhili na wemaaji wanaalikwa kusaidia maktaba za shule kwa kutoa vitabu vya hadithi kwa Kiingereza na Kiswahili.

English: Schools that received ICT devices must ensure they are used for learning and kept in secure rooms.
Kiswahili: Shule zilizopokea vifaa vya ICT lazima zihakikishe vinatumiwa kwa kujifunzia na kuhifadhiwa katika vyumba salama.

English: Parents whose children qualify for the school meals programme should confirm registration with the head teacher.
Kiswahili: Wazazi ambao watoto wao wanastahili programu ya chakula shuleni wanapaswa kuthibitisha usajili na mwalimu mkuu.

English: The county education office will inspect school libraries to confirm that books are accessible to all learners.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya elimu ya kaunti itakagua maktaba za shule ili kuthibitisha kwamba vitabu vinafikika kwa wanafunzi wote.

English: Secondary schools are reminded to keep laboratories stocked with basic materials for practical science lessons.
Kiswahili: Shule za sekondari zinakumbushwa kuhakikisha maabara zina vifaa vya msingi kwa ajili ya masomo ya vitendo vya sayansi.

English: Digital learning devices distributed to learners remain government property and must be returned in good condition.
Kiswahili: Vifaa vya kujifunzia vya kidijitali vilivyogawiwa wanafunzi vinabaki kuwa mali ya serikali na vinapaswa kurudishwa katika hali nzuri.

English: Head teachers must display the list of bursary beneficiaries on the school noticeboard for transparency.
Kiswahili: Walimu wakuu lazima wabandike orodha ya wafaidi wa misaada ya masomo kwenye ubao wa matangazo wa shule kwa uwazi.

English: Community members are urged to protect school property and report any vandalism of classrooms, desks, or water tanks.
Kiswahili: Wanajamii wanahimizwa kulinda mali ya shule na kuripoti uharibifu wowote wa madarasa, madawati au mizinga ya maji.

English: All schools must enforce anti-bullying rules and report serious cases to the sub-county education office immediately.
Kiswahili: Shule zote lazima zitekeleze sheria dhidi ya unyanyasaji na kuripoti kesi kubwa kwa ofisi ya elimu ya wilaya ndogo mara moja.

English: Parents should report any form of abuse against a child to the nearest chief's office or police station.
Kiswahili: Wazazi wanapaswa kuripoti unyanyasaji wa aina yoyote dhidi ya mtoto katika ofisi ya chifu aliye karibu au kituo cha polisi.

English: Learners with disabilities have the right to learn, and schools must provide reasonable support for their needs.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wenye ulemavu wana haki ya kujifunza, na shule lazima zitoe msaada unaofaa kwa mahitaji yao.

English: School administrations must ensure that toilets, classrooms, and playgrounds are safe and accessible to every learner.
Kiswahili: Utawala wa shule lazima uhakikishe kwamba vyoo, madarasa na viwanja vya michezo ni salama na vinafikika kwa kila mwanafunzi.

English: Teachers are urged to watch for signs of distress in learners and refer them for guidance and counselling.
Kiswahili: Walimu wanahimizwa kuwa makini na ishara za huzuni kwa wanafunzi na kuwaelekeza kwa huduma za mwongozo na ushauri.

English: The Ministry of Education directs all schools to hold regular safety drills for fire and other emergencies.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inaagiza shule zote kufanya mazoezi ya usalama mara kwa mara kwa ajili ya moto na dharura nyingine.

English: Girls must not be discriminated against in science, mathematics, or any subject offered in our schools.
Kiswahili: Wasichana hawapaswi kubaguliwa katika masomo ya sayansi, hesabu au somo lolote linalotolewa katika shule zetu.

English: Schools receiving learners with special needs will get additional resources and trained teachers to support inclusion.
Kiswahili: Shule zinazopokea wanafunzi wenye mahitaji maalum zitapata rasilimali za ziada na walimu waliofundishwa ili kuunga mkono ushirikishwaji.

English: Parents are reminded to accompany young children to school and teach them road safety rules.
Kiswahili: Wazazi wanakumbushwa kuwasindikiza watoto wadogo hadi shuleni na kuwafundisha sheria za usalama barabarani.

English: Any person who defiles or abuses a school child will face the full force of the law.
Kiswahili: Mtu yeyote atakayemtendea mtoto wa shule ubakaji au unyanyasaji atakabiliwa na nguvu kamili ya sheria.

English: NTSA reminds all road users to observe speed limits and avoid driving while tired or under the influence of alcohol.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawakumbusha watumiaji wote wa barabara kuzingatia miinuko ya mwendo na kuepuka kuendesha gari wakiwa imechoka au chini ya ushawishi wa pombe.

English: Motorists are advised to avoid flooded roads and bridges until the water levels go down completely.
Kiswahili: Madereva wanashauriwa kuepuka barabara na madaraja yaliyofurika hadi kiwango cha maji kipungue kabisa.

English: Pedestrians should always use footbridges and zebra crossings, and wear bright clothing when walking at night.
Kiswahili: Waenda kwa miguu wanapaswa kutumia madaraja ya kuvuka na miwaba kila wakati, na kuvaa mavazi yanayong'aa wanapotembea usiku.

English: The Kenya Meteorological Department warns residents in low-lying areas to move to higher ground before the heavy rains begin.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Hali ya Hewa ya Kenya inawaonya wakazi wa maeneo ya chini kuhama na kwenda sehemu za juu kabla mvua kubwa haijaanza.

English: Every household is encouraged to prepare an emergency kit with water, food, medicine and a torch before the rainy season.
Kiswahili: Kila kaya inahimizwa kuandaa kifurushi cha dharura chenye maji, chakula, dawa na tochi kabla ya msimu wa mvua.

English: Parents are urged to teach children what to do during an earthquake: drop down, take cover and hold on firmly.
Kiswahili: Wazazi wanahimizwa kuwafundisha watoto la kufanya tetemeko linapotokea: jilaze chini, jifiche na kushikilia kwa nguvu.

English: Boda boda riders and their passengers must always wear helmets to reduce the risk of serious injury on our roads.
Kiswahili: Waendesha pikipiki za boda boda na abiria wao ni lazima wavae kofia ngumu kila wakati ili kupunguza hatari ya kujeruhiwa vibaya barabarani.

English: Schools are advised to hold regular fire drills so that pupils and teachers know how to evacuate safely and quickly.
Kiswahili: Shule zinashauriwa kufanya mazoezi ya kukimbia moto mara kwa mara ili wanafunzi na walimu wajue jinsi ya kujikwamua kwa usalama na haraka.

English: Do not overload electrical sockets and always switch off appliances before leaving home to prevent fire accidents.
Kiswahili: Usipakize soketi za umeme zaidi ya kiasi na daima zima vifaa vya umeme kabla ya kuondoka nyumbani ili kuzuia ajali za moto.

English: In case of a fire outbreak, call the fire brigade immediately and never go back inside a burning building.
Kiswahili: Iwapo moto utazuka, pigia simu kikosi cha kuzima moto mara moja na usirudi ndani ya jengo linalowaka.

English: The National Police Service urges the public to report any suspicious persons or activities to the nearest police station without delay.
Kiswahili: Jeshi la Polisi la Kitaifa linahimiza umma kuripoti watu au shughuli zozote zinazoshukiwa katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu bila kuchelewa.

English: Residents are encouraged to join community policing forums and work closely with their local chief and police officers.
Kiswahili: Wakazi wanahimizwa kujiunga na vikao vya usalama wa jumuiya na kufanya kazi kwa karibu na chifu na maafisa wa polisi wa eneo lao.

English: Under the nyumba kumi initiative, every household should know its neighbours and report strangers loitering in the area.
Kiswahili: Katika mpango wa nyumba kumi, kila kaya inapaswa kuwajua majirani zake na kuripoti wageni wanaozurura eneo hilo.

English: Always lock your doors and windows, and do not leave valuables visible through windows when you are away from home.
Kiswahili: Daima funga milango na madirisha yako kwa kufuli, na usiache vifaa vya thamani vikionekana kupitia madirisha unapokuwa hayupo nyumbani.

English: The DCI advises business owners to install security lights and alarm systems to deter thieves from targeting their premises.
Kiswahili: DCI inawashauri wafanyabiashara kufunga taa za usalama na mifumo ya kengele ili kuzuia wezi kuwalenga majumba yao ya biashara.

English: If you witness a crime, stay calm, do not confront the suspect, and report to the police as soon as it is safe.
Kiswahili: Ukishuhudia uhalifu, jikaze, usimkabili mshukiwa, na uripoti kwa polisi haraka iwezekanavyo kwa usalama wako.

English: Community members are reminded that mob justice is a crime; always hand over suspects to the police for lawful action.
Kiswahili: Wanajamii wanakumbushwa kwamba sheria ya kujichukulia mkononi ni uhalifu; daima wakabidhi wahukiwa kwa polisi ili hatua za kisheria zichukuliwe.

English: Motorcycle owners are advised to install tracking devices and park in well-lit, guarded areas to prevent theft.
Kiswahili: Wamiliki wa pikipiki wanashauriwa kufunga vifaa vya kufuatilia na kuegesha sehemu zenye mwanga na walinzi ili kuzuia wizi.

English: Local chiefs urge residents to attend barazas where security matters affecting the community are discussed openly and peacefully.
Kiswahili: Machifu wa maeneo wanahimiza wakazi kuhudhuria mabaraza ambayo masuala ya usalama yanayogusa jumuiya hujadiliwa kwa uwazi na kwa amani.

English: Do not share your travel plans or valuables on social media, as criminals may use this information to target your home.
Kiswahili: Usitangaze mipango yako ya safari au mali zako kwenye mitandao ya kijamii, kwani wahalifu wanaweza kutumia taarifa hizo kuilenga nyumba yako.

English: The public is urged to remain vigilant and report unattended bags or parcels in public places to security officers immediately.
Kiswahili: Umma unahimizwa kuwa waangalifu na kuripoti mifuko au vifurushi vilivyowekwa wazi mahali pa umma kwa maafisa wa usalama mara moja.

English: In the event of a security alert, follow instructions from uniformed officers and move calmly to the designated safe areas.
Kiswahili: Iwapo kutakuwa na tahadhari ya usalama, fuata maagizo ya maafisa wenye sare na uende kwa utulivu hadi maeneo salama yaliyoteuliwa.

English: Security agencies remind Kenyans that terrorism is defeated through cooperation between citizens and the government at all levels.
Kiswahili: Mashirika ya usalama yanawakumbusha Wakenya kwamba ugaidi hushindwa kupitia ushirikiano kati ya wananchi na serikali katika ngazi zote.

English: Do not take photographs of government installations or security operations, as this may endanger national security.
Kiswahili: Usipige picha vituo vya serikali au shughuli za usalama, kwani hili linaweza kuhatarisha usalama wa taifa.

English: Every Kenyan has a role in keeping the country safe; if you see something unusual, say something to the authorities.
Kiswahili: Kila Mkenya ana jukumu la kulinda usalama wa nchi; ukiona jambo lisilo la kawaida, lifafanue kwa mamlaka husika.

English: Schools and places of worship are encouraged to review their emergency plans and train members on safe evacuation procedures.
Kiswahili: Shule na mahali pa ibada vinahimizwa kupitia tena mipango yao ya dharura na kuwafundisha wanachama taratibu salama za kujikwamua.

English: During national emergencies, rely only on information from official government channels and avoid spreading unverified rumours.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa dharura za kitaifa, tumia tu taarifa kutoka vyanzo rasmi vya serikali na epuka kueneza uvumi usiothibitishwa.

English: Cooperate fully with security checks at public buildings, bus stations and shopping centres; these measures protect everyone.
Kiswahili: Shirikiana kikamilifu na ukaguzi wa usalama katika majengo ya umma, vituo vya mabasi na maduka makubwa; hatua hizi hulinda kila mtu.

English: Landlords and hotel operators are reminded to keep proper records of tenants and guests as required by security regulations.
Kiswahili: Wamiliki wa nyumba za kupanga na wahudumu wa mahoteli wanakumbushwa kuweka kumbukumbu sahihi za wapangaji na wageni kama inavyohitajika na kanuni za usalama.

English: Community leaders are urged to promote peace and report early signs of radicalisation or violent extremism to the authorities.
Kiswahili: Viongozi wa jamii wanahimizwa kukuza amani na kuripoti ishara za mapema za itikadi kali na ugaidi kwa mamlaka husika.

English: Gender-based violence is a crime in Kenya; survivors are encouraged to report to the nearest police station or health facility.
Kiswahili: Ukatili wa kijinsia ni uhalifu nchini Kenya; washirika wanaopitia ukatili huu wanahimizwa kuripoti katika kituo cha polisi au kituo cha afya kilicho karibu.

English: If you or someone you know is experiencing abuse, call the national GBV helpline for free, confidential support at any time.
Kiswahili: Iwapo wewe au mtu unayemjua anapitia unyanyasaji, pigia simu laini ya kitaifa ya GBV kupata msaada wa bure na wa siri wakati wowote.

English: Survivors of violence deserve respect and care; seek medical attention within the recommended time and preserve any evidence safely.
Kiswahili: Waliopitia ukatili wanastahili heshima na utunzaji; tafuta huduma ya afya ndani ya muda unaopendekezwa na uhifadhi ushahidi wowote kwa usalama.

English: No one has the right to hurt you; support services will listen without judgement and help you make safe choices.
Kiswahili: Hakuna mtu aliye na haki ya kukuumiza; huduma za msaada zitakusikiliza bila kukuhukumu na kukusaidia kufanya maamuzi salama.

English: Community members are urged to speak out against harmful practices and protect women, girls and boys from all forms of abuse.
Kiswahili: Wanajamii wanahimizwa kuongea dhidi ya desturi zinazodhuru na kuwalinda wanawake, wasichana na wavulana dhidi ya aina zote za unyanyasaji.

English: Chiefs and community elders are reminded that resolving defilement or assault cases at home is against the law; report them immediately.
Kiswahili: Machifu na wazee wa jamii wanakumbushwa kwamba kutatua kesi za ubakaji au mashambulizi nyumbani ni kinyume cha sheria; ziripoti mara moja.

English: NGOs supporting survivors offer counselling, legal guidance and safe shelter; reaching out for help is a sign of strength, not weakness.
Kiswahili: Mashirika yasiyo ya kiserikali yanayowasaidia washirika hutoa ushauri, mwongozo wa kisheria na makazi salama; kutafuta msaada ni ishara ya nguvu, si udhaifu.

English: Men and boys are called upon to be allies in ending gender-based violence by challenging harmful attitudes in their communities.
Kiswahili: Wanaume na wavulana wanaalikwa kuwa washirika katika kukomesha ukatili wa kijinsia kwa kupinga mitazamo michafu katika jamii zao.

English: If you suspect a child is being abused, report to the children's officer or the nearest police station; your action can save a life.
Kiswahili: Ukishuki mtoto ananyanyaswa, ripoti kwa afisa wa watoto au kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu; hatua yako inaweza kuokoa maisha.

English: Everyone deserves to live free from fear; together we can build homes and communities where violence is never tolerated.
Kiswahili: Kila mtu anastahili kuishi bila hofu; kwa pamoja tunaweza kujenga nyumba na jamii ambako ukatili huvumiliwi kamwe.

English: The Communications Authority of Kenya warns the public never to share M-Pesa PINs or one-time codes with anyone, including callers claiming to be agents.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inaonya umma kutowahi kugawa PIN za M-Pesa au misimbo ya kuthibitisha na mtu yeyote, hata wanaojiita mawakala.

English: Safaricom and bank staff will never call to ask for your PIN or password; hang up and report such callers to the authorities.
Kiswahili: Wafanyakazi wa Safaricom na benki hawatawahi kupiga simu kuuliza PIN au nenosiri lako; kata simu na uwaripoti wapigaji kama hao kwa mamlaka.

English: Before sending money, confirm the recipient's name carefully and beware of fake reversal messages asking you to refund funds.
Kiswahili: Kabla ya kutuma pesa, hakikisha jina la mpokeaji kwa makini na ujihadhari na ujumbe bandia wa kurudisha pesa unaokuuliza kurejesha fedha.

English: Use strong passwords with a mix of letters, numbers and symbols, and never use the same password on different accounts.
Kiswahili: Tumia manenosiri imara yenye mchanganyiko wa herufi, nambari na alama, na usitumie nenosiri moja kwenye akaunti tofauti.

English: Parents are urged to monitor their children's online activities and teach them never to share personal details or photos with strangers.
Kiswahili: Wazazi wanahimizwa kufuatilia shughuli za watoto wao mtandaoni na kuwafundisha kutogawa taarifa binafsi au picha kwa wageni.

English: Do not click on links promising free loans, prizes or job offers; genuine organisations never ask for fees through random messages.
Kiswahili: Usibofye viungo vinavyoahidi mikopo ya bure, zawadi au kazi; mashirika halisi hayawahi kuomba ada kupitia ujumbe wa nasibu.

English: If your phone is lost or stolen, report immediately to your mobile service provider and the police to block your lines and accounts.
Kiswahili: Iwapo simu yako imepotea au imeibiwa, ripoti mara moja kwa mtoa huduma wa simu na polisi ili kuzuia laini na akaunti zako.

English: Enable two-step verification on your email and social media accounts to keep hackers away from your personal information.
Kiswahili: Wezesha uthibitishaji wa hatua mbili kwenye barua pepe na akaunti zako za mitandao ya kijamii ili kuwazuia wadukuzi kufikia taarifa zako binafsi.

English: Online fraudsters often pretend to be friends in distress; always call the person directly to confirm before sending any money.
Kiswahili: Watangamizi wa mtandaoni mara nyingi hujifanya marafiki walio katika shida; daima pigia mtu huyo simu moja kwa moja kuthibitisha kabla ya kutuma pesa yoyote.

English: The DCI reminds Kenyans to report cybercrime, including online harassment and fraud, at any police station or through official reporting channels.
Kiswahili: DCI inawakumbusha Wakenya kuripoti uhalifu wa mtandaoni, ikijumuisha unyanyasaji na ulaghai wa mtandaoni, katika kituo chochote cha polisi au kupitia njia rasmi za kuripoti.

English: The EACC encourages citizens to report any public officer who asks for a bribe before providing a government service.
Kiswahili: EACC inahimiza raia kuripoti afisa yeyote wa umma anayeomba rushwa kabla ya kutoa huduma ya serikali.

English: No government service requires a bribe; refuse to pay, note the officer's name, and report to the EACC.
Kiswahili: Hakuna huduma ya serikali inayohitaji rushwa; kataa kulipa, andika jina la afisa, na uripoti kwa EACC.

English: Whistleblowers are protected by law; you can report corruption confidentially without fear of victimisation.
Kiswahili: Watoaji taarifa za ufisadi hulindwa na sheria; unaweza kuripoti ufisadi kwa siri bila hofu ya kunyanyaswa.

English: Public officers are reminded that declaring their wealth as required by law is not optional but a legal duty.
Kiswahili: Maafisa wa umma wanakumbushwa kwamba kutangaza mali zao kama inavyohitajika na sheria si lazima bali ni wajibu wa kisheria.

English: The EACC urges institutions to strengthen internal audit systems to prevent misuse of public funds.
Kiswahili: EACC inahimiza taasisi kuimarisha mifumo ya ukaguzi wa ndani ili kuzuia matumizi mabaya ya fedha za umma.

English: Citizens are urged to demand official receipts for every payment made at government offices.
Kiswahili: Raia wanahimizwa kudai risiti rasmi kwa kila malipo yanayofanywa katika ofisi za serikali.

English: Integrity begins with each of us; do not offer a bribe even when you are in a hurry to be served.
Kiswahili: Uadilifu huanza na kila mmoja wetu; usitoe rushwa hata ukiwa na haraka ya kuhudumiwa.

English: The county government will publish all tender awards publicly to promote transparency in procurement.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya kaunti itachapisha wazi tuzo zote za zabuni ili kukuza uwazi katika ununuzi.

English: Students and young people are encouraged to join integrity clubs in schools to promote honesty from an early age.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi na vijana wanahimizwa kujiunga na vilabu vya uadilifu shuleni ili kukuza uaminifu tangu utotoni.

English: Anyone who falsifies documents to obtain public funds will be prosecuted and required to repay every shilling.
Kiswahili: Mtu yeyote atakayegushi nyaraka ili kupata fedha za umma atafunguliwa mashtaka na kulazimishwa kulipa kila shilingi.

English: Members of the public are invited to submit their views on the proposed county budget at the ward offices.
Kiswahili: Wananchi wanaalikwa kuwasilisha maoni yao kuhusu bajeti iliyopendekezwa ya kaunti katika ofisi za wadi.

English: The county government will hold public hearings in every sub-county before finalising the development plan.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya kaunti itafanya vikao vya kusikiliza umma katika kila wilaya ndogo kabla ya kukamilisha mpango wa maendeleo.

English: Your voice matters; attend the next public participation forum and tell your leaders what your community needs.
Kiswahili: Sauti yako ni muhimu; hudhuria kikao kijacho cha ushiriki wa umma na uwaambie viongozi wako mahitaji ya jumuiya yako.

English: Residents can now submit memoranda on proposed bills through the county assembly website or in person.
Kiswahili: Wakazi sasa wanaweza kuwasilisha maombi yao kuhusu mswada uliopendekezwa kupitia tovuti ya bunge la kaunti au kwa kufika wenyewe.

English: All public participation meetings are free and open to every resident, including persons with disabilities.
Kiswahili: Mikutano yote ya ushiriki wa umma ni ya bure na wazi kwa kila mkazi, ikiwemo watu wenye ulemavu.

English: Young people are encouraged to attend county budget forums to understand how public money is planned and spent.
Kiswahili: Vijana wanahimizwa kuhudhuria vikao vya bajeti ya kaunti ili kuelewa jinsi fedha za umma zinavyopangwa na kutumika.

English: The county assembly invites persons with disabilities to accessible forums; sign language interpreters will be provided.
Kiswahili: Bunge la kaunti linawaalika watu wenye ulemavu kwenye vikao vinavyowafaa; wakalimani wa lugha ya ishara watatolewa.

English: Community proposals submitted during public participation must be acknowledged and responded to within the set timelines.
Kiswahili: Mapendekezo ya jamii yanayowasilishwa wakati wa ushiriki wa umma lazima yatambuliwe na kujibiwa ndani ya muda uliowekwa.

English: Residents are reminded that public participation is a constitutional right, not a favour from leaders.
Kiswahili: Wakazi wanakumbushwa kwamba ushiriki wa umma ni haki ya katiba, si neema kutoka kwa viongozi.

English: The IEBC urges all eligible Kenyans to confirm their voter registration details before the register is finalised.
Kiswahili: IEBC inahimiza Wakenya wote wanaostahili kuthibitisha taarifa zao za usajili wa kupiga kura kabla daftari halijakamilishwa.

English: Voter registration is free and open at all IEBC constituency offices; carry your national ID card.
Kiswahili: Usajili wa kupiga kura ni wa bure na unapatikana katika ofisi zote za IEBC za majimbo; beba kitambulisho chako cha kitaifa.

English: Every vote counts; plan your voting day early and encourage your family and neighbours to vote peacefully.
Kiswahili: Kila kura ni muhimu; panga siku yako ya kupiga kura mapema na uhimize familia na majirani zako kupiga kura kwa amani.

English: Kenyans are urged to reject violence and hate speech before, during and after the elections.
Kiswahili: Wakenya wanahimizwa kukataa vurugu na lugha za chuki kabla, wakati na baada ya uchaguzi.

English: First-time voters are reminded that the ballot is secret; no one should force you to reveal your choice.
Kiswahili: Wapiga kura wa mara ya kwanza wanakumbushwa kwamba kura ni siri; hakuna mtu anayepaswa kukulazimisha kufichua chaguo lako.

English: Check your registration details through the official IEBC verification channels and correct any errors early.
Kiswahili: Kagua taarifa zako za usajili kupitia njia rasmi za uthibitishaji za IEBC na urekebishe makosa yoyote mapema.

English: Polling stations open in the morning; carry your identification document and follow the guidance of election officials.
Kiswahili: Vituo vya kupiga kura hufunguliwa asubuhi; beba hati yako ya kitambulisho na ufuate mwongozo wa maafisa wa uchaguzi.

English: Selling or buying votes is a crime punishable by law; report anyone attempting to buy your vote.
Kiswahili: Kuuza au kununua kura ni uhalifu unaoadhibiwa na sheria; ripoti mtu yeyote anayejaribu kununua kura yako.

English: The IEBC will provide assisted voting for persons with disabilities and priority queues for the elderly and expectant mothers.
Kiswahili: IEBC itatoa msaada wa kupiga kura kwa watu wenye ulemavu na foleni za kipaumbele kwa wazee na wakina mama wajawazito.

English: Peace begins with each of us; accept election results peacefully and use legal channels for any disputes.
Kiswahili: Amani huanza na kila mmoja wetu; kubali matokeo ya uchaguzi kwa amani na tumia njia za kisheria kwa migogoro yoyote.

English: The Nyeri ELRC is closed from 24th August to 7th September 2020 due to two confirmed COVID-19 cases, with fumigation and staff self-quarantine underway. Mahakama itafunguliwa tena kwa ajili ya vikao vya mtandaoni tarehe 21 Septemba, huku vikao vya kimwili vikitarajiwa kuanza tena chini ya usimamizi wa Jaji Mkuu mapema Oktoba.
Ekegusii:

Kiswahili: Kutangaza kuidhinishwa rasmi kwa mfumo wa Umoja wa Mataifa kwa ajili ya uingiliaji kati wa lishe wa sekta mbalimbali ili kukabiliana na utapiamlo kote nchini.

Metadata: {"type": "gold", "license": "lecturer-provided", "psa_class": "PSA", "lecturer_id": "1721", "dholuo": "Ne ochak tich mar pidho puothe kod pidho jamni e piny Naoros, kama kwan mar nyithindo ma nigi midekre mar yuto ne odok chien gi pasent 41 nikech chenro mag pur gi chiemo.", "somali": "Bilowga dadweynaha ee soo saarista dalagyada waraabinta iyo quudinta Naoros, halkaas oo kiisaska quudinta ka yar shan sano ay hoos u dhaceen 41% iyada oo ay ugu wacan tahay tallaabooyinka nafaqada beeraha ee isdhexgalka."}

English: Public announcement of national campaign targeting rice, flour and oil millers to adhere to micronutrient fortification standards, including awards for top performers.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la umma la kampeni ya kitaifa inayolenga wasagaji wa mchele, unga na mafuta kuzingatia viwango vya urutubishaji wa virutubisho, ikiwa ni pamoja na tuzo kwa waliofanya vyema.
Ekegusii: Okoraria ekampeni ase mwanyabanto erengete abaremi bomochere, obosie na amaguta gotingia ebirengo biobochenu,amo nebiegwa ase abakori amaya

English: Official launch of program training villagers including women for home gardens supplying nutrient-dense produce for households and schools.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi rasmi wa programu ya mafunzo kwa wanakijiji wakiwemo wanawake kwa ajili ya bustani za nyumbani zinazotoa mazao yenye virutubisho vingi kwa kaya na shule.

English: Launch of smartphone app to track daily steps, hydration, dietary intake, and stress levels with community leaderboards.

English: Men's mental health awareness is critically important because they face unique challenges and pressures from society. English: Floods are common in Kenya during rainy seasons. Learn evacuation routes, store emergency supplies, and avoid flooded areas to protect lives and property.
Kiswahili: Mafuriko ni ya kawaida nchini Kenya wakati wa mvua. Jifunze njia za kuhama, hifadhi vifaa vya dharura, na epuka maeneo yaliyofurika ili kulinda maisha na mali.
Ekegusii: Etoigo negento kiabotambe ekero kiembura enene aiga seito Kenya.Egera kumanyama chinsemo chiokominchoreria,kogacha ebinto biokonya,na bera are korwa chinsemo chitereime amache erio korenda obogima nenibo.
Metadata: {"type": "gold", "license": "lecturer-provided", "psa_class": "PSA", "lecturer_id": "2311", "dholuo": "Ng'e yore ma inyalo golgo joma odak e pinyno, kano gik ma dwarore e kinde mag masira, kendo weyo kuonde ma pi opong'o mondo irit ngima ji kod mwandu.", "somali": "Daadadku waa mid caadi ah Kenya xilliga roobka."}

English: Informal settlements are prone to fires due to congested housing and illegal electricity connections. Report hazards and use fire-safe cooking methods.
Kiswahili: Makazi yasiyo rasmi yanakabiliwa na moto kutokana na msongamano wa nyumba na miunganisho haramu ya umeme. Ripoti hatari na utumie njia za kupikia salama kwa moto.
Ekegusii: Abanto mamenyete ase emechie eagachire gotabwatia omoroberio omoronge bwobwagachi na ekomonteranete nigo bare ase emechando bwechinyomba chaibo koiya nomorero asengencho chinyomba chiabi chibwataine nabo igo okobeka esitima ase enchera yoboibi.Karwa amang'ana igoro yomorero na tumia chinchera chingiya chiokorisia endagera.
Metadata: {"type": "gold", "license": "lecturer-provided", "psa_class": "PSA", "lecturer_id": "2312", "dholuo": "Dak e mier ma ok ochan medo nyalo mar ute go mako mach nikech ngeny mar udi gi yore yuayo stima morochore. Ti uru gi yore tedo maratiro kendo chop uru weche masira kuma owinjore", "somali": "Guryaha la deggan yahay waxaa ku dhaca dabka sababtoo ah guryaha badan iyo korontada sharci darrada ah. Warbixinta khatarta iyo isticmaalka hababka dabka ammaan ah."}

English: Droughts devastate livestock and livelihoods. The government provides water trucking and livestock feeds. Report severe cases to county disaster committees.
Kiswahili: Ukame huharibu mifugo na riziki zao. Serikali hutoa huduma za maji kwa magari na chakula cha mifugo. Ripoti visa vikali kwa kamati za maafa za kaunti.
Ekegusii: Omogaso omonene nigo ogochanda etugo amo nendagera ase.Eserikari nkorwe ere ogosira ase amache nendagera yetugo boigo.
Metadata: {"type": "gold", "license": "lecturer-provided", "psa_class": "PSA", "lecturer_id": "2313", "dholuo": "Oro ketho jamni kod yore mag yuto. sirkal chiwo pi mar ting'o mtokni kod chiemb jamni. Ter uru wach achiedh nade e migepe mar masira", "somali": "Abaaruhu wuxuu baabi'inayaa xoolaha iyo noloshooda."}

English: Though rare, earthquakes can occur. Drop, Cover, and Hold during tremors. Avoid buildings with cracks and report structural weaknesses to authorities.
Kiswahili: Ingawa ni nadra, matetemeko ya ardhi yanaweza kutokea. Kuanguka, Kufunika, na Kushikilia wakati wa mitetemeko. Epuka majengo yenye nyufa na uripoti udhaifu wa kimuundo kwa mamlaka.
Ekegusii: Nonya omotengencho tori koba mono,nabo ekanyerekana ochiche.Tuba omotwe oo na ekumbe gose kunama namagako ao gochia inse,ekero kiomotengencho.Kabe are nechinyomba chitandogete,gose gose chiekumbete na manyia abateneri bamaagacho igoro yobogongeru bwechinyomba echio.
Metadata: {"type": "gold", "license": "lecturer-provided", "psa_class": "PSA", "lecturer_id": "2314", "dholuo": "Kata obedo ni yiengni mag piny ok nyal timore ahinya, buog e ute motegno kendo ichop wach ne migao mochungne arita mag yiengni piny", "somali": "Inkastoo ay dhif tahay, dhulgariir ayaa dhici kara.  Ka fogow dhismayaasha leh dildilaacyada oo u sheeg hay'adaha daciifnimada qaab-dhismeedka."}

English: Save critical numbers: *719# for Red Cross, 999 for police, and 112 for ambulance services during disasters. Share with family and neighbors.
Kiswahili: Hifadhi nambari muhimu: *719# kwa Msalaba Mwekundu, 999 kwa polisi, na 112 kwa huduma za ambulensi wakati wa majanga. Shiriki na familia na majirani.
Ekegusii: Kabe nechinamba chikorigia ogokonya:*719# ase ekeombe kiomosaraba omobariri,999 asee porisi na 112 ase chorori chiria chiogokonya ekero kiomochando.Manyania chinamba echi nabanto baino na abaamate.
Metadata: {"type": "gold", "license": "lecturer-provided", "psa_class": "PSA", "lecturer_id": "2315", "dholuo": "Ndik namba mag sime: *719# ne Red Cross, 999 ne polis, kod 112 ne ambulans e kinde masira, kendo ikon osiepe kod wede", "somali": "Ka badbaadi tirada ugu badan: *719# ee Laanqeyrta Cas, 999 ee booliiska, iyo 112 ee adeegyada degdegga ah."}

English: Hilly areas like Murang'a are prone to landslides. Avoid building on steep slopes and heed evacuation warnings during heavy rains.
Kiswahili: Maeneo yenye vilima kama Murang'a yanakabiliwa na maporomoko ya ardhi. Epuka kujenga kwenye miteremko mikali na zingatia maonyo ya uokoaji wakati wa mvua kubwa.
Ekegusii: Chinsemo chimogete iguru buna Murang'a naororo konyora okwanyoka kweriroba.Kabe are nechinyomba chiagachire ase aimogete igoro naende igwera chinchera chigokurera ekero kiembura enene.
Metadata: {"type": "gold", "license": "lecturer-provided", "psa_class": "PSA", "lecturer_id": "2316", "dholuo": "Lowo nyalo twal kuonde gode gode kaka Murang'a, omiyo kik igedi e kor gode madongo kendo iketh saa ma ok iringo ka lendo mag masira ochoponi", "somali": "Meelaha buuraha ku yaal sida Murang'a waxay u nugul yihiin dhulgariir."}

English: During floods, cholera spreads through contaminated water. Boil drinking water, wash hands, and report symptoms to health facilities immediately.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa mafuriko, kipindupindu huenea kupitia maji machafu. Chemsha maji ya kunywa, osha mikono, na uripoti dalili kwa vituo vya afya mara moja.
Ekegusii: Chingakj chiamache nemegoko emenene,obworwaire bwa gepindapindu nigo bokwambokerana bwango goetera ebinyinyi ase amache.Beria amache okonywa,esibie amaboko buya,na manyia abakoreri bobochenu bwango.
Metadata: {"type": "gold", "license": "lecturer-provided", "psa_class": "PSA", "lecturer_id": "2317", "dholuo": "Sama ataro otimore, tuwo mar cholera landore kokalo kuom pi mochido. Omyo ne laktar mapiyo kichich ni in gi tuo cholera", "somali": "Inta lagu jiro daadka, cudurka dacuunka ayaa ku faafa biyaha wasakhda ah."}

English: Human activities cause most wildfires. Avoid open flames in forests and report smoke sightings to Kenya Forest Service.
Kiswahili: Shughuli za kibinadamu husababisha moto mwingi wa porini. Epuka miale ya moto iliyo wazi katika misitu na uripoti moshi kwa Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya.
Ekegusii: Engencho abanto bagokora ebinto biabo nero egwokia omorero ase chingaki chinyinge.
Metadata: {"type": "gold", "license": "lecturer-provided", "psa_class": "PSA", "lecturer_id": "2318", "dholuo": "Timbe mag dhano ema kelo mach mang'eny e bunge. Tem kik ichwe mach e bunge kendo iter ripot ne Kenya Forest Service ka ineno iro e bungu", "somali": "Ka fogaada dabka kaynta oo ka warbixi in qiiqa ay keento Hay'adda Kaynta Kenya."}

English: Coastal communities should recognize tsunami warning signs (receding water) and move to higher ground immediately.
Kiswahili: Jamii za pwani zinapaswa kutambua ishara za onyo la tsunami (maji yanapungua) na kuhamia kwenye ardhi ya juu mara moja.
Ekegusii: Abamenyi baonchokanete enyancha nere buya babe nobomanyi bwokomanya ekero omwaga omonene bwesunami okare gocha (obwango bwa amache enyancha agocha na kogenda)erio batame gochia ase aimokerete igoro bwango kegima.
Metadata: {"type": "gold", "license": "lecturer-provided", "psa_class": "PSA", "lecturer_id": "2319", "dholuo": "Joma odak e dho nam onego ong'e ranyisi mag tsunami (pi dok chien) kendo gidonj e kuonde maboyo mapiyo.", "somali": "Bulshooyinka xeebta ku nool waa inay ogaadaan calaamadaha tsunami (biyo daadsan) isla markaana isla markiiba tagaan meelaha sare."}

English: Basic first aid saves lives during disasters. Free training is available through St. John Ambulance and Kenya Red Cross.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya kwanza ya msingi huokoa maisha wakati wa majanga. Mafunzo ya bure yanapatikana kupitia St. John Ambulance na Kenya Red Cross.
Ekegusii: Ayabwenerete gokorwa ritangani chingaki chimobasekano.Okwegerigwa kwa bosa na St.John Ambulance and Kenya Red cross.
Metadata: {"type": "gold", "license": "lecturer-provided", "psa_class": "PSA", "lecturer_id": "2320", "dholuo": "Tiegruok ma onge chudo ma yudore e St. John Ambulance kod Kenya Red Cross konyo e reso ngima ji sama masira otimore.", "somali": "Taageerada aasaasiga ah waxay badbaadinaysaa nolosha musiibooyinka. Tababbarka bilaashka ah waxaa laga helaa St. John Ambulance iyo Hay'adda Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya."}

English: Disasters disproportionately affect people with disabilities. Families should plan accessible evacuation routes in advance.
Kiswahili: Maafa huathiri watu wenye ulemavu kwa kiasi kikubwa. Familia zinapaswa kupanga njia za uokoaji zinazopatikana mapema.
Ekegusii: Emesabeka no nigo ere omochando omonene ase abanto bare noborema.Abanto benyomba eyemo nere buya koroberia igoro yenchera yogwekonya baranyare goetera nyuma yomobasekano oyio.
Metadata: {"type": "gold", "license": "lecturer-provided", "psa_class": "PSA", "lecturer_id": "2321", "dholuo": "Masiche hinyo joma nigi ng'ol e okang' malach, omiyo onego ochan chon yore ma ginyalo tiyogo e golo joma nigi ng'ol mopogore opogore.", "somali": "Dadka naafada ah waxaa ku dhaca musiibooyin aan horay loo arag."}

English: Survivors of disasters often face trauma. Free counseling is available at government health centers and through NGOs.
Kiswahili: Mara nyingi manusura wa majanga hukabiliwa na kiwewe. Ushauri nasaha wa bure unapatikana katika vituo vya afya vya serikali na kupitia mashirika yasiyo ya kiserikali.
Ekegusii: Abatigari bemebasekano chingaki chinyinge nigo bakweiranana.Obotebereria na obokonyi bwa bosa mboreo ase chinyagitari chieserikari na goetera ebiombe biria bitari bieserikari(NGOs).
Metadata: {"type": "gold", "license": "lecturer-provided", "psa_class": "PSA", "lecturer_id": "2322", "dholuo": "Joma yudo masira bedoga gi buok mang'eny nikech masira magikale.  Mano emomiyo ute thieth mag sirikal kod NGOs golo kony", "somali": "Talobixinta lacag la'aanta ah waxaa laga helaa xarumaha caafimaadka dawladda iyo hay'adaha aan dawladda ahayn."}

English: Drought-affected families can access government relief food. Report hunger cases to the National Drought Management Authority.
Kiswahili: Familia zilizoathiriwa na ukame zinaweza kupata chakula cha msaada cha serikali. Ripoti visa vya njaa kwa Mamlaka ya Kitaifa ya Usimamizi wa Ukame.
Ekegusii: Baria banyorirwe nomochando bweguragura enene nabo bakonyora endagera korwa eserikari.Karwe amang'ana igoro yabanto bare nchara gochia eserikari ensemo ya baria batenenerete ogokonya igoro yokorwa obokonyi chingaki chieguragura enene.

Onego chiw ripot mar oro e migao mar National Drought Management Authority", "somali": "Qoysaska abaaruhu saameyn ku yeesheen waxay heli karaan raashinka dawladda. Warbixin ku saabsan kiisaska abaaraha ee Hay'adda Maareynta Abaaraha Qaranka."}

English: Homes and schools in disaster-prone areas should meet safety standards to withstand floods, earthquakes, and storms.
Kiswahili: Nyumba na shule katika maeneo yanayokumbwa na majanga zinapaswa kufikia viwango vya usalama ili kustahimili mafuriko, matetemeko ya ardhi, na dhoruba.
Ekegusii: Chinka nechisukuru chire chingongo chiriachibwate rinaga rinene ria emechando goika chitwatre oborendi bore igoro konua emetengecho nee chikoba
Metadata: {"type": "gold", "license": "lecturer-provided", "psa_class": "PSA", "lecturer_id": "2324", "dholuo": "Ute kod skunde manie alwora ma masiche nyalo yudo onego obed ma nigi rit maber mondo omi kik yiengni mag pi, yiengni mag piny, kod yamo mager omedre.", "somali": "Guryaha iyo dugsiyada meelaha musiibada ka dhacdo waa in la ilaaliyaa heerarka amniga si ay u adkeystaan fatahaadaha, dhulgariirrada iyo duufaannada."}

English: Counties have designated evacuation centers. Locate your nearest shelter and keep emergency kits ready.
Kiswahili: Kaunti zina vituo maalum vya uokoaji. Tafuta makazi yako ya karibu na weka vifaa vya dharura tayari.
Ekegusii: Counties chibegete chinsemo chio obotamero bera ange nase ayie beka ebinto bio'bokonyi ang'e.
Metadata: {"type": "gold", "license": "lecturer-provided", "psa_class": "PSA", "lecturer_id": "2325", "dholuo": "Kaunti oseyiero kuonde ma ji nyalo yueyoe, temuru manyo kar dak machiegni kodu kendo rituru gik ma dwarore ni utiyogo e konyo joma dwaro thieth.", "somali": "Tirakoobka ayaa go'aamiyay saldhigyada degdegga ah ee loogu talagalay dadka degdegga ah."}

English: After floods, water sources may be contaminated. Use water purification tablets or boil water before drinking.
Kiswahili: Baada ya mafuriko, vyanzo vya maji vinaweza kuwa vimechafuliwa. Tumia vidonge vya kusafisha maji au chemsha maji kabla ya kunywa.
Ekegusii: Nyuma yetoigo,chisoko chia amache nabo chirasareke tumia chitetere chia ogosibia amache ose oberie.
Metadata: {"type": "gold", "license": "lecturer-provided", "psa_class": "PSA", "lecturer_id": "2326", "dholuo": "Bang' koth maduong', pi nyalo bedo ma ok ler. Chuak pi modho kata uti gi yath manego kute mag pi", "somali": "Biyaha daadka ka dib waxaa laga yaabaa inay wasakheeyaan."}

English: Schools should conduct regular fire drills and have emergency plans for floods, fires, and conflicts.
Kiswahili: Shule zinapaswa kufanya mazoezi ya mara kwa mara ya kuzima moto na kuwa na mipango ya dharura kwa ajili ya mafuriko, moto, na migogoro.
Ekegusii: Nere buya ase chisukuru korenda ogwateka kwemerero ase chisukuru chiabo nomoroberio bwokwerenda igoro yetoigo,emerero,nechisegi.
Metadata: {"type": "gold", "license": "lecturer-provided", "psa_class": "PSA", "lecturer_id": "2327", "dholuo": "Skunde onego otim tiegruok mapile mar tieko mach kendo onego gibed gi chenro mag timo mapiyo sama pi opong', mach, kod ywaruok moro otimore.", "somali": "Iskuullada waa inay sameeyaan tababar joogto ah oo dab daminta ah oo ay sameeyaan barnaamijyo deg deg ah oo ku saabsan fatahaadaha, dabka, iyo dagaalada."}

English: Subscribe to SMS alerts from the Meteorological Department to receive real-time flood warnings in your area.
Kiswahili: Jisajili kwa arifa za SMS kutoka Idara ya Hali ya Hewa ili upokee maonyo ya mafuriko ya wakati halisi katika eneo lako.
Ekegusii: Erike nomoroberio oria okorwa ogokurera igoro bwabsemi berire erio konyora ogosemia kwa beene igoro yembura eneene egocha netoigo ase ekenyoro kiao.
Metadata: {"type": "gold", "license": "lecturer-provided", "psa_class": "PSA", "lecturer_id": "2328", "dholuo": "Som weche ma biro e gaset mar Meteorological Department mondo iyud siem e wi pi ma biro e alworau.", "somali": "Hoos ka daawo fariimaha telefoonka ee Xafiiska saadaasha cimilada si aad u hesho digniino dhab ah oo ku saabsan fatahaadaha deegaankaada."}

English: Local committees help coordinate rescue efforts and resource distribution during emergencies. Volunteer with your village committee.
Kiswahili: Kamati za mitaa husaidia kuratibu juhudi za uokoaji na usambazaji wa rasilimali wakati wa dharura. Jitolee na kamati ya kijiji chako.
Ekegusii: Chikomiti chi nka ase okomanyania na kobwaterana igoro yobokonyi na kobga obokonyi chinaki chiomobasekano.Erwe gokomora emeremo yokwerwa.
Metadata: {"type": "gold", "license": "lecturer-provided", "psa_class": "PSA", "lecturer_id": "2329", "dholuo": "Komiti mag alwora konyo e chano yore mag reso ngima kod pogo mwandu mag dhano e kinde mag chandruok.", "somali": "Guddiyada maxalliga ah waxay ka caawiyaan isku xirka gargaarka iyo qeybinta khayraadka xaaladaha degdegga ah."}

English: Improper handling of corpses risks disease outbreaks. Follow Textlines from health authorities during mass fatalities.
Kiswahili: Utunzaji usiofaa wa maiti unahatarisha mlipuko wa magonjwa. Fuata Ujumbe wa maandishi kutoka kwa mamlaka za afya wakati wa vifo vya watu wengi.
Ekegusii: Enhera etabwenereti buna etugo ekwete egotindekwa nenchera eyemo yogwateka kwendwari.Bwatita ayarikire korwa baria bakoraa obochenu ekero endwari yatekire.
Metadata: {"type": "gold", "license": "lecturer-provided", "psa_class": "PSA", "lecturer_id": "2330", "dholuo": "Ka ng'ato ok tim maber gi ringre jomotho, mano nyalo miyo tuwoche omedre. Lu chike mogol kod ute thieth mondo uchor ringre jomotho", "somali": "Isticmaalka xun ee meydadka ayaa khatar ku ah cudurrada faafa."}

English: Criminals may exploit chaos. Secure your property and report looters to police immediately.
Kiswahili: Wahalifu wanaweza kutumia machafuko. Linda mali yako na uripoti waporaji kwa polisi mara moja.
Ekegusii: Abasaria nigo bagotumia omoburukano gokora obosareku.Gacha buya enibo yao na karwe yabasaria gochia ase abasikari bwango kegima.
Metadata: {"type": "gold", "license": "lecturer-provided", "psa_class": "PSA", "lecturer_id": "2331", "dholuo": "Jomahundu nyalo tiyo gi thuolo ma masira otimoree e yo marach, omiyo inyalo rito mwanduni kendo nyiso polis mapiyo", "somali": "Dambiilayaashu waxay si nabadgelyo leh u isticmaali karaan hantidaada waxayna isla markiiba u soo sheegaan booliska."}

English: Livestock are critical for livelihoods. Report distressed animals to veterinary officers for feed and medical support.
Kiswahili: Mifugo ni muhimu kwa riziki. Waripoti wanyama walio katika hali ngumu kwa maafisa wa mifugo kwa ajili ya chakula na usaidizi wa kimatibabu.
Ekegusii: Etugo negento iiengencho ase endangera.Manyia abanyagitari betugo yetugo eria ere ase obokong'u kobwenia nagochirageria amo nobokonyi boganeirie.
Metadata: {"type": "gold", "license": "lecturer-provided", "psa_class": "PSA", "lecturer_id": "2332", "dholuo": "Chiaye ber e medo yuto mar ng'ato. Omiyo ter wach ne lakteche chiaye mondo okony matuo gi modenyo e yoo makare", "somali": "Warbixinta ayaa aad ugu murugooday xayawaanka ay dhakhaatiirtu u keeneen cunto iyo daryeel caafimaad."}

English: Use flashlights instead of candles to prevent fires during blackouts. Report downed power lines to Kenya Power.
Kiswahili: Tumia tochi badala ya mishumaa ili kuzuia moto wakati wa kuzimwa kwa umeme. Ripoti nyaya za umeme zilizoanguka kwa Kenya Power.
Ekegusii: Tumia chitoci ase oborabu erio gotanga ogwateka kwomorero ekero esitima etaiyo.Manyia abanto besitima igoro yemerande yesitima eyio egwete inse.
Metadata: {"type": "gold", "license": "lecturer-provided", "psa_class": "PSA", "lecturer_id": "2333", "dholuo": "Ti gi torch e mudho kar msuma mondo igeng' mach e seche mag mudho.  Kow wach mar mudho ne Kenya Power", "somali": "Shumacyada halkii aad ku isticmaali lahayd toosh u adeegso si aad dabka uga hortagto marka korontada la damiyo."}

English: Avoid driving through flooded roads. Just 30cm of water can sweep away vehicles. Use alternative routes.
Kiswahili: Epuka kuendesha gari kupitia barabara zilizojaa maji. Maji ya sentimita 30 pekee yanaweza kufyonza magari. Tumia njia mbadala.
Ekegusii: Renda togendia egari ase emegeko yamache gose epara etubire namache.Ekerengo kia amache 30cm nabo kerayengeyie na gokorora erori.Etera chinchera ching'ao.
Metadata: {"type": "gold", "license": "lecturer-provided", "psa_class": "PSA", "lecturer_id": "2334", "dholuo": "Kik idonj e nderni ma pi opong'o, nikech pi matin ma romo sentimita 30 nyalo ywayo mtokni.", "somali": "Ka fogow waddooyinka buuxsamay."}

English: Companies should have continuity plans, backup generators, and employee safety training for emergencies.
Kiswahili: Makampuni yanapaswa kuwa na mipango ya mwendelezo, jenereta mbadala, na mafunzo ya usalama wa wafanyakazi kwa dharura.
Ekegusii: Chikampani nchibwenerete koba nomoroberio bwokogenderera,koba nebinto buna chichenereta chiomorero,na gosimia abakori emerebo baye igoro yemebasekano.
Metadata: {"type": "gold", "license": "lecturer-provided", "psa_class": "PSA", "lecturer_id": "2335", "dholuo": "Kuonde ohala onego obed gi chenro mag dhi nyime, gi masinde mag loso gik moko, kendo tiego jotich e weche mag ritruok e kinde mag chandruok.", "somali": "Shirkadaha waa inay lahaadaan qorshe joogto ah, matoorro dib u dhiska ah, iyo tababar ku saabsan badbaadada shaqaalaha xaaladaha degdegga ah."}

English: Internally Displaced Persons (IDPs) are vulnerable to diseases. Ensure clean water, sanitation, and medical supplies in camps.
Kiswahili: Watu Waliohamishwa Ndani ya Nchi (IDPs) wako katika hatari ya kupata magonjwa. Hakikisha maji safi, usafi wa mazingira, na vifaa vya matibabu katika kambi.
Ekegusii: Abanto baria baseretigwe korwa ase bare gokora emeremo ekero kieminano yechikura chibopresidenti omwaka 2007/2008 na korenta egegi embe yebiama biegesiasa nebisaku, igo ere obwororo ase bare konyorwa namarwaire. Bakonye konyora amache amaya, chichoo, namariogo aaria chikambi chiabo.
Metadata: {"type": "gold", "license": "lecturer-provided", "psa_class": "PSA", "lecturer_id": "2336", "dholuo": "Joma odak e kuonde jot (IDPs) nyalo yudo tuoche mapiyo. Rituru ler mar pi kod alwora kendo chiwuru yedhe", "somali": "Gudaha dadka guryaha la'aanta ah (IPPP) si fudud ayey u xanuunsan karaan cudurrada."}

English: Improper generator use causes carbon monoxide poisoning. Operate generators outdoors and away from windows.
Kiswahili: Matumizi yasiyofaa ya jenereta husababisha sumu ya monoksidi kaboni. Huendesha jenereta nje na mbali na madirisha.
Ekegusii: Gotumia echenereta etarosirie buya namakanika esambe ediseli gose epetiroli buya ekero okoyetumia konyora chunguru chiesuitima nigo egosokia erioki ribabwate esumu ekero kwayeeyanire yaba esumu ase omobere oo. Okia echenereta are korwa ase emerangu nechitirisa erioki tirisoa nyoma.
Metadata: {"type": "gold", "license": "lecturer-provided", "psa_class": "PSA", "lecturer_id": "2337", "dholuo": "Tiyo gi generator e yo maok owinjore nyalo kaw ngima ng'ato kluwore gi carbon monoxide. Ti gi generator e laro mabor gi dirishni mag ot", "somali": "Isticmaalka qalabka korontada ee aan habboonayn wuxuu keenaa in la soo saaro carbon monoxide."}

English: Trained volunteers assist in rescue operations. Register with Kenya Red Cross or local disaster committees.
Kiswahili: Wajitolea waliofunzwa husaidia katika shughuli za uokoaji. Jisajili na kamati za Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya au kamati za maafa za eneo husika.
Ekegusii: Tabanto begeirie bokwerwa nigo bagokonya ekero kiemesekano. Erike byuna oyomo obo nekeombe ekebariri (Red Cross) gose ecomiti eria yanka eusikaine nemeremo eyio.
Metadata: {"type": "gold", "license": "lecturer-provided", "psa_class": "PSA", "lecturer_id": "2338", "dholuo": "Joma otiegore konyo e tije mag reso ji. Ndikri gi Kenya Red Cross kata migepe mar reso joma masira omako", "somali": "Shaqaale tababaran ayaa ka caawiya hawsha gurmadka."}

English: Children are highly vulnerable. Ensure they know emergency contacts and have identification tags in crowded shelters.
Kiswahili: Watoto wako katika hatari kubwa. Hakikisha wanawajua watu wa dharura na wana vitambulisho katika makazi yaliyojaa watu.
Ekegusii: Nigo ere aororo aase abana konyora emechando yemebasekano. Tema kobamanyia chinamba chiesimi chiemebasekano baranyare korangeria nakobaa chipachi chibwate amarieta abo aase abanto bare abange.
Metadata: {"type": "gold", "license": "lecturer-provided", "psa_class": "PSA", "lecturer_id": "2339", "dholuo": "Nyithindo nyalo bedo joma yom yom ahinya, omiyo nyaka ine ni ging'eyo joma ginyalo tudorego e saa masira, kendo ni gin gi kalatese ma nyiso kuma giwuoke", "somali": "Carruurtu si sahlan ayey u qabsadaan, sidaas awgeed waxay u yaqaanaan xaaladaha degdegga ah waxayna haystaan aqoonsiyo meelaha dadku ku badan yihiin."}

English: After floods, disinfect homes to prevent mold and diseases. Wear protective gear during cleanup.
Kiswahili: Baada ya mafuriko, safisha nyumba ili kuzuia ukungu na magonjwa. Vaa vifaa vya kujikinga wakati wa usafi.
Ekegusii: Nyuma yetoigo, siarera omochie ariogo riogoita abinyinyi gotanga amatosi namarwaire. Beka chianga chiogwetanga gotonyerwa neriogo.
Metadata: {"type": "gold", "license": "lecturer-provided", "psa_class": "PSA", "lecturer_id": "2340", "dholuo": "Bang' koth, go udi yedhe mageng'o tuoche kiruako jwala e lweti", "somali": "Daadka ka dib guriga nadiifiso si looga hortago fangaska iyo cudurrada."}

English: During prolonged disasters, preserve food by drying, salting, or using airtight containers to avoid spoilage.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa majanga ya muda mrefu, hifadhi chakula kwa kukausha, kutia chumvi, au kutumia vyombo visivyopitisha hewa ili kuepuka kuharibika.
Ekegusii: Ekero kiechando emetambe buna omogaso gose embura enyinge, gacha endagera ase okoyiomia, koyebeka omonyo, goge koyesiba ime yebibekerero embeo etari gosoa ime koyerenda tegunda.
Metadata: {"type": "gold", "license": "lecturer-provided", "psa_class": "PSA", "lecturer_id": "2341", "dholuo": "Sama masira moro otimore kuom kinde malach, ket chiemo e bwo yiengni ma ok nyal kethore.", "somali": "Marka ay dhacdo musiibooyin muddo dheer soconaya, cuntooyinka ku badbaadi adigoo qalajinaya, ku qallajinaya, ama isticmaalaya qalab hawada la'aan ah si looga hortago in la burburiyo."}

English: Rumors worsen panic. Rely on official updates from government agencies and verified media outlets.
Kiswahili: Uvumi unazidisha hofu. Tegemea masasisho rasmi kutoka kwa mashirika ya serikali na vyombo vya habari vilivyothibitishwa.
Ekegusii: Amangana oborimo nigo akogesa obororo. Nyora amangana korwa aase aronge buna eserikari amo nabariki na abamanyi amangana bokwegenwa.
Metadata: {"type": "gold", "license": "lecturer-provided", "psa_class": "PSA", "lecturer_id": "2342", "dholuo": "Weche mag miriambo miyo ji bedo gi luoro ahinya, kendo mano miyo giweyo weche ma sirkal wacho kod weche ma gipuonjore e wi weche ma timore e piny.", "somali": "Wararka xukuumadda iyo warbaahinta la xaqiijiyay waxay ku tiirsan yihiin wararka rasmiga ah."}

English: Snakes seek shelter in homes during floods. Use torches at night and avoid walking barefoot.
Kiswahili: Nyoka hutafuta makazi majumbani wakati wa mafuriko. Tumia mienge usiku na epuka kutembea bila viatu.
Ekegusii: Chingiti ching'enda'nse origia chire obomenyo chinka chiaito ekero chietoigo. Tumia etochi botuko na erende gotatacha inse namagoro amasa aotabegeti ebiato.
Metadata: {"type": "gold", "license": "lecturer-provided", "psa_class": "PSA", "lecturer_id": "2343", "dholuo": "Sama pi opong'o piny, thuonde manyo kar buok e utegi, giti gi mach gotieno, kendo kik giwuothi gi tiendgi nono.", "somali": "Mas'uuliyiinta ciidamada amniga ayaa sheegay in xilliyada ciidamada amniga ay ka fuliyeen ciidamo ka tirsan ciidamada AMISOM."}

English: Insurance mitigates financial losses from floods, fires, or storms. Explore affordable micro-insurance options.
Kiswahili: Bima hupunguza hasara za kifedha kutokana na mafuriko, moto, au dhoruba. Gundua chaguzi za bima ndogo za bei nafuu.
Ekegusii: Chinsuarensi nigo chigotanga babanto konyora asara ekero kiembura enyinge nemegoko, emerero, gose emerindo. Rigia komanya ebiombe ebike bikorwa ogokonya ekero kiemebasekano yoboremi bwao ekobe ase rigori rianse.
Metadata: {"type": "gold", "license": "lecturer-provided", "psa_class": "PSA", "lecturer_id": "2344", "dholuo": "Insuarans konyo e chulo gik makelo hinyruok nikech pi, mach, kata yamo mager. Ndikri kar insurance mondo iyud kony e saa masira", "somali": "Caymiska waxaa lagu daboolaa khasaaraha dhaqaale ee fatahaadaha, dabka ama duufaannada."}

English: Vulnerable families can access government cash aid during disasters via mobile money platforms.
Kiswahili: Familia zilizo katika mazingira magumu zinaweza kupata msaada wa pesa taslimu wa serikali wakati wa majanga kupitia mifumo ya pesa za simu.
Ekegusii: Chifamiri chiria chitari kwenyara gose chintaka mbwango konyorwa nemechando, tema goikera ogokonya gweserikari goetera omoroberio (o'cash aid) ekero kiemechando goetera esimi yao.
Metadata: {"type": "gold", "license": "lecturer-provided", "psa_class": "PSA", "lecturer_id": "2345", "dholuo": "Joot ma nigi chandruok nyalo yudo kony ma sirkal chiwo e kinde masiche kokalo kuom chenro mag pesa mitimo gi simo.", "somali": "Qoysaska khatarta ku dhaca waxay caawimaad dhaqaale ka heli karaan dowladda markii ay musiibo dhacdo iyada oo loo marayo barnaamijyada lacag bixinta."}

English: Avoid rebuilding in landslide-prone areas. Government offers alternative land for affected families.
Kiswahili: Epuka kujenga upya katika maeneo yanayokumbwa na maporomoko ya ardhi. Serikali inatoa ardhi mbadala kwa familia zilizoathiriwa.
Ekegusii: Tiga koirorera kwoagacha ase riroba rikoanyoka. Eserikari nkorwa ere emegondo emao ase oyio oo ase chifamilia chianyorirwe nomochando oyio.
Metadata: {"type": "gold", "license": "lecturer-provided", "psa_class": "PSA", "lecturer_id": "2346", "dholuo": "Kik uger kuonde ma lowo olwar ahinya, nikech sirkal chiwo lowo ma nyalo konyo joodgi ma masira mar yiengni omako.", "somali": "Ka fogow dib u dhiska meelaha ay dhaceen dhulgariirada. Dowladdu waxay siinaysaa dhul kale qoysaska dhaawacmay."}

English: Free fire safety training is available for communities to prevent and respond to fire outbreaks.
Kiswahili: Mafunzo ya usalama wa moto bila malipo yanapatikana kwa jamii ili kuzuia na kukabiliana na milipuko ya moto.
Ekegusii: Amasomo abosa igoro yokwerenda ekero kiomorero nareo ase ebinyoro gotanga nagokonya chingaki omorero ogwateka.
Metadata: {"type": "gold", "license": "lecturer-provided", "psa_class": "PSA", "lecturer_id": "2347", "dholuo": "Tiegruok ma onge chudo mar mach yudore mondo omi oganda ogeng'o kendo odwokgi e yo maber.", "somali": "Waxaa jira tababar cad oo ku saabsan badbaadada dabka ee bulshooyinka kala duwan si looga hortago iyo looga hortago qaraxyada dabka."}

English: Water conducts electricity. Avoid touching power lines or electrical appliances during floods.
Kiswahili: Maji hupitisha umeme. Epuka kugusa nyaya za umeme au vifaa vya umeme wakati wa mafuriko.
Ekegusii: Chinguru chiomorero bwesitima ngoeta chire ase amache. Tiga kobwata ebitanke biesitima gose ebinto biesitima chingaki chietoigo gose amache ateremete.
Metadata: {"type": "gold", "license": "lecturer-provided", "psa_class": "PSA", "lecturer_id": "2348", "dholuo": "Pi miyo ga sitima muoch, omiyo kik imul sitima kata masinde mamoko mag sitima sama pi opong'o piny.", "somali": "Biyaha waxaa ku jira koronto waxayna ka fogaadaan inay taabtaan fiilooyinka korontada ama qalabka korontada inta lagu jiro daadka."}

English: Farmers should adopt drought-resistant crops and water conservation techniques to mitigate climate shocks.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanapaswa kutumia mazao yanayostahimili ukame na mbinu za kuhifadhi maji ili kupunguza mishtuko ya hali ya hewa.
Ekegusii: Nere buya ase abaremi gosimeka ebimeri bikoremereria omogaso omnene amo nenchera yokogacha na gotumia buya amache na gotanga konyorwa gose gokeania konyorwa nemechando eyio .
Metadata: {"type": "gold", "license": "lecturer-provided", "psa_class": "PSA", "lecturer_id": "2349", "dholuo": "jopur onego opidh yiende ma ok oluoro oro kendo giti gi yore mag rito pi mondo kik giwit yuto e saa masira", "somali": "Beeralayda waa inay horumariyaan dalagyo abaaro ah iyo habab biyo lagu kaydiyo si loo yareeyo saameynta cimilada."}

English: Learn to build temporary shelters using locally available materials for displaced families.
Kiswahili: Jifunze kujenga makazi ya muda kwa kutumia vifaa vinavyopatikana katika eneo husika kwa ajili ya familia zilizopoteza makazi.
Ekegusii: Egera koacha chinyomba ogtumia ebinto bigotoka inka ase bari baseretigwe korwa aase bare abwo nyuma.
Metadata: {"type": "gold", "license": "lecturer-provided", "psa_class": "PSA", "lecturer_id": "2350", "dholuo": "Puonjri gero ute jot ma ji dakie ndalo masir, kitiyo gi gik ma yudore e alwora ma gidakie mondo okonygo joma masira oyudo", "somali": "Baro sida loo dhiso guryo ku meelgaar ah adoo adeegsanaya qalabka deegaankaada loogu talagalay qoysaska guryahooda lumay."}

English: Stampedes worsen disasters. Follow authorities' instructions and avoid panic during mass evacuations.
Kiswahili: Kukanyagana huzidisha majanga. Fuata maagizo ya mamlaka na epuka hofu wakati wa uhamishaji wa watu wengi.
Ekegusii: Ekere omobasekano obeire ekero abanto bakomigererania gotama nogo gokogesa emechando ende emenene. Bwatia ekere abarai bagoteba gokonya okomagamaga chingaki chiogokonya kwabanto abange.
Metadata: {"type": "gold", "license": "lecturer-provided", "psa_class": "PSA", "lecturer_id": "2351", "dholuo": "Luw chike ma sirkal chiko kendo kik ibed maluor sama itimo chenro mar golo ji e kuonde masira", "somali": "Daabacaadda waxay sii kordhisaa masiibooyinka waxayna raacdaa tilmaamaha maamulka waxayna ka baxsataa cabsida marka dad badani ka guuraan."}

English: Learn to recognize trauma symptoms and provide psychological first aid to disaster survivors.
Kiswahili: Jifunze kutambua dalili za kiwewe na kutoa huduma ya kwanza ya kisaikolojia kwa manusura wa majanga.
Ekegusii: Tema komanya buna obwoba gose ogwechanda kwa abanto banyorirwe nomobasekano erio kobakonya korwania obwoba obwo goetera obosemia bwebirengererio na kobasira nchera ende yonsi erio banyare gotenenana kogenderera.
Metadata: {"type": "gold", "license": "lecturer-provided", "psa_class": "PSA", "lecturer_id": "2352", "dholuo": "Puonjri fwenyo chal mar tuwo moro ma ne oyudo ng'ato ka en e masira kendo ikony joma oyudo masira.", "somali": "Baro sida loo aqoonsado calaamadaha cudurka xanuunka maskaxda iyo sida looga caawiyo dadka ka badbaaday musiibada."}

English: Ensure LPG cylinders are stored in well-ventilated areas and check for leaks regularly.
Kiswahili: Hakikisha mitungi ya LPG imehifadhiwa katika maeneo yenye hewa ya kutosha na angalia uvujaji mara kwa mara.
Ekegusii: Rora ng'a omotungi bwegasi yokorugera mbuya egachiire na aase agiya are nerigaba riembeo gosoa ime, na rigereria kera chingaki komanya gose egasi nkominchoria ere korwa omotungi oyesokie bwango buna enchera eyemo yogotanga emebasekano.
Metadata: {"type": "gold", "license": "lecturer-provided", "psa_class": "PSA", "lecturer_id": "2353", "dholuo": "Keturu osikni mag LPG e kuonde ma yamo nitie maber kendo ng'iuru machuer.", "somali": "Daabacaadaha LPG waxaa lagu kaydiyaa meelo si fiican loo ilaaliyo oo si joogto ah loo hubiyaa in ay baxayaan."}

English: Older adults need tailored evacuation plans. Identify caregivers and accessible shelters in advance.
Kiswahili: Wazee wanahitaji mipango maalum ya uokoaji. Tambua walezi na makazi yanayoweza kufikiwa mapema.
Ekegusii: Abanto abagotu mbaganetie enchera yabeene kobatamia korwa emebasekano. Beka abatenereri babo amo nase oraibaire kobera motwe yokobatania korwa omobasekano.
Metadata: {"type": "gold", "license": "lecturer-provided", "psa_class": "PSA", "lecturer_id": "2354", "dholuo": "Joma hikgi ng'eny onego otim chenro mar wuok e utegi, kendo onego ging'e joma rito nyithindgi kod kuonde dak ma ginyalo dhiye chon.", "somali": "Dadka qaangaarka ah waxay u baahan yihiin qorshe lagu wareejiyo dadka."}

English: Village loudspeakers, SMS alerts, and radio broadcasts help disseminate disaster warnings quickly.
Kiswahili: Vipaza sauti vya kijijini, arifa za SMS, na matangazo ya redio husaidia kusambaza maonyo ya maafa haraka.
Ekegusii: Beka amakondo komanyia abanto, tima amangana amenge goetera esimi, nechiredi gokonya komanyia abanto ase oboagare nogokurerwa bwango igoro yomobasekano.
Metadata: {"type": "gold", "license": "lecturer-provided", "psa_class": "PSA", "lecturer_id": "2355", "dholuo": "Auja, weche ma ji oroga kokalo kuom SMS, kod nyakalondo konyo e lando siem mag masiche mapiyo.", "somali": "Codadka tuulooyinka, farriimaha taleefanka gacanta, iyo baahinta raadiyaha waxay gacan ka geystaan in digniinta masiibada si dhakhso leh loo faafiyo."}

English: Chemicals and fuels should be stored away from homes to prevent fires and environmental contamination.
Kiswahili: Kemikali na mafuta yanapaswa kuhifadhiwa mbali na nyumba ili kuzuia moto na uchafuzi wa mazingira.
Ekegusii: Chikemiko naguta nere buya kogachwa are korwa chinka na ase engencho ebwenerete eri ogotanga ogwateka kwemerero na ogosaria amasingira.
Metadata: {"type": "gold", "license": "lecturer-provided", "psa_class": "PSA", "lecturer_id": "2356", "dholuo": "Mondo omi mach kik chakre kendo keth alwora, gik makelo chuk kod petrol onego okan mabor gi udi.", "somali": "Kiimikada iyo shidaalka waa in guriga laga saaraa si looga hortago dabka iyo wasakheynta."}

English: Lost family members can be traced through Kenya Red Cross and social media platforms.
Kiswahili: Wanafamilia waliopotea wanaweza kufuatiliwa kupitia majukwaa ya Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya na mitandao ya kijamii.
Ekegusii: Abanto basirete nnabo barabwatigwe goetera ekeombe ekebariri (Red Cross) amo nabariki amangana na komanyia abanto amang'ana.
Metadata: {"type": "gold", "license": "lecturer-provided", "psa_class": "PSA", "lecturer_id": "2357", "dholuo": "Joma olal bang' masira inyalo yud kuonde ma gintie kokalo kuom riwruok mar Kenya Red Cross kod social media.", "somali": "Xubnaha qoyska ee lumay waxaa lagu raad raaci karaa Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya iyo baraha bulshada."}

English: Stagnant water breeds mosquitoes. Use bed nets and report mosquito infestations to health authorities.
Kiswahili: Maji yaliyotuama huzaa mbu. Tumia vyandarua na uripoti maambukizi ya mbu kwa mamlaka za afya.
Ekegusii: Chiumbu nigo chikoiborerana ase amache atereime. Tumia chineti chiebitanda korara na manyia abanyagitari igoro yokoromwa nechiumbu na buna abanto barwarete.
Metadata: {"type": "gold", "license": "lecturer-provided", "psa_class": "PSA", "lecturer_id": "2358", "dholuo": "Pi ma ok mol miyo suna nywolore, omiyo ti gi net mag nindo kendo inyis jotelo mag thieth ni suna ngeny e aluora ma intie", "somali": "Isticmaal shaashadda, oo u sheeg in cayayaanka ay soo weeraraan xirfadlayaasha caafimaadka."}

English: Communities should invest in boreholes and rainwater harvesting to ensure water access during droughts.
Kiswahili: Jamii zinapaswa kuwekeza katika visima na uvunaji wa maji ya mvua ili kuhakikisha upatikanaji wa maji wakati wa ukame.
Ekegusii: Nere buya ebinyoro kobeka chinguri chiabo ase okorema ebisima ebinene bia abanto abange nomoroberion bwogotacha amache erio koba namache aisaine chingaki chieguragura.
Metadata: {"type": "gold", "license": "lecturer-provided", "psa_class": "PSA", "lecturer_id": "2359", "dholuo": "Ji onego onyiew gige ywayo kod choko pi koth mondo omi ji obed gi pi e ndalo kech gi oro", "somali": "Bulshooyinka waa inay isticmaalaan ceelasha iyo biyaha roobka si ay u kaydiyaan biyaha xilliga abaarta."}

English: Kenya's policy framework ensures coordinated disaster management. Understand your rights and government obligations.
Kiswahili: Mfumo wa sera wa Kenya unahakikisha usimamizi wa maafa ulioratibiwa. Elewa haki zako na majukumu ya serikali.
Ekegusii: Amachiko aKenya igoro yobokoreri ekero kia omobasekano nkoenekia are ng'a okobeaterana nekomoti yemebasekano. Manya aboronge bwao neki eserikari ebwenerete kogokorera.
Metadata: {"type": "gold", "license": "lecturer-provided", "psa_class": "PSA", "lecturer_id": "2360", "dholuo": "Chenro mar Kenya mar timo lokruok e weche mag siasa miyo ji bedo gi chenro maber mar rito masiche.", "somali": "Qaab dhismeedka siyaasadda Kenya wuxuu hubiyaa in masiibooyinka la maareeyo si habsami leh."}

English: The national helpline 1195 is available at all times to provide immediate assistance to survivors of sexual and gender-based violence.
Kiswahili: Simu ya usaidizi ya kitaifa 1195 inapatikana wakati wote ili kutoa msaada wa haraka kwa manusura wa unyanyasaji wa kingono na kijinsia.
Ekegusii: Enamba yesimi yogokonya 1195 inao ere ase chingaki chionsi ase ogokonya bari batarareirwe, gotibonwa gose komocherwa nchera ende yonsi koreng'ana na eki ore.
Metadata: {"type": "gold", "license": "lecturer-provided", "psa_class": "PSA", "lecturer_id": "2361", "dholuo": "namba sime milandoe masich dhaw e kind dichwo gi dhako, en namba 1195 ma yudore e piny mangima.", "somali": "Taageerada qaranka ee 1195 ayaa had iyo jeer la heli karaa si degdeg ah loogu caawiyo dhibanayaasha xadgudubka galmada iyo galmada."}

English: Intimate partner violence often escalates gradually. Early recognition and training for frontline professionals support prevention and safe referrals.
Kiswahili: Vurugu za wapenzi wa karibu mara nyingi huongezeka polepole. Utambuzi wa mapema na mafunzo kwa wataalamu wa mstari wa mbele husaidia kuzuia na rufaa salama.
Ekegusii: Eminano gose ogokurarana gati yomosacha nomokungu oye mara aanga nigo gokogenderera kogesekana na koba boke ng'orang'ora. Mbuya komanya ayio bwango na kwegeria abakoreri baria bare motwe gokonya ase okobaikera na kobakonya ebirengererio na kobaraa gochia nyagitari ase kobwenigwa.

Kiswahili: Wanyanyasaji wa kingono huwalenga watoto mtandaoni na nje ya mtandao. Wazazi wanapaswa kufuatilia mwingiliano na kuwafundisha watoto kuhusu usalama wa miili yao.

English: Many children drown in open water sources. Parents should supervise kids near pools, rivers, and wells.
Kiswahili: Watoto wengi huzama kwenye vyanzo vya maji vilivyo wazi. Wazazi wanapaswa kuwasimamia watoto karibu na madimbwi ya maji, mito, na visima.

Kiswahili: Utafiti wa Chuo Kikuu cha Methodist cha Kenya/IJRISS unaonyesha kwamba polisi jamii inaboresha kwa kiasi kikubwa utoaji wa huduma na uaminifu katika Kaunti ya Nairobi

Kiswahili: Utafiti wa Chuo Kikuu cha Nairobi unatambua mawasiliano kama ufunguo wa uaminifu wa jamii na ufanisi wa COP katika Mji wa Ruai

Kiswahili: Kamanda wa Mkoa wa Nairobi aahidi ulinzi salama wa maandamano ya GenZ kwa kuzingatia kanuni za COP na uratibu na vikundi vya kijamii

English: The Inspector General pledged to implement IPOA recommendations to strengthen oversight, disciplinary processes, and responsiveness to misconduct complaints.
Kiswahili: Mkaguzi Mkuu aliahidi kutekeleza mapendekezo ya IPOA ili kuimarisha usimamizi, michakato ya nidhamu, na uwajibikaji kwa malalamiko ya utovu wa nidhamu.

English: A report documented systemic excessive force during protests and called for prosecutions, crowd control reforms, and stronger conduct enforcement mechanisms.
Kiswahili: Ripoti ilirekodi matumizi mabaya ya nguvu wakati wa maandamano na kutoa wito wa mashtaka, mageuzi ya udhibiti wa umati, na mifumo imara ya utekelezaji wa mwenendo.
